# 外资研报模块 实施计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 落地规格 `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-04-foreign-research-design.md`（第 5 稿；Codex 第四轮 "READY WITH P2 FIXES"，第五轮增量审计 FR5-01–04 已落实）：私有研报馆藏（版本化许可、内容寻址私有桶、意向—暂存—提交状态机）、不可变运行、证据行与物化、发布不变量（SQL 阻断函数 + 唯一发布函数 + 不可变快照）、内容级披露检查、独立摘要三检查、公开只读视图与 API、公开页面与管理员页面、核验 cron 与 outbox。

**Architecture:** 三个迁移（表与触发器 / 函数 / 视图）；`src/lib/broker-research/db.ts` 的 `BrokerResearchDb` 契约有 Supabase（rpc + 表）/ 内存 / pg 三实现；处理服务（上传、解析、抽取、摘要、发布）只依赖注入的 `deps.ts::BrokerDeps`（`BrokerResearchDb`、`BrokerStorage`、`F3Port`、`LlmPort`、`TableClient`、时钟、代码版本、id 生成）；抽取、类型化、定位、合并、规则、披露、落地检查都是纯函数；公开读一律经 anon 客户端读视图。

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 15 App Router、TypeScript、Supabase（PostgreSQL 17 + PostgREST + Storage）、vitest、`pg`（集成测试）、`ajv@8`、`tsx` 脚本、next-intl。

**范围（本计划交付 / 不交付）**

| 工作包 | 本计划 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| FR-0 迁移、视图、函数、契约 | 全部 | Part A |

| FR-2 解析、抽取、复核、评测回执 | 全部，**F3 与 LLM 经可注入端口**：生产端口默认关闭（`BROKER_RESEARCH_F3_ENABLED`、`BROKER_RESEARCH_LLM_ENABLED` 未设为 `1` 时返回 `f3_unavailable` / `llm_unavailable`）；测试用伪 F3 + 录制 LLM 响应 | F3 §11.1 契约由 F3 规格第 6 稿 §8.3 交付；O13 签字未完成，见 PR 依赖清单 |

- **工作树**：`/Volumes/AIMATE_WORK/Developer/CodeX/OsbornAlpha/.claude/worktrees/foreign-research-f63683`，分支 `claude/foreign-research-f63683`。不要 `cd` 到主检出；不要用裸 `git stash`（栈与其他工作树共享）。
- **并行兄弟模块**（plan 3、F3、F4、F6、行业、公司、A 股启用）同时在别的工作树开发。本模块**只拥有**：`src/lib/broker-research/**`、`src/app/(app)/intel/foreign-research/**`、`src/app/(app)/admin/broker-research/**`、`src/app/api/broker-research/**`、`src/app/api/admin/broker-research/**`、`src/app/api/cron/broker-research-*/**`、`scripts/broker-research/**`、`messages/{zh,en}/foreign-research.json`、`supabase/migrations/20261117*_broker_research*.sql`、`docs/audits/2026-11-06-foreign-research/**`。对共享文件的修改**必须**包在注释围栏里，便于合并：TS/JS 用 `// FOREIGN ↓` … `// FOREIGN ↑`，JSON 无法注释时把新增项追加在数组 / 对象末尾并在任务里写明。共享文件清单（只允许这些）：`supabase/migrations.lock.json`（末尾追加）、`src/lib/supabase/database.types.ts`、`scripts/ci/research-checks.ts`（`criticalSuites` 追加）、`src/lib/dq/batches.ts`（`INFO_CODES` 追加 `eval_receipt_absent`）、`src/i18n/request.ts`（`MESSAGE_DOMAINS` 追加 `'foreign-research'`）、`src/app/api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]/route.ts` 及其 `route.test.ts`（`broker_research` 分支与两个用例）、`src/app/(app)/stock/[ticker]/page.tsx`（mock 块移除 + 馆藏块）、`src/app/api/consensus/[ticker]/route.ts`（mock 分支；D3 新建同目录 `route.test.ts`）、`src/app/(app)/intel/page.tsx`（入口）、`package.json`（`test:storage` 脚本）、`docs/runbooks/`（新文件 `broker-research.md`，不改既有文件）。
- **迁移**：只用 `supabase/migrations/20261117HHMMSS_*`。本计划三个文件：`20261117090000_broker_research.sql`（表、约束、索引、桶、表权限、表级触发器）、`20261117091000_broker_research_functions.sql`（全部 SQL 函数与依赖函数的触发器）、`20261117092000_broker_research_views.sql`（公开视图与视图权限）。可重放（`create table if not exists`、`create or replace function`、`drop trigger if exists` 后 `create trigger`、`create or replace view`、`insert … on conflict`）。每个迁移完成时把 `{file, sha256}`（文件字节 hex）**追加**到 `supabase/migrations.lock.json` 末尾；已锁文件不可再改（后续任务需要改动就在**同一任务尚未锁定前**改，或新增迁移文件 `20261117093000_*` 起）。`migrationInventory` 要求未锁迁移晚于已锁最新（2026-11-07 合并 main 后为 `20261114090000_macro_workbench.sql`；`20261115*` 已被 F3 / 宏观占用，`20261116*` 被 F4 占用，故本模块改用 `20261117*`）。
- **本地 harness**：`test:db`（`scripts/ci/research-db.ts`）起本地 PostgreSQL 17，按序执行全部迁移再跑 vitest。集成测试读 `process.env.S4_TEST_STATE` 的 `adminUrl`，`describe.skipIf(!enabled)`。**任何包含字符串 `S4_TEST_STATE` 的 `.test.ts` 必须加进 `criticalSuites`**（否则 `Database suite inventory drift`）。本地只有 `storage.buckets(id,name,public,file_size_limit,allowed_mime_types)` 桩表：迁移只能 `insert into storage.buckets … on conflict (id) do update`，不得引用 `storage.objects`。角色 `anon`、`authenticated`、`service_role` 存在；角色断言用 `has_table_privilege` / `has_function_privilege` 与 `set local role anon` 后真实查询（参照 `src/lib/facts/facts.integration.test.ts` 第 120–145 行）。单文件跑法：`LC_ALL=C PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@17/bin:$PATH npx tsx .claude/scratch/db-one.ts <file>`（`db-one.ts` 内容见 `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-04-HANDOFF-data-foundation-2-execution.md` §5，未提交，丢了就重建）。`LC_ALL=C` 只给 `test:db`/`test:migrations`，不要导出给 `npm test`。
- **托管实例**：`postgres` 非超级用户；`security definer` 函数内 `set search_path = public`；不要 `alter … owner to`。Supabase 默认给 `anon/authenticated` 新函数 EXECUTE：每个函数后 `revoke execute on function … from public, anon, authenticated; grant execute … to service_role`。视图 owner 是迁移角色，`with (security_invoker=false, security_barrier=true)`；视图内**不调用任何本模块函数**（许可谓词、生效值选择器都内联为 SQL 表达式）。
- **类型**：`src/lib/supabase/database.types.ts` 手工维护（新增 22 张表的 `Row/Insert/Update` 放在 `// FOREIGN ↓ … ↑` 围栏里）；RPC 不登记到 `Functions`，调用用 `(client.rpc as never as RpcFn)(...)` 窄类型办法（见 `src/lib/supabase/admin.ts` 注释与 `src/lib/facts/db.ts`）。
- **服务端客户端**：管理员门禁 `requireAdminUser()`（`src/lib/admin/auth.ts`）；写库 `getAdminSupabase()`（`src/lib/supabase/admin.ts`）；公共读 `getAnonSupabase()`（`src/lib/supabase/anon.ts`）；批次 / 隔离 / 新鲜度用计划一 `TableClient`（`src/lib/db/table-client.ts`）+ `startBatch/finishBatch`（`src/lib/dq/batches.ts`）+ `quarantine()`（`src/lib/dq/quarantine.ts`）+ `recordAttempt`（只由核验 cron 调用）。
- **管理员 POST 路由**：沿用 `src/app/api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]/route.ts` 的 Content-Type（`application/json`，否则 415）与 Origin（与 `request.nextUrl.origin` 不同则 403）校验；未登录 401、非管理员 403（`requireAdminUser` 抛出时的映射照抄该路由）。★ 路由（返回全文 / 跨度 / 签名 URL）**先写** `broker_report_access_log` 再返回，写日志失败 → `500 access_log_failed` 且无正文；`withdrawn` 文档 → `410 document_withdrawn`。全部管理员响应 `Cache-Control: no-store`。
- **公开路由**：`export const dynamic='force-dynamic'`；anon 客户端只读视图；**全部响应 `Cache-Control: no-store`**（规格 §8.1，与 facts 公共路由的缓存头不同）；参数解析复用 `src/lib/facts/public-route.ts` 的 `readParams/dateParam/intParam/QueryError/TICKER_RE/UUID_RE`（只 import，不改该文件）；错误体 `{error:{code,message}}`。

- **代码版本**：`resolveCodeVersion({allowGit})`（`src/lib/facts/deps.ts`，只 import）；路由里 `allowGit:false`，脚本 `allowGit:true`；为 null 时写 `'unknown'`。
- **提交**：`git add <本任务 Files>`（不用 `git add -A`）后，`git commit` 单独一条命令；同一命令里不得出现任何 `-n` 记号（包括 `grep -n`、`head -n`），仓库钩子会拦截；不要 `--no-verify`。提交信息末尾：`Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`。每个任务提交前在 `docs/audits/2026-11-06-foreign-research/10-implementation-log.md` 末尾追加一行 `| <任务> | <日期> | <提交 sha 前 8 位> | <测试数> | <偏差或无> |`（文件不存在则建，表头 `| 任务 | 日期 | 提交 | 测试 | 偏差 |`）。
- **测试命令**：`npm test -- <path>`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run lint`（`--max-warnings=0`）、`LC_ALL=C PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@17/bin:$PATH npm run test:db`、同前缀 `npm run test:migrations`。
- **集成测试先过类型检查**：A1–A5、C8 每次改完 `*.integration.test.ts` 后、跑 `test:db` 之前先 `npm run typecheck`（集成文件同样在 tsconfig 覆盖内）；类型 / 语法错误不得留给 `test:db` 去发现。
- **桶写入协议**（P-R6-01..04）：所有模块写入先登记；`trackedUpload` 与 `trackedPortWrite` 在发起前检查未撤回及租约。仅确认成功才 `finishWrite`；发送前围栏拒绝且 worker 确认未调用 upload/F3 时 `abandonWrite`（无 finished_at，排除对账）。F3 返回后再次检查撤回与租约，失败保留 pending。仅有 `purge_requested_at` 的文档进入每日对账；pending 无时间上限，done 在 finished_at 后删除才 reconciled。撤回不清除时保留全部证据。
- **测试库全局状态隔离**：`broker_research_settings` 是单行全局状态，`test:db` 按文件并行。凡切换 `public_enabled`、`approved_gold_corpus_hash` 或依赖其默认值的集成 describe（A1–A3、A5 的 pg 契约、C8 pipeline），在 `beforeAll` 用一条专用连接取会话级 `pg_advisory_lock(hashtext('broker_research_settings'))`，`afterAll` 复原设置行后 `pg_advisory_unlock` 并释放连接（`broker-research.integration.test.ts::lockSettings`；C8 用同一把锁）。断言仍只按本文件自己的 `institution_id / report_id` 过滤。
- **不提交真实研报**：夹具一律合成（`src/lib/broker-research/fixtures/`：合成页文本 JSON、预期 `DocumentExtraction`、录制格式的 LLM 响应 JSON）。不抓取任何网站。

```
src/lib/broker-research/rules-run.ts        applyRules（规则 + 标题披露结果 → 回执 → 隔离；C5）
src/lib/broker-research/extract/run.ts      runExtract / extractCandidates（C5）
src/lib/broker-research/review.ts           复核服务 + reviewData（ReviewPayload）+ 发布 / 取消发布（C6）
src/lib/broker-research/quarantine-hook.ts、quarantine-hook-rules.ts   隔离钩子（db.quarantineResolve；C6）
src/lib/broker-research/summary/run.ts      runSummary / approveSummary / translateTitle（C7）
src/lib/broker-research/snippets.ts         createSnippet / approveSnippet / rejectSnippet（C7）
src/lib/broker-research/withdraw.ts         withdrawDocument / purgeDocument（步骤表；C7）
src/lib/broker-research/eval.ts             评测回执（C8）
src/lib/broker-research/replay.ts           replayPublication（不写库；C8）
src/lib/broker-research/pipeline.integration.test.ts  端到端（critical；C8）
src/lib/broker-research/public-dto.ts、public-read.ts   公开 DTO 白名单序列化 + 公开读加载器（D1）
src/lib/broker-research/admin-read.ts       管理员总览读模型（D4）
src/lib/broker-research/admin-document.ts、preview.ts   文档页读模型、预览（D5）
src/lib/broker-research/institutions.ts     机构维护输入解析 + 审计（D6）
src/lib/broker-research/verify.ts、outbox.ts、cron-auth.ts、ports/f4.ts   核验与清除意向持续对账、outbox 投递、cron 鉴权、F4 端口（E1）
src/lib/broker-research/**/*.test.ts         单测
src/app/api/admin/broker-research/**         管理员路由（C2–C7、D6、E1 的 documents/[documentId]/verify）
src/app/api/broker-research/**               公开路由（D1）
src/app/api/cron/broker-research-verify/route.ts、src/app/api/cron/broker-research-outbox/route.ts（E1）
src/app/(app)/intel/foreign-research/**      公开页面：列表、[reportId]、institutions/[institutionId] + components/*（D2、D3）
src/app/(app)/admin/broker-research/**       管理员页面：总览/上传/许可/访问日志（D4）、documents/[documentId]、review/[reportId]、preview/[reportId]（D5）、institutions（D6）
messages/{zh,en}/foreign-research.json      （D2 创建；D4–D6 追加键）
scripts/broker-research/replay.ts、eval-gold.ts（C8）、storage-check.ts（E1）
docs/runbooks/broker-research.md             （E1）
docs/audits/2026-11-06-foreign-research/10-implementation-log.md   实施记录（每任务一行）
```

**路由动态段命名（全模块唯一）**：`documents/[documentId]`、`reports/[reportId]`、`snippets/[snippetId]`、`summaries/[summaryId]`、`licences/[licenceId]`、`fields/[fieldId]`、`publications/[publicationId]`、`institutions/[institutionId]`、`scales/[scaleId]`、`pages/[n]`；页面目录同名。同级目录不得出现不同 slug 名（Next 拒绝构建）。

---

## 共享契约（所有任务必须用这些名字；`src/lib/broker-research/types.ts` 原样落地）

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/types.ts
// Shared contract of the foreign broker research module (plan 2026-11-06 §共享契约; spec §4).
// Every task uses these names verbatim. BrokerResearchDb has three implementations:
// supabaseBrokerResearchDb (db.ts), memoryBrokerResearchDb (memory-db.ts, unit tests),
// pgBrokerResearchDb (pg-db.ts, integration tests).

export type LicenceKind='terminal_subscription'|'direct_from_broker'|'owner_authored'|'other';
export type IntentStatus='open'|'validating'|'validated'|'promoting'|'committed'|'expired'|'abandoned';
export type DocumentStatus='uploaded'|'parsing'|'parsed'|'parse_failed'|'withdrawn';
export type RunKind='parse'|'extract'|'summary'|'translate'|'verify';
export type RunStatus='running'|'succeeded'|'failed';
export type ReportScope='single_issuer'|'multi_issuer'|'sector'|'macro_strategy';
export type ReviewStatus='pending'|'in_review'|'approved'|'rejected';
export type ReportStatus='draft'|'published'|'withdrawn';
export type TargetBasis='candidate'|'effective';
export type FieldName='institution'|'analyst'|'published_date'|'price_as_of_date'|'ticker'|'rating'|'target_price'|'target_currency'|'target_horizon'|'price_at_report'|'price_currency'|'upside_stated'|'wacc'|'terminal_growth'|'terminal_value_share'|'valuation_method'|'sector'|'title';
export type FieldStatus='extracted'|'unverified'|'confirmed'|'corrected'|'rejected'|'absent';
export type ValueUnit='pct'|'ratio'|'months'|'price';
export type SnippetPurpose='rating'|'target'|'thesis'|'risk'|'method'|'other';
export type TextStatus='draft'|'approved'|'rejected';
export type Lang='zh'|'en';
export type NormalizedRating='buy'|'overweight'|'neutral'|'underweight'|'sell'|'not_rated';
export type AccessAction='upload'|'signed_url_issued'|'text_viewed'|'parse_run'|'extract_run'|'summary_run'|'unpublish'|'withdraw'|'purge'|'orphan_cleanup';
export type OutboxKind='claim.register'|'claim.revise'|'claim.retract'|'licence.changed'|'mapping.changed';
export type PurgeStep='pdf'|'artifacts'|'runs'|'fields_text'|'snippets_text'|'summaries'|'quarantine_payload';
export type FieldAction='confirm'|'correct'|'reject'|'absent';

/** Typed value components of an evidence row (spec §4.6, §5.3). */
export interface TypedValue{value_text:string;value_num:string|null;value_currency:string|null;value_unit:ValueUnit|null;value_date:string|null}
/** `corrected` payload: present key with null = explicit clear; missing key = inherit; value_text must be present and non-null. */
export type CorrectedValue={value_text:string}&Partial<Omit<TypedValue,'value_text'>>;

export interface LicenceRow{
 licence_id:string;version:number;source_label:string;licence_kind:LicenceKind;holder:string;terms_summary:string;evidence_path:string|null;
 allows_llm_processing:boolean;allows_public_metadata:boolean;allows_public_snippets:boolean;allows_public_summary:boolean;allows_public_target_price:boolean;
 snippet_max_chars:number;valid_from:string;valid_to:string|null;
 confirmed_by:string|null;confirmed_at:string|null;confirmed_version:number|null;created_at:string;updated_at:string;
}
export type LicenceInput=Pick<LicenceRow,'source_label'|'licence_kind'|'holder'|'terms_summary'|'evidence_path'|'allows_llm_processing'|'allows_public_metadata'|'allows_public_snippets'|'allows_public_summary'|'allows_public_target_price'|'snippet_max_chars'|'valid_from'|'valid_to'>;
export interface SettingsRow{public_enabled:boolean;approved_gold_corpus_hash:string|null;approved_gold_corpus_by:string|null;approved_gold_corpus_at:string|null;updated_by:string|null;updated_at:string}
export interface IntentRow{
 intent_id:string;sha256:string;byte_size:number;licence_id:string;original_filename:string;created_by:string;created_at:string;expires_at:string;
 status:IntentStatus;staging_path:string;document_id:string|null;error_code:string|null;checkpoint_at:string|null;
}
export interface DocumentRow{
 document_id:string;sha256:string;storage_path:string;byte_size:number;page_count:number|null;licence_id:string;
 uploaded_by:string;uploaded_at:string;original_filename:string;current_parse_run_id:string|null;status:DocumentStatus;
 lease_token:string|null;lease_until:string|null;promotion_pending:boolean;last_verified_at:string|null;verify_status:'ok'|'failed'|'error'|null;
 withdrawn_at:string|null;withdrawn_reason:string|null;purged_at:string|null;purge_requested_at:string|null;purge_requested_by:string|null;
}
export interface RunRow{
 run_id:string;document_id:string;kind:RunKind;parse_run_id:string|null;extractor_version:string|null;artifact_path:string|null;artifact_hash:string|null;
 model_id:string|null;registry_hash:string|null;prompt_version:string|null;schema_version:string|null;code_version:string;behavior_digest:string|null;
 licence_version:number;request_path:string|null;response_path:string|null;batch_id:string|null;status:RunStatus;started_at:string;finished_at:string|null;
 detail:Record<string,unknown>;
}
export interface ReportRow{
 report_id:string;document_id:string;revision:number;scope:ReportScope|null;institution_id:string|null;
 title_original:string|null;title_lang:string|null;title_zh:string|null;title_en:string|null;title_run_id:string|null;title_public:string|null;title_public_by:string|null;
 published_date:string|null;price_as_of_date:string|null;report_type:string|null;sector_as_stated:string|null;primary_target_key:string|null;
 effective_hash:string|null;materialized_hash:string|null;rules_input_hash:string|null;summary_input_digest:string|null;
 title_restricted:boolean;evidence_ok:boolean;disclosure_ok:boolean;review_status:ReviewStatus;status:ReportStatus;
 current_publication_id:string|null;supersedes_report_id:string|null;code_version:string;created_at:string;updated_at:string;
}
/** target_key = parseBrokerTicker key (HK without the leading zero: '9988.HK'); security_ticker = universe ticker ('09988.HK'); join universe/issuer tables only on security_ticker/issuer_id.
 * upside_pct is a FRACTION (0.25 = 25 %): upside/1 = round(target_price / price_at_report − 1, 6), 6-decimal text; UI multiplies by 100. */
export interface TargetRow{
 report_id:string;target_key:string;basis:TargetBasis;ticker_as_stated:string;security_ticker:string|null;issuer_id:string|null;
 resolution:Record<string,unknown>;rating_raw:string|null;rating_normalized:NormalizedRating|null;scale_id:string|null;
 target_price:string|null;target_currency:string|null;target_horizon_months:number|null;
 price_at_report:string|null;price_currency:string|null;price_as_of_date:string|null;upside_pct:string|null;upside_formula_version:string|null;input_hash:string;
}
export interface FieldRow extends TypedValue{
 field_id:string;report_id:string;parse_run_id:string|null;run_id:string|null;superseded_by_run_id:string|null;target_key:string|null;
 field:FieldName;occurrence:number;page:number|null;char_start:number|null;char_end:number|null;value_source_text:string|null;
 extractor:string;extractor_confidence:number|null;status:FieldStatus;corrected:CorrectedValue|null;conflict_group:string|null;
 detail:Record<string,unknown>;reviewed_by:string|null;reviewed_at:string|null;created_at:string;
}
/** Candidate rows written by broker_extract_commit (field_id/report_id/timestamps assigned by the DB). */
export type CandidateFieldInput=Pick<FieldRow,'target_key'|'field'|'occurrence'|'value_text'|'value_num'|'value_currency'|'value_unit'|'value_date'|'page'|'char_start'|'char_end'|'value_source_text'|'extractor'|'extractor_confidence'|'conflict_group'|'detail'>&{status:'extracted'|'unverified';resolution?:Record<string,unknown>};
/** Human-added evidence row (broker_field_add). */
export type HumanFieldInput=Pick<FieldRow,'target_key'|'field'|'occurrence'|'page'|'char_start'|'char_end'|'value_source_text'>&TypedValue&{parse_run_id:string;status:'confirmed'|'absent'};
/** draft_reason: why an approved text fell back to draft (licence_version|analyst_disclosure|disclosure_inputs|summary_stale; spec §4.1/§4.9 detail.reason). */
export type DraftReason='licence_version'|'analyst_disclosure'|'disclosure_inputs'|'summary_stale';
export interface SnippetRow{snippet_id:string;report_id:string;target_key:string|null;purpose:SnippetPurpose;parse_run_id:string;page:number;char_start:number;char_end:number;text:string|null;field_id:string|null;status:TextStatus;disclosure_check:DisclosureCheck|null;draft_reason:DraftReason|null;approved_by:string|null;approved_at:string|null;created_by:string;created_at:string}
export interface SummaryRow{summary_id:string;report_id:string;lang:Lang;kind:'independent_summary';run_id:string;input_hash:string;summary_md:string;max_verbatim_overlap:number;numeric_grounding:GroundingResult;disclosure_check:DisclosureCheck;status:TextStatus;draft_reason:DraftReason|null;approved_by:string|null;approved_at:string|null;generated_at:string}
export interface PublicationRow{publication_id:string;report_id:string;revision:number;snapshot:Record<string,unknown>;snapshot_hash:string;licence_version:number;rules_receipt_id:string;eval_receipt_id:string|null;published_at:string;published_by:string;unpublished_at:string|null;unpublish_reason:string|null}
export interface RuleReceiptRow{receipt_id:string;report_id:string;rules_version:string;input_hash:string;results:RuleResult[];code_version:string;created_at:string}
export interface InstitutionRow{institution_id:string;name_en:string;name_zh:string|null;aliases:string[];kind:string|null;rating_disclosure_url:string|null;created_at:string}
export interface RatingScaleRow{scale_id:string;institution_id:string;raw_label:string;normalized:NormalizedRating;source_url:string;valid_from:string;valid_to:string|null;created_by:string;created_at:string;closed_by:string|null;closed_at:string|null}
export interface AnalystRow{analyst_id:string;institution_id:string;display_name:string;name_variants:string[];public_display:boolean;created_at:string}
export interface ReportAnalystRow{report_id:string;analyst_id:string;role:string|null;field_id:string}
export interface AccessLogInput{document_id:string|null;user_id:string;action:AccessAction;detail:Record<string,unknown>}
export interface EvalFieldStats{tp:number;fp:number;fn:number;precision:number|null;recall:number|null}
export interface EvalReceiptRow{
 receipt_id:string;corpus_kind:'gold'|'synthetic';corpus_hash:string;behavior_digest:string;extractor_version:string;model_id:string;registry_hash:string;
 prompt_version:string;schema_version:string;code_version:string;n_docs:number;per_field:Record<string,EvalFieldStats>;absence:{tp:number;fp:number;fn:number};
 precision_min:number|null;recall_min:number|null;passed:boolean;ran_at:string;ran_by:string;
}
export interface OutboxEvent{event_id:string;kind:OutboxKind;payload:Record<string,unknown>;status:'pending'|'delivered'|'failed';attempts:number;last_error:string|null;created_at:string;delivered_at:string|null}
/** Durable bucket-write inventory (broker_storage_writes; P-R5-01..03). path = object path, or a prefix ending in '/' for port-written objects. */
export type StorageWriter='parse'|'extract'|'summary'|'translate'|'eval'|'f3';
export interface StorageWriteRow{write_id:string;document_id:string;path:string;writer:StorageWriter;status:'pending'|'done'|'reconciled'|'abandoned';started_at:string;finished_at:string|null;reconciled_at:string|null;next_attempt_at:string;attempts:number;deleted_at:string|null}
export interface PurgeStepRow{document_id:string;step:PurgeStep;status:'pending'|'done'|'failed';attempts:number;last_error:string|null;at:string}

export interface MaterializeReceipt{effectiveHash:string;materializedHash:string;targets:number;basis:'candidate'|'effective'|'mixed'}
export interface RuleResult{rule:string;passed:boolean;blocking:boolean;target_key:string|null;reason_code:string|null;detail:Record<string,unknown>}
/** db_digest = broker_report_disclosure_digest at approval (stamped by the approval triggers; a supplied value must be current). */
export interface DisclosureCheck{version:string;inputs_hash:string;passed:boolean;db_digest?:string;hits:{kind:'restricted_value:target'|'restricted_name';token:string;target_key?:string;analyst_id?:string}[]}
export interface GroundingAssertion{sentence_idx:number;target_key:string;field:FieldName;value:string;unit:ValueUnit;field_id:string}
export interface GroundingResult{version:string;passed:boolean;assertions:GroundingAssertion[];failures:{sentence_idx:number;reason:string}[]}

/** Error raised by BrokerResearchDb implementations; `code` is the SQL `raise exception` message prefix (e.g. 'publish_blocked', 'published_immutable', 'lease_lost'). */
export class BrokerResearchDbError extends Error{
 constructor(readonly code:string,message?:string,readonly detail?:string){super(message??code);this.name='BrokerResearchDbError';}
}

export interface ReviewQueueOptions{status?:ReviewStatus;limit?:number}
/** issuerId / rating / securityTicker / currency are correlated on ONE target (target_facets); currency = target_currency only with a public target_price, else price_currency only with price_at_report, else null. */
export interface PublicReportFilter{institutionId?:string;issuerId?:string;rating?:NormalizedRating;securityTicker?:string;currency?:string|null;scope?:ReportScope;from?:string;to?:string;hasSummary?:boolean;limit:number;cursor?:{publishedDate:string;reportId:string}}
/** Steps of purgeReportText (the PDF / artifacts / runs steps are storage work, spec §6.5). */
export type PurgeTextStep=Extract<PurgeStep,'fields_text'|'snippets_text'|'summaries'|'quarantine_payload'>;
export type TitleSurface='title_original'|'title_public'|'title_zh'|'title_en';
export interface DisclosureRecheckInput{expected_digest:string;titles:Partial<Record<TitleSurface,DisclosureCheck>>;snippets:Record<string,DisclosureCheck>;summaries:Record<string,DisclosureCheck>}
export type QuarantineResolution='resolved_accept'|'resolved_reject';
/** Open dq_quarantine rows of the report's document, as shown on the review page (payload = values and pages only). */
export interface ReviewQuarantineItem{id:string;reason_code:string;natural_key:string;payload:Record<string,unknown>;created_at:string}
/** Body of ★ GET /api/admin/broker-research/reports/[reportId] (C6 builds it; D5 renders it). */
export interface ReviewPayload{
 report:ReportRow;document:DocumentRow;licence:LicenceRow;fields:FieldRow[];targets:TargetRow[];snippets:SnippetRow[];summaries:SummaryRow[];runs:RunRow[];
 blockers:string[];quarantine:ReviewQuarantineItem[];institutions:InstitutionRow[];analysts:AnalystRow[];reportAnalysts:ReportAnalystRow[];
}

export interface BrokerResearchDb{
 // settings & licences
 getSettings():Promise<SettingsRow>;
 setPublicEnabled(flag:boolean,by:string):Promise<void>;
 setApprovedGoldCorpus(hash:string|null,by:string):Promise<void>;                                   // approved_gold_corpus_hash/by/at (owner action, spec §4.1)
 listLicences():Promise<LicenceRow[]>;
 getLicence(licenceId:string):Promise<LicenceRow|null>;
 insertLicence(input:LicenceInput):Promise<LicenceRow>;
 updateLicence(licenceId:string,patch:Partial<LicenceInput>):Promise<LicenceRow>;      // trigger bumps version on material change
 confirmLicence(licenceId:string,by:string,version:number):Promise<'confirmed'|'version_mismatch'>;
 // intents & documents
 insertIntent(row:Omit<IntentRow,'created_at'|'checkpoint_at'|'error_code'>):Promise<void>;
 getIntent(intentId:string):Promise<IntentRow|null>;
 transitionIntent(intentId:string,from:IntentStatus,to:IntentStatus,patch?:Partial<Pick<IntentRow,'document_id'|'error_code'>>):Promise<boolean>;   // CAS; sets checkpoint_at
 findDocumentBySha(sha256:string):Promise<DocumentRow|null>;
 getDocument(documentId:string):Promise<DocumentRow|null>;
 insertDocument(row:Pick<DocumentRow,'document_id'|'sha256'|'storage_path'|'byte_size'|'licence_id'|'uploaded_by'|'original_filename'>):Promise<'inserted'|'duplicate'>;  // status='uploaded', promotion_pending=true
 withdrawWithIntent(documentId:string,reason:string,purge:boolean,by:string):Promise<void>; // atomic withdrawal + optional durable intent, before lease/steps
 updateDocument(documentId:string,patch:Partial<Pick<DocumentRow,'promotion_pending'|'status'|'withdrawn_at'|'withdrawn_reason'|'purged_at'|'purge_requested_at'|'purge_requested_by'|'page_count'|'last_verified_at'|'verify_status'>>):Promise<void>;
 claimLease(documentId:string,token:string,ttlSeconds:number):Promise<boolean>;                         // CAS
 renewLease(documentId:string,token:string,ttlSeconds:number):Promise<'ok'|'lease_lost'|'document_withdrawn'>;   // rpc broker_document_renew_lease: fenced re-check + TTL refresh before a long holder's bucket write (P-R3-04)
 fencedUpdateDocument(documentId:string,token:string,patch:Partial<Pick<DocumentRow,'status'|'current_parse_run_id'|'page_count'>>&{releaseLease?:boolean}):Promise<'ok'|'lease_lost'>;
 // runs
 insertRun(row:Omit<RunRow,'started_at'|'finished_at'|'status'|'detail'>&{detail?:Record<string,unknown>}):Promise<void>;
 finishRun(runId:string,token:string,patch:Pick<RunRow,'status'>&Partial<Pick<RunRow,'extractor_version'|'artifact_path'|'artifact_hash'|'request_path'|'response_path'|'detail'>>):Promise<'ok'|'lease_lost'>;   // rpc broker_run_finish; extractor_version only while null (parse runs learn it from F3)
 getRun(runId:string):Promise<RunRow|null>;
 listRuns(documentId:string):Promise<RunRow[]>;
 // reports & evidence
 ensureReport(documentId:string,codeVersion:string):Promise<ReportRow>;
 getReport(reportId:string):Promise<ReportRow|null>;
 reportByDocument(documentId:string):Promise<ReportRow|null>;
 listReports(opts:{institutionId:string}):Promise<ReportRow[]>;                                    // every status; R7 peers
 updateReportDraft(reportId:string,patch:Partial<Pick<ReportRow,'scope'|'institution_id'|'report_type'|'primary_target_key'|'supersedes_report_id'|'title_public'|'title_public_by'|'title_zh'|'title_en'|'title_run_id'|'review_status'|'disclosure_ok'|'evidence_ok'>>):Promise<void>;
 setReportFlags(reportId:string,flags:{evidence_ok?:boolean;disclosure_ok?:boolean}):Promise<void>;   // draft or published (reports_guard k_live); verify cron, restore
 extractCommit(documentId:string,leaseToken:string,runId:string,rows:CandidateFieldInput[]):Promise<MaterializeReceipt>;   // rpc broker_extract_commit
 fieldReview(fieldId:string,action:FieldAction,payload:Record<string,unknown>,by:string):Promise<MaterializeReceipt>;    // rpc broker_field_review; payload snake_case: confirm {page?,char_start?,char_end?,value_source_text?,detail?} · correct {value_text,value_num?,value_currency?,value_unit?,value_date?,page?,char_start?,char_end?,value_source_text?,detail?} · reject {detail?} · absent {page?,detail?}; payload.detail (object) is merged into the row's detail (e.g. {framed:true})
 insertHumanField(reportId:string,row:HumanFieldInput,by:string):Promise<{fieldId:string;receipt:MaterializeReceipt}>;  // rpc broker_field_add
 upsertTargetOverride(row:{report_id:string;target_key:string;security_ticker:string;issuer_id:string|null;set_by:string;note:string|null}):Promise<MaterializeReceipt>;  // rpc broker_target_override
 materialize(reportId:string):Promise<MaterializeReceipt>;                                                                // rpc broker_report_materialize
 listFields(reportId:string,opts?:{includeSuperseded?:boolean}):Promise<FieldRow[]>;
 listTargets(reportId:string):Promise<TargetRow[]>;
 bindAnalyst(row:ReportAnalystRow):Promise<void>;
 listReportAnalysts(reportId:string):Promise<ReportAnalystRow[]>;
 insertRuleReceipt(row:Omit<RuleReceiptRow,'receipt_id'|'created_at'>):Promise<string>;
 // snippets & summaries
 insertSnippet(row:Omit<SnippetRow,'snippet_id'|'created_at'|'approved_by'|'approved_at'|'status'|'draft_reason'>&{status?:'draft'}):Promise<string>;
 setSnippetStatus(snippetId:string,patch:{status:TextStatus;disclosure_check?:DisclosureCheck;approved_by?:string|null}):Promise<void>;
 getSnippet(snippetId:string):Promise<SnippetRow|null>;
 listSnippets(reportId:string):Promise<SnippetRow[]>;
 /** rpc broker_summary_commit: lease fence + insert (status draft|rejected) + finish the run succeeded, one transaction; lost lease → BrokerResearchDbError('lease_lost'), nothing written (P-R1-09). */
 summaryCommit(documentId:string,token:string,runId:string,row:Omit<SummaryRow,'summary_id'|'approved_by'|'approved_at'|'generated_at'|'draft_reason'|'run_id'|'kind'>):Promise<string>;
 /** rpc broker_title_commit: lease fence + title_zh/title_en/title_run_id on the draft report + finish the run, one transaction. */
 titleCommit(documentId:string,token:string,runId:string,titles:{title_zh:string|null;title_en:string|null}):Promise<'ok'>;
 /** rpc broker_extract_set_scope: under the lease, scope := the merged scope if the draft has none, then materialize (P-R2-04). */
 extractSetScope(documentId:string,token:string,runId:string,scope:ReportScope):Promise<MaterializeReceipt>;
 /** rpc broker_extract_finalize: under the lease, finish the extract run succeeded (detail merged) and release the lease, one transaction. */
 extractFinalize(documentId:string,token:string,runId:string,detail:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<'ok'>;
 insertSummary(row:Omit<SummaryRow,'summary_id'|'approved_by'|'approved_at'|'generated_at'|'draft_reason'>):Promise<string>;
 setSummaryStatus(summaryId:string,patch:{status:TextStatus;disclosure_check?:DisclosureCheck;approved_by?:string|null}):Promise<void>;
 getSummary(summaryId:string):Promise<SummaryRow|null>;
 listSummaries(reportId:string):Promise<SummaryRow[]>;
 // publish
 publishBlockers(reportId:string):Promise<string[]>;
 disclosureDigest(reportId:string):Promise<string>;
 /** rpc broker_report_disclosure_recheck (spec §4.11 重跑规则; P-R1-08): verifies expected_digest is current, applies the title policy, checks APPROVED snippets/summaries only, restores disclosure_ok=true; failures change nothing. */
 disclosureRecheck(reportId:string,by:string,checks:DisclosureRecheckInput):Promise<{restored:boolean;failures:string[]}>;                                               // rpc broker_report_disclosure_digest (P-R1-04)
 publish(reportId:string,by:string):Promise<{publicationId:string}>;
 unpublish(reportId:string,by:string,reason:string):Promise<void>;
 getPublication(publicationId:string):Promise<PublicationRow|null>;
 // entities
 upsertInstitution(row:Omit<InstitutionRow,'institution_id'|'created_at'>&{institution_id?:string}):Promise<string>;
 listInstitutions():Promise<InstitutionRow[]>;
 insertRatingScale(row:Omit<RatingScaleRow,'scale_id'|'created_at'|'closed_by'|'closed_at'|'valid_to'>):Promise<string>;
 closeRatingScale(scaleId:string,validTo:string,by:string):Promise<void>;
 listRatingScales(institutionId:string):Promise<RatingScaleRow[]>;
 upsertAnalyst(row:Omit<AnalystRow,'analyst_id'|'created_at'>&{analyst_id?:string}):Promise<string>;
 listAnalysts(institutionId:string):Promise<AnalystRow[]>;
 // logs, receipts, outbox, purge
 reviewQueue(opts:ReviewQueueOptions):Promise<ReportRow[]>;
 logAccess(row:AccessLogInput):Promise<void>;
 listAccessLog(opts:{documentId?:string;limit:number}):Promise<(AccessLogInput&{id:string;created_at:string})[]>;
 insertEvalReceipt(row:Omit<EvalReceiptRow,'receipt_id'|'ran_at'>):Promise<string>;
 latestEvalReceipt(behaviorDigest:string):Promise<EvalReceiptRow|null>;
 takePendingOutbox(limit:number):Promise<OutboxEvent[]>;
 markOutbox(eventId:string,outcome:{delivered:true}|{delivered:false;error:string}):Promise<void>;   // attempts+1; ≥10 failures → 'failed'
 upsertPurgeStep(documentId:string,step:PurgeStep,outcome:{ok:true}|{ok:false;error:string}):Promise<void>;
 purgeSteps(documentId:string):Promise<PurgeStepRow[]>;
 purgeReportText(reportId:string,step:PurgeTextStep):Promise<number>;   // report must be withdrawn (else report_not_withdrawn); fields_text: value_source_text=null+status rejected · snippets_text: text=null+status rejected · summaries: status rejected (O11: text kept) · quarantine_payload: payload={} on the document's broker_research items; returns rows changed
 // quarantine hook (rpc broker_quarantine_resolve; spec §7.3)
 quarantineResolve(id:string,status:QuarantineResolution,by:string,payload:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<'resolved'|'not_found'|'already_resolved'>;
 // verify cron (spec §8.3): documents of published reports, last_verified_at asc, never-verified first
 verifyCandidates(limit:number):Promise<DocumentRow[]>;
 // bucket-write inventory (P-R5-01..03): registered BEFORE bytes are sent; started_at = server now()
 registerWrite(row:{document_id:string;path:string;writer:StorageWriter}):Promise<string>;               // write_id
 abandonWrite(writeId:string):Promise<void>; // pending → abandoned only with worker proof no bytes dispatched; finished_at stays null
 finishWrite(writeId:string):Promise<void>;                                                              // pending → done (finished_at = now); other states untouched
 writesFor(documentId:string):Promise<StorageWriteRow[]>;                                                 // every row of the document (purge deletes every path)
 pendingWritesFor(documentId:string):Promise<StorageWriteRow[]>;                                          // status pending, started_at asc
 /** Purge intent only, status <> reconciled, next_attempt_at <= now; ordered next_attempt_at, write_id. No age cutoff. */
 unreconciledWrites(limit:number):Promise<StorageWriteRow[]>;
 retryWrite(writeId:string,nextAttemptAt:string,attempts:number):Promise<void>;
 markReconciled(writeId:string,deletedAt:string):Promise<void>;                                                           // only done with finished_at <= deletion-completion timestamp; pending remains eligible
 // public (anon client, views only)
 publicReports(filter:PublicReportFilter):Promise<PublicReportBundle[]>;
 spreadReports(filter:{issuerId:string;securityTicker:string;currency:string|null;from:string}):Promise<PublicReportBundle[]>;
 publicReport(reportId:string):Promise<PublicReportDetail|null>;
 publicInstitutions():Promise<Record<string,unknown>[]>;                                          // + report_count, last_published_date, last_available_at
 publicAnalysts(opts:{institutionId:string;limit:number}):Promise<Record<string,unknown>[]>;        // distinct public analysts of the institution: {analyst_id,display_name,institution_id,report_count}
 ratingHistory(opts:{securityTicker:string;institutionId?:string;currency?:string;limit:number}):Promise<Record<string,unknown>[]>;
}
/** Rows read from the public views (column names as in spec §4.11). */
export interface PublicReportBundle{report:Record<string,unknown>;targets:Record<string,unknown>[];hasSummary:{zh:boolean;en:boolean};snippetCount:number;institution:Record<string,unknown>|null}
export interface PublicReportDetail extends PublicReportBundle{citations:Record<string,unknown>[];snippets:Record<string,unknown>[];summaries:Record<string,unknown>[];analysts:Record<string,unknown>[]}

// BrokerDeps / CoreDeps (the injected service dependencies) live in ./deps.ts (C1 creates CoreDeps; C4 adds the
// ports and BrokerDeps), so this file imports nothing and typechecks on its own at A4.
```

**契约补充**

- **规范化 JSON 与哈希**（`hash.ts`，A4）：`canonicalJson(v)` = 键按 UTF-16 码元排序、无空白、数组保序、数值一律以十进制字符串出现（证据行的 `value_num` 本来就是字符串）；`sha256Hex(s)` = UTF-8 字节的 sha256 hex。SQL 端 `effective_hash` 等由 `broker_report_materialize` 用 `encode(sha256(convert_to(<jsonb>::text,'UTF8')),'hex')` 计算——**jsonb 的文本形式与 `canonicalJson` 不同**，因此**哈希只在 SQL 端计算与比较**；TS 端从不重算 `effective_hash/rules_input_hash/summary_input_digest`，只读取并原样比较（规则回执 `input_hash` = 读到的 `rules_input_hash`）。`canonicalJson` 只用于 TS 自己产生的哈希（`behavior_digest`、`disclosure_check.inputs_hash`、`snapshot_hash` 不在 TS 算——发布快照哈希也在 SQL 端）。
- **生效值选择器**：TS `effectiveValue(row:FieldRow):TypedValue`（`effective.ts`）与 SQL 内联表达式同规则：对每个分量 k，`row.corrected` 有键 k → 取该值（可为 null），否则取 `row.value_k`。A2 的函数 `broker_field_effective` 与 A3 视图内联 `case` 都实现同一规则；A5 的 pg 契约用例断言三者一致。
- **数值**：证据行与 targets 的 `numeric` 列在 TS 侧一律是十进制字符串（`value_num:string|null`）；pg/supabase 实现把 `numeric` 读成字符串（PostgREST 默认返回 JSON number——supabase 实现在 select 时用 `value_num::text` 别名，或在 rpc 返回 jsonb 时以 `to_jsonb(x::text)` 输出；A4 定）。规则与检查的数值比较用 `src/lib/facts/json-numbers.ts` 的 `canonicalDecimal/decimalEquals`（只 import）与 BigInt 定标运算，**不经 `Number`**（空间恒等容差 0.005 与 1 位小数四舍五入也用定标整数）。
- **RPC 错误**：SQL `raise exception '<code>[:<detail>]'`；三实现都把它映射为 `BrokerResearchDbError(code, message, detail)`（code = 第一个冒号前的串）。路由（C1 `toErrorResponse` / `DB_ERROR_STATUS`）把 `publish_blocked` → `409 {error:{code:'publish_blocked',reasons:[…]}}`（原因 = detail 按逗号拆分），`published_immutable` → 409，`lease_lost` → 409，`version_mismatch` → 409，`hook_params_required` → 400。
- **租约**：TTL 300 s；`claimLease` 返回 false → `409 lease_held`；收尾一律 `fencedUpdateDocument(..., {releaseLease:true})`。`extractCommit` 在 SQL 内校验 `lease_token` 相等且 `lease_until > now()`。
- **outbox**：`claim.register` / `claim.retract` 由 SQL 函数（`broker_report_publish` / `broker_report_unpublish` / 文档撤回触发器 / `disclosure_ok` 或 `evidence_ok` 置 false 的触发器）写入；`licence.changed` 由许可 after update 触发器写入。唯一索引 `(payload->>'claim_key', payload->>'claim_seq')` 部分索引（`kind in ('claim.register','claim.retract')`）。TS 只负责投递（E1）。
- **隔离键**：`naturalKey = ${sha256}:${rule}:${target_key ?? '-'}`，`dataset='broker_research'`，`table='broker_research_reports'`，`payload` 只含值与页码，不含跨度文本。
- **批次**：`producer` ∈ `broker-research-parse` / `broker-research-extract` / `broker-research-review`（复核动作触发的规则与隔离）/ `broker-research-summary`（摘要与标题翻译）/ `broker-research-verify`；`INFO_CODES` 只追加 `eval_receipt_absent`（C6，一次）；`f3_unavailable`、`llm_unavailable`、`extract_deadline`、`llm_failed`、`storage_failed`、`rules_error`、`document_insert_lost`、`span_drift`、`artifact_unreadable`、`verify_error` 都是非信息码（使批次 `partial`/`failed`），登记在规格 §17 记录里；`dataset='broker_research'`；计数规则见规格 §6.2。只有核验 cron 调 `recordAttempt`（`cadence:'daily'`）。

## 跨部分约定（各 Part 已按此对齐；执行任何任务前必读）

1. **顺序与依赖**：A1–A5 → B1–B5 → C1–C8 → D1–D6 → E1–E2。B 直接 `import type … from '../types'`（无本地别名）；`versions.ts` 由 A2 建。
2. **依赖注入**：`types.ts` 不 import 任何文件。`CoreDeps`（db、storage、tables、now、codeVersion、newId）与 `coreDeps()` 在 C1 的 `deps.ts`；C4 在同一文件追加 `BrokerDeps extends CoreDeps{f3;llm}`、`brokerDeps()`、`deadlineFrom()`。服务 `import type {BrokerDeps} from './deps'`。
3. **客户端**：`supabaseBrokerResearchDb({anon:getAnonSupabase()})` 只用于公开读（D1–D3），`{admin:getAdminSupabase()}` 用于管理员路由、服务与 cron；用错抛 `anon_client_required` / `admin_client_required`。单测用 `memoryBrokerResearchDb({tables,now})`（扩展成员只有 `tables`、`setNow`、`expireLease`、`outbox()`），集成测试用 `pgBrokerResearchDb(pool)`。
4. **标题披露结果在规则回执里**（拒绝"发布函数接收标题检查"的方案）：`rules-run.ts::applyRules`（C5）在 `evaluateRules` 结果之后，对每个非空标题面（`title_original`、`title_public`、`title_zh`、`title_en`）各追加一条 `{rule:'disclosure',passed,blocking:false,target_key:null,reason_code:passed?null:'restricted_value'|'restricted_name',detail:{surface,hits}}`；输入 = 许可的 `allows_public_target_price`、物化后的 targets、**报告绑定的**分析师（`listReportAnalysts` → `listAnalysts`）。阻断第 15 条读与当前 `rules_input_hash` 匹配的最新回执；`broker_report_publish` 写 `title_restricted := title_original 的结果不是 passed`。`publish(reportId,by)` 签名不变；C6 发布前不做 TS 预检，只做 物化 → `applyRules` → 发布。
5. **物化 + 规则**：规则回执的 `input_hash` = 读到的 `rules_input_hash`（TS 不重算）。改 `institution_id / scope / title_* / supersedes_report_id`、绑定分析师、覆盖映射、复核动作之后，服务先 `materialize` 再 `applyRules`；否则阻断 `materialize_stale` / `rules_stale`。
6. **`upside_pct` 是小数**：`upside/1 = round(target_price / price_at_report − 1, 6)`（SQL `round(numeric,6)`、内存 `upside1` BigInt、6 位小数文本）。R2、披露检查按小数比较；只有 D 的展示格式化 ×100（十进制字符串移位，不经浮点）。
7. **`target_key` vs `security_ticker`**：`target_key` 是 `parseBrokerTicker` 键（`9988.HK`，HK 去前导零补足 4 位），只用于报告内身份与隔离键；`security_ticker` 是宇宙代码（`09988.HK`）。与 `stocks_universe` / 发行人 / `/stock/[ticker]` / 历史视图的一切关联只用 `security_ticker` 或 `issuer_id`。
8. **复核载荷**（`broker_field_review`，snake_case）：`confirm {page?,char_start?,char_end?,value_source_text?,detail?}`（带跨度 = 框选确认，C6 先在 TS 校验逐字，再写 `detail:{framed:true}`；回放据此豁免 `candidate_missing`）· `correct {value_text,value_num?,…,page?,char_start?,char_end?,value_source_text?,detail?}` · `reject {detail?}` · `absent {page?,detail?}`（原行 `rejected` + 同身份插入人工 `absent` 行）。`payload.detail` 必须是对象，合并进行的 `detail`。无候选行时 `markAbsent` 用 `insertHumanField(status:'absent')`。HTTP 请求体是 C 路由自己的 camelCase 字段（见 Part C 末尾「管理员路由一览（C 定稿）」），由路由映射为上述 snake_case。
9. **评测阻断只认 `gold`**：没有任何会话 GUC 旁路。C8 pipeline 测试在测试库插入 `gold` 回执（`n_docs ≥ 30`、覆盖所用字段）并 `setApprovedGoldCorpus(hash,by)`，断言前后 `eval_receipt_missing` 的出现与消失。
10. **测试库全局状态**：见仓库约定「测试库全局状态隔离」（会话级 `pg_advisory_lock(hashtext('broker_research_settings'))`）。
11. **解析运行的 `extractor_version`**：`insertRun(kind:'parse',extractor_version:null)` 合法；F3 返回后 `finishRun(...,{status:'succeeded',extractor_version,artifact_path,artifact_hash})` 补写（只在为空时，不同值 → `extractor_version_immutable`）；成功的解析运行必须有值。抽取 / 回放 / 评测读 `run.extractor_version`。
12. **评级映射键与阻断集合**：比较键 `lower(btrim(raw_label))`（SQL 唯一索引、物化选择、隔离钩子）= B4 `ratingKey`（只去两端空格 + 小写）= 内存实现；B4 测试读 A2 迁移文本断言该表达式。阻断第 10 条的原因集合：SQL 字面量 = `memory-db.ts::BLOCKING_QUARANTINE_REASONS` = B4 `BLOCKING_REASONS`（B4 测试三方比较）。
13. **清除文本**：`purgeReportText(reportId,step)` 只在报告 `withdrawn` 时可用（否则 `report_not_withdrawn`）；`fields_text` 同时清 `corrected`；`summaries` 只置 `rejected`（O11：文本保留）；`quarantine_payload` 置本文档隔离项 `payload={}`。C7 的清除步骤表只经此方法与存储端口，不直写表。
14. **页文本**：`PageText` / `sliceText(pages,page,start,end)` 只在 `extract/locate.ts`（B1）定义；F3 产物类型是 `ports/f3.ts::F3Artifact`（`pages:F3Page[]` 与 `PageText` 同形），`ports/f3.ts` 不导出切片函数。R1、复核框选、回放、核验 cron 一律 `sliceText(artifact.pages,…)`。`extract/schema.ts::DocumentExtraction` 是 LLM 抽取形状，与 F3 产物无关。
15. **复核数据**：★ `GET /api/admin/broker-research/reports/[reportId]` 返回契约 `ReviewPayload`；D5 直接用该类型。
16. **新增的视图列**（A3）：`broker_reports_public_v.rules_version`、`.title_model_id`、过滤列 `.target_facets`（jsonb：每个标的一个 `{issuer_id,rating}`，发行人 + 评级组合筛选在同一元素上做 `@>`；P-R4-02）、`.has_summary`（列表筛选在库内与键集游标一起执行，不在客户端收集 id；P-R3-05）；`broker_report_summaries_public_v.grounding_assertions`（无 `field_id`）；`research_institutions_public_v.report_count`、`.last_published_date`、`.last_available_at`（只列有可见报告的机构）；`broker_report_citations_v.field_id`（片段与引用按 `field_id` 关联）。
17. **金额是十进制字符串**：outbox 载荷（`claim.target_price`、`reference_price`）与发布快照里的金额一律字符串；E1 投递不经 `Number()`。
18. **回草稿原因**：`SnippetRow.draft_reason` / `SummaryRow.draft_reason`（`licence_version|analyst_disclosure|disclosure_inputs|summary_stale`），D4/D5 的"受影响片段 / 摘要"计数读它。
19. **`deps.tables` 的用途**：服务只用它读写计划一的表（`dq_quarantine`、`ingest_batches`、`research_audit_log`）；本模块表的写入一律经 `BrokerResearchDb`。唯一例外是 D4 `admin-read.ts` 的总览计数与许可影响面：service-role 只读本模块表做聚合（契约没有计数方法），不写。
20. **披露输入摘要与批准绑定**（P-R1-04）：`broker_report_disclosure_digest(report)`（契约 `disclosureDigest`）覆盖许可版本 + `allows_public_target_price`、物化 targets 的 `target_price/upside_pct`、绑定分析师的披露字段。批准片段 / 摘要时，服务先读摘要值再算 `checkDisclosure`，提交 `disclosure_check.db_digest`；批准触发器拒绝过期值（`disclosure_inputs_changed` → 409），未提供时写入当前值。任何 `broker_report_analysts` 增删改都把该报告的已批准文本回 `draft`（`analyst_disclosure`）。
21. **重跑披露检查**（P-R1-08，规格 §4.11）：`POST /api/admin/broker-research/reports/[reportId]/disclosure-recheck` → C6 `recheckDisclosure` → `db.disclosureRecheck`（SQL `broker_report_disclosure_recheck`）；复核页在 `disclosure_ok=false` 时显示该操作与失败项。
22. **LLM 结果的围栏提交**（P-R1-09）：摘要 / 标题翻译经 `summaryCommit` / `titleCommit` 写入并收尾运行（同一事务、租约围栏），之后才释放租约；`insertSummary` 只留给测试夹具。
23. **回放只读快照**（P-R1-10）：发布快照的每个证据行带 `value_source_text`、`value_source_sha256`、`framed`、`extracted`；`replay.ts` 不读活的证据行。
24. **函数权限**（P-R1-05）：A1、A2 迁移末尾的 `do` 块对所有 `public.broker_%` 函数（含触发器函数）`revoke execute … from public, anon, authenticated`；新增函数一律以 `broker_` 开头。
25. **子表写入的锁顺序**（P-R1-03）：子表守卫先 `select … for update` 父报告行，再判断状态（与 `broker_lock_draft` / `broker_report_publish` 同序：报告 → 子表）。

## Part A — FR-0：迁移、函数、视图、契约

Part A 的设计决定（后续 Part 依赖，执行者不得自行改动）：

- **哈希只在 SQL 端算。** `broker_sha256(text)` = `encode(sha256(convert_to(t,'UTF8')),'hex')`。`broker_report_live_digests(report_id)` 根据当前活表**实时**重算 `effective_hash / rules_input_hash / summary_input_digest`；`broker_report_materialize` 把三者写进报告行；`broker_report_publish_blockers` 第 11 条 `materialize_stale` = 已存的三个值与实时重算值任一不等（或 `materialized_hash` 为空）。所以 `updateReportDraft` 改了 `institution_id / scope / title_* / supersedes_report_id` 之后、没有重新物化 + 重跑规则就不能发布。规格 §4.4 第 11 条原文（`materialized_hash <> effective_hash`）在两列同时由物化写入时恒为假；这里按其意图实施，记入规格 §17。
- **规则输入**（`rules_input_hash` 的 jsonb）包括：`rules_version='broker-rules/1'`、生效行（含生效值）、物化后的 targets（含 `resolution`，不含 `input_hash`）、覆盖行、选中的映射行、`institution_id`、`scope`、`published_date`、文档 `uploaded_at`、四个标题面、`supersedes_report_id`，以及披露输入（`allows_public_target_price`、许可 `version`、已绑定分析师的 `public_display/display_name/name_variants`）。
- **标题披露检查结果放在规则回执里**（无需新增列）：B4/C6 跑规则时，对每个非空标题面（`title_original`、`title_public`、`title_zh`、`title_en`）各写一条 `RuleResult{rule:'disclosure', passed, blocking:false, target_key:null, reason_code: passed?null:'restricted_value', detail:{surface:'<面名>', hits}}`。阻断第 15 条读与当前 `rules_input_hash` 匹配的最新回执：某非空标题面没有结果或 `passed=false` → `restricted_value_in_text:<面名>`（`title_original` 只在 `title_public` 为空时阻断）。发布函数写 `title_restricted := title_original 的结果不是 passed`。片段 / 摘要的披露检查仍在各自 `disclosure_check` 列，由批准触发器校验。
- **`upside/1` 定义**：`upside_pct = round(target_price / price_at_report − 1, 6)`（小数，不是百分数；PostgreSQL `round(numeric,6)` 半数远离零；文本恒 6 位小数，如 `0.200000`），仅当两个值都有、两币种相等且 `price_at_report <> 0`。内存实现用 BigInt 实现同一规则。B4 的 R2 与 B5 的披露检查都以此为准。
- **新增的基础 RPC**（不改 TS 契约，只是实现内部）：`broker_document_claim_lease`、`broker_document_fenced_update`、`broker_run_finish`、`broker_outbox_mark`、`broker_purge_step_record`（需要服务器时间或读改写原子性）。
- **片段 / 摘要回草稿的原因**：两表各加一列 `draft_reason text null`（`licence_version` / `analyst_disclosure` / `summary_stale` / `disclosure_inputs`），对应规格 §4.1、§4.9 的 `detail.reason`（这两张表没有 `detail` 列）。契约 `SnippetRow` / `SummaryRow` 已含 `draft_reason:DraftReason|null`（摘要表的 check 不含 `disclosure_inputs`：只有片段会因披露输入变化回草稿）。
- **取消发布**：`status='draft'`、`revision+1`、`current_publication_id=null`、`review_status='in_review'`（重新编辑后必须重新复核；规格没写，记入 §17）。
- **撤回与 outbox**：报告的 after-update 触发器统一处理 `claim.retract`：旧状态是 `published`，并且（状态离开 `published`，或 `disclosure_ok` / `evidence_ok` 从 true 变 false）→ 对旧 `current_publication_id` 下的每条 `claim.register` 各写一条 retract（`on conflict do nothing`，同一 `claim_key` 只有一次）。
- **金额在 JSON 里一律是十进制字符串**（outbox `claim.target_price/reference_price`、快照）。
- **解析运行的 `extractor_version`**：插入时可为空（F3 返回后才知道），`broker_run_finish` 补写一次（只在为空时；不同值 → `extractor_version_immutable`）；约束 `broker_runs_parse_extractor` 只要求 `succeeded` 的解析运行有值。
- **`broker_field_review` 载荷的 `detail`**（对象）合并进该行 `detail`（框选确认写 `{framed:true}`，回放据此豁免）。
- **评级映射比较键**：`lower(btrim(raw_label))`（唯一索引、物化选行、隔离钩子 `on conflict`、内存实现、B4 `ratingKey` 一致）。阻断第 10 条的原因集合 = `memory-db.ts::BLOCKING_QUARANTINE_REASONS` = B4 `BLOCKING_REASONS`（B4 测试断言三者相等）。
- **视图补充列**：`broker_reports_public_v.rules_version / title_model_id`、`broker_report_summaries_public_v.grounding_assertions`（去掉 `field_id`）、`research_institutions_public_v.report_count / last_published_date / last_available_at`。
- **集成测试的设置行隔离**：凡读默认值或切换 `public_enabled` / 黄金集哈希的 describe，在 beforeAll 取会话级 `pg_advisory_lock(hashtext('broker_research_settings'))`（`lockSettings(pool)`），afterAll 复原并释放；C8 的 `pipeline.integration.test.ts` 用同一把锁。

创建 `src/lib/broker-research/broker-research.integration.test.ts`。文件顶部的辅助函数被 A2/A3/A5 复用（后续任务只追加 `describe` 块，以及块内自己的辅助函数）。种子数据刻意满足 A2 的批准触发器（片段长度 ≤ N、`disclosure_check.passed`、摘要 `input_hash` = 报告 `summary_input_digest`），这样 A2/A3 落地后块 1 仍然绿。

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/broker-research.integration.test.ts
// Foreign broker research on real PostgreSQL (spec §4, §6.3, §6.5, §7.3, §10.2, §12.2): block 1 (A1)
// tables, constraints, bucket, grants and table-level triggers; block 2 (A2) SQL functions and
// function-backed triggers; block 3 (A3) public views under the real anon/authenticated roles;
// block 4 (A5) the pgBrokerResearchDb contract. Rows are never cleaned up: test:db builds a fresh
// database per run and every test seeds its own licence/document/report.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {createHash,randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {Pool} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
const M1='supabase/migrations/20261117090000_broker_research.sql';
const TABLES=['broker_research_settings','broker_report_licences','broker_report_upload_intents','broker_report_documents','broker_report_runs','broker_research_reports','broker_report_targets','broker_report_target_overrides','broker_report_fields','broker_report_snippets','broker_report_summaries','broker_report_publications','broker_report_rule_receipts','broker_purge_steps','research_institutions','research_rating_scales','research_analysts','broker_report_analysts','broker_report_access_log','broker_eval_receipts','broker_outbox','broker_storage_writes'];

// Same replay policy as facts.integration.test.ts (not exported there).
const RETRYABLE=new Set(['55P03','40P01']);
async function replayMigration(pool:Pool,sql:string,attempts=10):Promise<void>{
 for(let attempt=1;;attempt++){
  const c=await pool.connect();
  try{await c.query(`begin; set local lock_timeout='3s';\n${sql}\n;commit;`);return;}
  catch(e){
   await c.query('rollback').catch(()=>{});
   const code=(e as {code?:string}).code;
   if(attempt>=attempts||!code||!RETRYABLE.has(code))throw e;
   await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250*attempt+Math.floor(Math.random()*250)));
  }finally{c.release();}
 }
}
/** broker_research_settings is one global row (public_enabled, approved_gold_corpus_hash). Every describe that reads its
 * defaults or toggles it holds this session-level advisory lock from beforeAll to afterAll (pipeline.integration.test.ts
 * does the same), so parallel test files never interleave. The release restores the defaults, then unlocks. */
async function lockSettings(pool:Pool):Promise<()=>Promise<void>>{
 const c=await pool.connect();
 await c.query(`select pg_advisory_lock(hashtext('broker_research_settings'))`);
 return async()=>{
  try{await c.query(`update public.broker_research_settings set public_enabled=false,approved_gold_corpus_hash=null,approved_gold_corpus_by=null,approved_gold_corpus_at=null where id=1`);}
  finally{await c.query(`select pg_advisory_unlock(hashtext('broker_research_settings'))`).catch(()=>{});c.release();}
 };
}
type PgErr={message:string;code?:string};
const fails=(p:Promise<unknown>)=>p.then(()=>{throw new Error('expected rejection');},e=>e as PgErr);
const sha=(s:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');
const PASS={version:'disclosure/1',inputs_hash:'0'.repeat(64),passed:true,hits:[]};

/** Seed helpers over the admin (superuser) pool: plain table writes, valid under every block's triggers. */
function seeds(pool:Pool){
 const q=async(text:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>(await pool.query(text,values)).rows as Record<string,any>[];
 const one=async(text:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>(await q(text,values))[0]?.v;
 const user=()=>randomUUID();
 const licence=async(o:Record<string,unknown>={},confirm=true)=>{
  const cols:Record<string,unknown>={source_label:'Test terminal',licence_kind:'terminal_subscription',holder:'Owner',terms_summary:'test terms',allows_llm_processing:true,allows_public_metadata:true,allows_public_snippets:true,allows_public_summary:true,allows_public_target_price:true,snippet_max_chars:200,valid_from:'2020-01-01',...o};
  const k=Object.keys(cols);
  const id=await one(`insert into public.broker_report_licences(${k.join(',')}) values(${k.map((_,i)=>`$${i+1}`).join(',')}) returning licence_id as v`,k.map(c=>cols[c]));
  if(typeof id!=='string'||!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(id))throw new Error(`seed licence: expected uuid, got ${String(id)}`);
  if(confirm)await q(`update public.broker_report_licences set confirmed_by=$2,confirmed_at=now(),confirmed_version=version where licence_id=$1`,[id,user()]);
  return id as string;
 };
 const document=async(licenceId:string,o:{sha?:string;uploadedAt?:string}={})=>{
  const s=o.sha??sha(randomUUID());
  return await one(`insert into public.broker_report_documents(document_id,sha256,storage_path,byte_size,licence_id,uploaded_by,uploaded_at,original_filename) values(gen_random_uuid(),$1,'reports/'||$1||'.pdf',1024,$2,$3,coalesce($4::timestamptz,now()),'r.pdf') returning document_id as v`,[s,licenceId,user(),o.uploadedAt??null]) as string;
 };
 /** A succeeded parse run made current: uploaded → parsing → parsed. */
 const parsed=async(documentId:string)=>{
  const run=randomUUID();const s=(await q(`select sha256 from public.broker_report_documents where document_id=$1`,[documentId]))[0].sha256;
  await q(`insert into public.broker_report_runs(run_id,document_id,kind,extractor_version,code_version,licence_version) values($1,$2,'parse','f3/1','test',1)`,[run,documentId]);
  await q(`update public.broker_report_runs set status='succeeded',artifact_path=$2,artifact_hash=$3 where run_id=$1`,[run,`reports/${s}.extract.${run}.json`,sha(run)]);
  await q(`update public.broker_report_documents set status='parsing' where document_id=$1`,[documentId]);
  await q(`update public.broker_report_documents set status='parsed',current_parse_run_id=$2,page_count=10 where document_id=$1`,[documentId,run]);
  return run;
 };
 const extractRun=async(documentId:string,parseRun:string,digest=sha('behavior'))=>{
  const run=randomUUID();
  await q(`insert into public.broker_report_runs(run_id,document_id,kind,parse_run_id,model_id,registry_hash,prompt_version,schema_version,code_version,behavior_digest,licence_version) values($1,$2,'extract',$3,'m-test','r'||repeat('0',63),'broker-extract/1','extract-schema/1','test',$4,1)`,[run,documentId,parseRun,digest]);
  return run;
 };
 const report=async(documentId:string)=>await one(`insert into public.broker_research_reports(document_id,code_version) values($1,'test') returning report_id as v`,[documentId]) as string;
 /** A human 'confirmed' evidence row with a span (valid under every constraint). */
 const field=async(reportId:string,parseRun:string,o:Record<string,unknown>)=>{
  const cols:Record<string,unknown>={report_id:reportId,parse_run_id:parseRun,field:'title',occurrence:1,value_text:'Title',page:1,char_start:0,char_end:5,value_source_text:'Title',extractor:`human:${randomUUID()}`,status:'confirmed',...o};
  const k=Object.keys(cols);
  return await one(`insert into public.broker_report_fields(${k.join(',')}) values(${k.map((_,i)=>`$${i+1}`).join(',')}) returning field_id as v`,k.map(c=>{const v=cols[c];return v!==null&&typeof v==='object'?JSON.stringify(v):v;})) as string;
 };
 const stock=async(ticker:string,market:'A'|'HK'|'US')=>{await q(`insert into public.stocks_universe(ticker,name,market) values($1,$1,$2::market_t) on conflict (ticker) do nothing`,[ticker,market]);};
 const issuer=async()=>await one(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_en) values(gen_random_uuid(),'ZZ Broker Test') returning issuer_id as v`) as string;
 const institution=async(name=`ZZ Broker ${randomUUID()}`)=>await one(`insert into public.research_institutions(name_en) values($1) returning institution_id as v`,[name]) as string;
 /** Simulates broker_report_publish at table level (A1 has no functions): receipt, publication, status flip in one transaction under the publishing setting. */
 const forcePublish=async(reportId:string,licenceVersion=1)=>{
  const c=await pool.connect();
  try{
   await c.query('begin');
   await c.query(`select set_config('broker.publishing',$1,true)`,[reportId]);
   const rr=(await c.query(`insert into public.broker_report_rule_receipts(report_id,rules_version,input_hash,results,code_version) values($1,'broker-rules/1',$2,'[]','test') returning receipt_id`,[reportId,sha(reportId)])).rows[0].receipt_id;
   const pub=(await c.query(`insert into public.broker_report_publications(report_id,revision,snapshot,snapshot_hash,licence_version,rules_receipt_id,published_by) select report_id,revision,'{}'::jsonb,$2,$3,$4,$5 from public.broker_research_reports where report_id=$1 returning publication_id`,[reportId,sha('snap'+reportId),licenceVersion,rr,randomUUID()])).rows[0].publication_id;
   await c.query(`update public.broker_research_reports set status='published',current_publication_id=$2 where report_id=$1`,[reportId,pub]);
   await c.query('commit');return pub as string;
  }catch(e){await c.query('rollback');throw e;}finally{c.release();}
 };
 return {q,one,user,licence,document,parsed,extractRun,report,field,stock,issuer,institution,forcePublish};
}

  expect((await fails(s.q(`insert into public.broker_report_licences(source_label,licence_kind,holder,terms_summary,snippet_max_chars,valid_from) values('x','other','h','t',501,'2020-01-01')`))).message).toMatch(/broker_licences_snippet_max/);
 });

 it('licence_material_change: material edit bumps version, clears confirmation, drafts approved texts, flags reports, writes licence.changed; non-material edit does not',async()=>{
  const lic=await s.licence();const doc=await s.document(lic);const pr=await s.parsed(doc);const rep=await s.report(doc);
  const ext=await s.extractRun(doc,pr);
  await s.q(`update public.broker_research_reports set summary_input_digest=$2 where report_id=$1`,[rep,sha('d')]);
  const sn=await s.one(`insert into public.broker_report_snippets(report_id,purpose,parse_run_id,page,char_start,char_end,text,status,disclosure_check,approved_by,approved_at,created_by) values($1,'thesis',$2,1,0,4,'abcd','approved',$3,gen_random_uuid(),now(),gen_random_uuid()) returning snippet_id as v`,[rep,pr,JSON.stringify(PASS)]);
  const su=await s.one(`insert into public.broker_report_summaries(report_id,lang,run_id,input_hash,summary_md,max_verbatim_overlap,numeric_grounding,disclosure_check,status,approved_by,approved_at) values($1,'zh',$2,$3,'摘要',3,'{"version":"grounding/1","passed":true,"assertions":[],"failures":[]}',$4,'approved',gen_random_uuid(),now()) returning summary_id as v`,[rep,ext,sha('d'),JSON.stringify(PASS)]);
  const before=Number(await s.one(`select count(*)::int v from public.broker_outbox where kind='licence.changed' and payload->>'licence_id'=$1`,[lic]));
  await s.q(`update public.broker_report_licences set source_label='Renamed', evidence_path='licences/'||$2||'.pdf' where licence_id=$1`,[lic,sha('evidence')]);
  expect((await s.q(`select version,confirmed_version from public.broker_report_licences where licence_id=$1`,[lic]))[0]).toEqual({version:1,confirmed_version:1});
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_report_licences set version=7 where licence_id=$1`,[lic]))).message).toMatch(/^licence_version_managed/);
  await s.q(`update public.broker_report_licences set allows_public_target_price=false where licence_id=$1`,[lic]);
  expect((await s.q(`select version,confirmed_by,confirmed_at,confirmed_version from public.broker_report_licences where licence_id=$1`,[lic]))[0]).toEqual({version:2,confirmed_by:null,confirmed_at:null,confirmed_version:null});
  expect((await s.q(`select status,approved_by,approved_at,draft_reason from public.broker_report_snippets where snippet_id=$1`,[sn]))[0]).toEqual({status:'draft',approved_by:null,approved_at:null,draft_reason:'licence_version'});
  expect((await s.q(`select status,draft_reason from public.broker_report_summaries where summary_id=$1`,[su]))[0]).toEqual({status:'draft',draft_reason:'licence_version'});
  expect(await s.one(`select disclosure_ok v from public.broker_research_reports where report_id=$1`,[rep])).toBe(false);
  const ev=await s.q(`select payload from public.broker_outbox where kind='licence.changed' and payload->>'licence_id'=$1 order by created_at`,[lic]);
  expect(ev.length).toBe(before+1);expect(ev.at(-1)!.payload).toMatchObject({licence_id:lic,version:2,previous_version:1});
  expect(typeof ev.at(-1)!.payload.event_id).toBe('string');
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_report_licences set confirmed_by=gen_random_uuid(),confirmed_at=now(),confirmed_version=1 where licence_id=$1`,[lic]))).message).toMatch(/broker_licences_confirmed_version/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`delete from public.broker_report_licences where licence_id=$1`,[lic]))).message).toMatch(/^append_only:/);
 });

 it('documents: status machine, immutable identity, promotion_pending only clears, promotion_lost recovery, never deleted',async()=>{
  const lic=await s.licence();const doc=await s.document(lic);
  const set=(sql:string)=>s.q(`update public.broker_report_documents set ${sql} where document_id=$1`,[doc]);
  expect((await fails(set(`status='parsed'`))).message).toMatch(/^document_transition_invalid:uploaded->parsed/);
  await set(`status='parsing'`);await set(`status='parse_failed'`);await set(`status='parsing'`);
  expect((await fails(set(`status='parsed'`))).message).toMatch(/^document_parse_run_required/);
  expect((await fails(set(`sha256='${sha('other')}'`))).message).toMatch(/^document_immutable/);
  expect((await fails(set(`byte_size=2`))).message).toMatch(/^document_immutable/);
  expect((await fails(set(`promotion_pending=true`))).message).toMatch(/^document_promotion_pending_only_clears/);
  await set(`status='parse_failed'`);
  await set(`status='withdrawn',withdrawn_at=now(),withdrawn_reason='promotion_lost'`);
  await set(`status='uploaded',withdrawn_at=null,withdrawn_reason=null`);                      // FR4-01 recovery
  await set(`status='withdrawn',withdrawn_at=now(),withdrawn_reason='owner request'`);
  expect((await fails(set(`status='uploaded',withdrawn_at=null,withdrawn_reason=null`))).message).toMatch(/^document_transition_invalid:withdrawn->uploaded/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`delete from public.broker_report_documents where document_id=$1`,[doc]))).message).toMatch(/^append_only:/);
 });

 it('intents: legal transitions only, checkpoint_at stamped on every status change, document_id set once',async()=>{
  const lic=await s.licence();const id=randomUUID();
  await s.q(`insert into public.broker_report_upload_intents(intent_id,sha256,byte_size,licence_id,original_filename,created_by,expires_at,status,staging_path) values($1,$2,10,$3,'a.pdf',gen_random_uuid(),now()+interval '2 hours','open','staging/'||$1||'.pdf')`,[id,sha(id),lic]);
  const set=(sql:string)=>s.q(`update public.broker_report_upload_intents set ${sql} where intent_id=$1`,[id]);
  expect(await s.one(`select checkpoint_at v from public.broker_report_upload_intents where intent_id=$1`,[id])).toBeNull();
  await set(`status='validating'`);
  expect(await s.one(`select checkpoint_at is not null v from public.broker_report_upload_intents where intent_id=$1`,[id])).toBe(true);
  expect((await fails(set(`status='committed'`))).message).toMatch(/^intent_transition_invalid:validating->committed/);
  await set(`status='validated'`);await set(`status='promoting'`);
  expect((await fails(set(`status='committed'`))).message).toMatch(/broker_intents_committed_document/);
  const doc=await s.document(lic);
  await set(`document_id='${doc}'`);
  expect((await fails(set(`document_id='${await s.document(lic)}'`))).message).toMatch(/^intent_document_set_once/);
  await set(`status='committed'`);
  expect((await fails(set(`status='abandoned'`))).message).toMatch(/^intent_transition_invalid:committed->abandoned/);
  expect((await fails(set(`sha256='${sha('z')}'`))).message).toMatch(/^intent_immutable/);
 });

 it('runs: inserted running, finished once with finished_at stamped, finishing columns only, never deleted',async()=>{

  await s.q(`insert into public.broker_report_runs(run_id,document_id,kind,extractor_version,code_version,licence_version) values($1,$2,'parse','f3/1','t',1)`,[run,doc]);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_report_runs set code_version='x' where run_id=$1`,[run]))).message).toMatch(/^append_only:/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_report_runs set status='failed',extractor_version='f3/2' where run_id=$1`,[run]))).message).toMatch(/^extractor_version_immutable/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_report_runs set status='succeeded' where run_id=$1`,[run]))).message).toMatch(/broker_runs_parse_artifact/);

  expect((await fails(s.q(`delete from public.broker_report_runs where run_id=$1`,[run]))).message).toMatch(/^append_only:/);
 });

 it('broker_storage_writes: pending by default with server started_at; writer / status / reconciled constraints (P-R5-01)',async()=>{
  const lic=await s.licence();const doc=await s.document(lic);
  const w=await s.one(`insert into public.broker_storage_writes(document_id,path,writer) values($1,'runs/x.request.json','extract') returning write_id as v`,[doc]);
  expect((await s.q(`select status,started_at is not null s,finished_at,reconciled_at from public.broker_storage_writes where write_id=$1`,[w]))[0]).toEqual({status:'pending',s:true,finished_at:null,reconciled_at:null});
  expect((await fails(s.q(`insert into public.broker_storage_writes(document_id,path,writer) values($1,'p','browser')`,[doc]))).message).toMatch(/broker_storage_writes_writer/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_storage_writes set status='done' where write_id=$1`,[w]))).message).toMatch(/broker_storage_writes_finished/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_storage_writes set status='abandoned',finished_at=now() where write_id=$1`,[w]))).message).toMatch(/broker_storage_writes_finished/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_storage_writes set status='reconciled' where write_id=$1`,[w]))).message).toMatch(/broker_storage_writes_(finished|reconciled)/);
  expect((await s.q(`select attempts, next_attempt_at is not null scheduled, deleted_at from public.broker_storage_writes where write_id=$1`,[w]))[0]).toEqual({attempts:0,scheduled:true,deleted_at:null});
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_storage_writes set status='reconciled',finished_at=now(),reconciled_at=now() where write_id=$1`,[w]))).message).toMatch(/broker_storage_writes_deleted/);
  await s.q(`update public.broker_storage_writes set status='reconciled',finished_at=now(),deleted_at=now(),reconciled_at=now() where write_id=$1`,[w]);
 });

 it('child guard on every attached table: insert/update/delete compile and behave on draft and published reports (P-R1-02)',async()=>{
  const lic=await s.licence();const doc=await s.document(lic);const pr=await s.parsed(doc);const rep=await s.report(doc);const ext=await s.extractRun(doc,pr);
  await s.stock('ZZCG','US');const inst=await s.institution();
  const an=await s.one(`insert into public.research_analysts(institution_id,display_name) values($1,'Pat Placeholder') returning analyst_id as v`,[inst]);
  const af=await s.field(rep,pr,{field:'analyst',value_text:'Pat Placeholder',value_source_text:'Pat P',char_end:5});
  // draft: every table accepts insert and update; targets / overrides / bindings also delete; fields / snippets / summaries are append-only
  await s.q(`insert into public.broker_report_targets(report_id,target_key,basis,ticker_as_stated,input_hash) values($1,'ZZCG','candidate','ZZCG US',$2)`,[rep,sha('t')]);
  await s.q(`update public.broker_report_targets set rating_raw='Buy' where report_id=$1`,[rep]);
  await s.q(`insert into public.broker_report_target_overrides(report_id,target_key,security_ticker,set_by) values($1,'ZZCG','ZZCG',gen_random_uuid())`,[rep]);
  await s.q(`update public.broker_report_target_overrides set note='n' where report_id=$1`,[rep]);
  const fid=await s.field(rep,pr,{field:'sector',value_text:'Tech',value_source_text:'Tech',char_end:4});
  await s.q(`update public.broker_report_fields set status='rejected' where field_id=$1`,[fid]);
  const sn=await s.one(`insert into public.broker_report_snippets(report_id,purpose,parse_run_id,page,char_start,char_end,text,created_by) values($1,'thesis',$2,1,0,4,'abcd',gen_random_uuid()) returning snippet_id as v`,[rep,pr]);
  await s.q(`update public.broker_report_snippets set status='rejected' where snippet_id=$1`,[sn]);
  const su=await s.one(`insert into public.broker_report_summaries(report_id,lang,run_id,input_hash,summary_md,max_verbatim_overlap,numeric_grounding,disclosure_check) values($1,'en',$2,$3,'S',0,'{"passed":false}','{"passed":false}') returning summary_id as v`,[rep,ext,sha('i')]);
  await s.q(`update public.broker_report_summaries set status='rejected' where summary_id=$1`,[su]);
  await s.q(`insert into public.broker_report_analysts(report_id,analyst_id,field_id) values($1,$2,$3)`,[rep,an,af]);
  await s.q(`update public.broker_report_analysts set role='lead' where report_id=$1`,[rep]);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`insert into public.broker_report_analysts(report_id,analyst_id,field_id) values($1,$2,$3)`,[rep,an,fid]))).message).toMatch(/analyst_field_mismatch|duplicate key/);
  for(const t of ['broker_report_fields','broker_report_snippets','broker_report_summaries'])
   expect((await fails(s.q(`delete from public.${t} where report_id=$1`,[rep]))).message).toMatch(/^append_only:/);
  await s.q(`delete from public.broker_report_analysts where report_id=$1`,[rep]);
  await s.q(`delete from public.broker_report_target_overrides where report_id=$1`,[rep]);
  await s.q(`delete from public.broker_report_targets where report_id=$1`,[rep]);
  // published: every table rejects every write with published_immutable (no "record new has no field" error)
  await s.q(`insert into public.broker_report_targets(report_id,target_key,basis,ticker_as_stated,input_hash) values($1,'ZZCG','candidate','ZZCG US',$2)`,[rep,sha('t')]);
  await s.q(`insert into public.broker_report_analysts(report_id,analyst_id,field_id) values($1,$2,$3)`,[rep,an,af]);
  await s.forcePublish(rep);
  const writes:[string,unknown[]][]=[
   [`insert into public.broker_report_targets(report_id,target_key,basis,ticker_as_stated,input_hash) values($1,'ZZCH','candidate','ZZCH US',$2)`,[rep,sha('u')]],
   [`update public.broker_report_targets set rating_raw='Sell' where report_id=$1`,[rep]],
   [`delete from public.broker_report_targets where report_id=$1`,[rep]],
   [`insert into public.broker_report_target_overrides(report_id,target_key,security_ticker,set_by) values($1,'ZZCG','ZZCG',gen_random_uuid())`,[rep]],
   [`update public.broker_report_fields set reviewed_at=now() where field_id=$1`,[fid]],
   [`update public.broker_report_snippets set text='abce' where snippet_id=$1`,[sn]],
   [`update public.broker_report_summaries set summary_md='T' where summary_id=$1`,[su]],
   [`update public.broker_report_analysts set role='x' where report_id=$1`,[rep]],
   [`delete from public.broker_report_analysts where report_id=$1`,[rep]],
  ];
  for(const [sql,args] of writes){const e=await fails(s.q(sql,args));expect(e.message).toMatch(/^published_immutable:/);expect(e.message).not.toMatch(/has no field/);}
 });

 it('reports guard and child guards: draft-only insert, publish_direct_forbidden, published immutability, frozen children, snippets/summaries may only fall back',async()=>{
  const lic=await s.licence();const doc=await s.document(lic);const pr=await s.parsed(doc);const rep=await s.report(doc);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`insert into public.broker_research_reports(document_id,code_version,status) values($1,'t','published')`,[await s.document(lic)]))).message).toMatch(/^publish_direct_forbidden/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_research_reports set status='published' where report_id=$1`,[rep]))).message).toMatch(/^publish_direct_forbidden/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_research_reports set revision=2 where report_id=$1`,[rep]))).message).toMatch(/^report_column_managed/);
  const fid=await s.field(rep,pr,{field:'title'});
  await s.q(`update public.broker_research_reports set summary_input_digest=$2 where report_id=$1`,[rep,sha('d')]);
  const sn=await s.one(`insert into public.broker_report_snippets(report_id,purpose,parse_run_id,page,char_start,char_end,text,status,disclosure_check,approved_by,approved_at,created_by) values($1,'thesis',$2,1,0,4,'abcd','approved',$3,gen_random_uuid(),now(),gen_random_uuid()) returning snippet_id as v`,[rep,pr,JSON.stringify(PASS)]);
  const pub=await s.forcePublish(rep);
  expect((await s.q(`select status,current_publication_id from public.broker_research_reports where report_id=$1`,[rep]))[0]).toEqual({status:'published',current_publication_id:pub});
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_research_reports set title_public='x' where report_id=$1`,[rep]))).message).toMatch(/^published_immutable/);
  await s.q(`update public.broker_research_reports set evidence_ok=false where report_id=$1`,[rep]);                   // allowed
  await s.q(`update public.broker_research_reports set evidence_ok=true, disclosure_ok=true where report_id=$1`,[rep]);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_research_reports set status='draft' where report_id=$1`,[rep]))).message).toMatch(/^unpublish_direct_forbidden/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_research_reports set status='withdrawn' where report_id=$1`,[rep]))).message).toMatch(/^withdraw_direct_forbidden/);
  expect((await fails(s.field(rep,pr,{field:'sector',value_text:'Tech'}))).message).toMatch(/^published_immutable:broker_report_fields/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_report_fields set status='rejected' where field_id=$1`,[fid]))).message).toMatch(/^published_immutable/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_report_snippets set text='abce' where snippet_id=$1`,[sn]))).message).toMatch(/^published_immutable/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`insert into public.broker_report_target_overrides(report_id,target_key,security_ticker,set_by) values($1,'X',null,gen_random_uuid())`,[rep]))).message).toMatch(/published_immutable|null value/);
  await s.q(`update public.broker_report_snippets set status='draft',approved_by=null,approved_at=null,draft_reason='licence_version' where snippet_id=$1`,[sn]);   // fallback allowed
  expect((await fails(s.q(`delete from public.broker_report_snippets where snippet_id=$1`,[sn]))).message).toMatch(/^append_only:/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`delete from public.broker_research_reports where report_id=$1`,[rep]))).message).toMatch(/^append_only:/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_report_publications set snapshot='{"x":1}' where publication_id=$1`,[pub]))).message).toMatch(/^append_only:/);
  await s.q(`update public.broker_report_publications set unpublished_at=now(),unpublish_reason='t' where publication_id=$1`,[pub]);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`update public.broker_report_publications set unpublished_at=now() where publication_id=$1`,[pub]))).message).toMatch(/^append_only:/);
  expect((await fails(s.q(`insert into public.broker_report_publications(report_id,revision,snapshot,snapshot_hash,licence_version,rules_receipt_id,published_by) select report_id,9,'{}',$2,1,rules_receipt_id,published_by from public.broker_report_publications where publication_id=$1`,[pub,sha('p')]))).message).toMatch(/^publish_direct_forbidden:publication/);
 });

 it('fields guard: identity and values immutable, legal status moves only, superseded set once; analyst bindings point at analyst rows',async()=>{
  const lic=await s.licence();const doc=await s.document(lic);const pr=await s.parsed(doc);const rep=await s.report(doc);const ext=await s.extractRun(doc,pr);
```
