```ts
  it('fieldReview: conflict siblings rejected, effective basis, typed corrections with explicit null, atomic failure, absent, effective_exists',async()=>{
   const w=await world({extra:tk=>[candidate({field:'rating',target_key:tk,value_text:'Overweight',conflict_group:'g'})]});
   const live=async(field:string)=>(await db.listFields(w.rep)).filter(f=>f.field===field&&(f.status==='extracted'||f.status==='unverified'));
   expect((await db.listTargets(w.rep))[0].rating_raw).toBeNull();
   const ow=(await live('rating')).find(f=>f.value_text==='Overweight')!;
   expect(await code(db.fieldReview(ow.field_id,'confirm',{detail:'x'},by))).toBe('invalid_payload');
   expect(await code(db.fieldReview(ow.field_id,'confirm',{page:1,char_start:5},by))).toBe('invalid_payload');                     // partial span
   await db.fieldReview(ow.field_id,'confirm',{page:1,char_start:5,char_end:15,value_source_text:'Overweight',detail:{framed:true}},by);
   expect((await db.listFields(w.rep)).find(f=>f.field_id===ow.field_id)).toMatchObject({detail:expect.objectContaining({framed:true}),page:1,char_start:5,char_end:15,value_source_text:'Overweight'});   // framed confirm: span written, payload.detail merged (replay)
   expect((await db.listFields(w.rep)).filter(f=>f.field==='rating').map(f=>[f.value_text,f.status]).sort()).toEqual([['Buy','rejected'],['Overweight','confirmed']]);
   for(const f of (await db.listFields(w.rep)).filter(x=>x.status==='extracted'))await db.fieldReview(f.field_id,'confirm',{},by);
   expect((await db.listTargets(w.rep))[0]).toMatchObject({basis:'effective',rating_raw:'Overweight'});
   const pc=(await db.listFields(w.rep)).find(f=>f.field==='price_currency')!;
   const before=await db.listFields(w.rep);
   expect(await code(db.fieldReview(pc.field_id,'correct',{value_text:'USD',value_date:'2026-02-30'},by))).toBe('invalid_payload');
   expect(await code(db.fieldReview(pc.field_id,'shout' as 'confirm',{},by))).toBe('invalid_action');
   expect(await db.listFields(w.rep)).toEqual(before);
   const r=await db.fieldReview(pc.field_id,'correct',{value_text:'USD',value_currency:'USD',value_unit:null},by);
   expect(r).toMatchObject({targets:1,basis:'effective'});
   const corrected=(await db.listFields(w.rep)).find(f=>f.field_id===pc.field_id)!;
   expect(corrected).toMatchObject({status:'corrected',corrected:{value_text:'USD',value_currency:'USD',value_unit:null}});
   expect(effectiveValue(corrected)).toEqual({value_text:'USD',value_num:null,value_currency:'USD',value_unit:null,value_date:null});
   expect((await db.listTargets(w.rep))[0]).toMatchObject({price_currency:'USD',upside_pct:null,upside_formula_version:null});
   expect(await code(db.insertHumanField(w.rep,{target_key:w.tk,field:'price_currency',occurrence:1,value_text:'HKD',value_num:null,value_currency:'HKD',value_unit:null,value_date:null,page:1,char_start:0,char_end:3,value_source_text:'HKD',parse_run_id:w.parse,status:'confirmed'},by))).toBe('effective_exists');
   const tp=(await db.listFields(w.rep)).find(f=>f.field==='target_price')!;
   await db.fieldReview(tp.field_id,'absent',{page:2},by);
   expect((await db.listFields(w.rep)).filter(f=>f.field==='target_price').map(f=>f.status).sort()).toEqual(['absent','rejected']);
   expect((await db.listTargets(w.rep))[0]).toMatchObject({basis:'effective',target_price:null});
   expect(await code(db.fieldReview(randomUUID(),'confirm',{},by))).toBe('field_not_found');
  });

  it('fieldReview: a corrected row can be rejected or marked absent; corrected is cleared (broker_fields_corrected_iff, P-R1-06)',async()=>{
   const w=await world();
   const pick=async(field:string)=>(await db.listFields(w.rep)).find(f=>f.field===field&&f.status==='extracted')!;
   const rating=await pick('rating');
   await db.fieldReview(rating.field_id,'correct',{value_text:'Overweight'},by);
   expect((await db.listFields(w.rep)).find(f=>f.field_id===rating.field_id)).toMatchObject({status:'corrected',corrected:{value_text:'Overweight'}});
   await db.fieldReview(rating.field_id,'reject',{},by);
   expect((await db.listFields(w.rep)).find(f=>f.field_id===rating.field_id)).toMatchObject({status:'rejected',corrected:null});
   const tp=await pick('target_price');
   await db.fieldReview(tp.field_id,'correct',{value_text:'121',value_num:'121'},by);
   await db.fieldReview(tp.field_id,'absent',{page:1},by);
   const rows=(await db.listFields(w.rep)).filter(f=>f.field==='target_price');
   expect(rows.find(f=>f.field_id===tp.field_id)).toMatchObject({status:'rejected',corrected:null});
   expect(rows.find(f=>f.status==='absent')).toMatchObject({corrected:null});
  });

  it('publish: blocked → publish_blocked with the reasons; success → snapshot, published, immutable, one claim per priced target; unpublish → revision, retract, review reopened; republish → new claim',async()=>{
   const w=await world();

   expect(e).toMatchObject({code:'publish_blocked'});expect(e!.detail).toMatch(/^review_not_approved,/);
   const r=await ready();
   const {publicationId:pub}=await db.publish(r.rep,by);
   const p=(await db.getPublication(pub))!;
   expect(p).toMatchObject({report_id:r.rep,revision:1,licence_version:1,published_by:by,unpublished_at:null});expect(p.snapshot_hash).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
   expect((p.snapshot.report as Record<string,unknown>).status).toBe('published');expect((p.snapshot.fields as unknown[]).length).toBe(10);
   expect(await db.getReport(r.rep)).toMatchObject({status:'published',current_publication_id:pub,title_restricted:false});
   expect(await code(db.updateReportDraft(r.rep,{title_public:'x',title_public_by:by}))).toBe('published_immutable');
   expect(await code(db.fieldReview((await db.listFields(r.rep))[0].field_id,'reject',{},by))).toBe('published_immutable');
   expect(await code(db.materialize(r.rep))).toBe('published_immutable');
   expect(await code(db.publish(r.rep,by))).toBe('report_not_draft');
   await db.updateReportDraft(r.rep,{evidence_ok:true});                                        // allowed (unchanged)
   const regs=(await h.outbox()).filter(x=>x.kind==='claim.register'&&(x.payload.source as Record<string,unknown>).publication_id===pub);
   expect(regs).toHaveLength(1);
   expect(regs[0].payload).toMatchObject({claim_key:`broker_target_price:${pub}:${r.tk}`,claim_seq:1,methodology_version:CLAIM_METHODOLOGY_VERSION,subject:{security_ticker:r.tk,market:'HK',currency:'HKD'},claim:{direction:1,target_price:'120',reference_price:'100'},source:{snapshot_hash:p.snapshot_hash}});
   expect(await code(db.unpublish(r.rep,by,' '))).toBe('reason_required');
   await db.unpublish(r.rep,by,'owner request');
   expect(await db.getReport(r.rep)).toMatchObject({status:'draft',revision:2,current_publication_id:null,review_status:'in_review'});
   expect(await db.getPublication(pub)).toMatchObject({unpublish_reason:'owner request'});
   const ret=(await h.outbox()).filter(x=>x.kind==='claim.retract'&&x.payload.claim_key===`broker_target_price:${pub}:${r.tk}`);
   expect(ret.map(x=>[x.payload.claim_seq,x.payload.reason])).toEqual([[2,'unpublish']]);
   await db.updateReportDraft(r.rep,{review_status:'approved'});
   const {publicationId:pub2}=await db.publish(r.rep,by);
   expect((await db.getPublication(pub2))!.revision).toBe(2);
   await db.updateReportDraft(r.rep,{disclosure_ok:false});
   expect((await h.outbox()).filter(x=>x.kind==='claim.retract'&&(x.payload.claim_key as string).includes(pub2)).map(x=>x.payload.reason)).toEqual(['disclosure_ok']);
   await db.updateDocument(r.doc,{status:'withdrawn',withdrawn_at:new Date().toISOString(),withdrawn_reason:'gone'});
   expect((await db.getReport(r.rep))!.status).toBe('withdrawn');
   expect((await h.outbox()).filter(x=>x.kind==='claim.retract'&&(x.payload.claim_key as string).includes(pub2))).toHaveLength(1);
  });

   const w=await world();
   const run=async(kind:'summary'|'translate')=>{const id=randomUUID();await db.insertRun({run_id:id,document_id:w.doc,kind,parse_run_id:w.parse,extractor_version:null,artifact_path:null,artifact_hash:null,model_id:'m-test',registry_hash:'r'.repeat(64),prompt_version:'p',schema_version:null,code_version:'t',behavior_digest:null,licence_version:1,request_path:null,response_path:null,batch_id:null});return id;};
   const dg=(await db.getReport(w.rep))!.summary_input_digest!;
   const row={report_id:w.rep,lang:'en' as const,input_hash:dg,summary_md:'S',max_verbatim_overlap:1,numeric_grounding:{version:'grounding/1',passed:true,assertions:[],failures:[]},disclosure_check:PASS_CHECK,status:'draft' as const};
   const s1=await run('summary');
   const id=await db.summaryCommit(w.doc,w.token,s1,row);
   expect(await db.getSummary(id)).toMatchObject({run_id:s1,status:'draft'});expect(await db.getRun(s1)).toMatchObject({status:'succeeded'});
   const t1=await run('translate');
   expect(await db.titleCommit(w.doc,w.token,t1,{title_zh:'标题',title_en:'Title'})).toBe('ok');
   expect(await db.getReport(w.rep)).toMatchObject({title_zh:'标题',title_en:'Title',title_run_id:t1});
   const s2=await run('summary');const t2=await run('translate');
   expect(await code(db.summaryCommit(w.doc,randomUUID(),s2,row))).toBe('lease_lost');               // taken over
   await h.expireLease(w.doc);
   expect(await code(db.summaryCommit(w.doc,w.token,s2,row))).toBe('lease_lost');                    // expired
   expect(await code(db.titleCommit(w.doc,w.token,t2,{title_zh:'x',title_en:'y'}))).toBe('lease_lost');
   expect((await db.listSummaries(w.rep)).map(s=>s.summary_id)).toEqual([id]);
   expect(await db.getReport(w.rep)).toMatchObject({title_zh:'标题',title_run_id:t1});
   expect(await db.getRun(s2)).toMatchObject({status:'running'});
  });

   const r=await ready();
   const sn=await db.insertSnippet({report_id:r.rep,target_key:null,purpose:'thesis',parse_run_id:r.parse,page:1,char_start:0,char_end:4,text:'abcd',field_id:null,disclosure_check:null,created_by:by});

   await db.setSummaryStatus(su,{status:'approved',approved_by:by,disclosure_check:PASS_CHECK});
   const titlesOf=async()=>{const x=(await db.getReport(r.rep))!;return Object.fromEntries((['title_original','title_public','title_zh','title_en'] as const).filter(k=>x[k]!==null).map(k=>[k,PASS_CHECK]));};
   const attempt=async(o:{snippets:Record<string,typeof PASS_CHECK>;summaries:Record<string,typeof PASS_CHECK>})=>db.disclosureRecheck(r.rep,by,{expected_digest:await db.disclosureDigest(r.rep),titles:await titlesOf(),...o});
   for(const phase of ['draft','published'] as const){

    expect(await attempt({snippets:{},summaries:{[su]:PASS_CHECK}})).toEqual({restored:false,failures:[`restricted_value_in_text:snippet:${sn}`]});
    expect(await attempt({snippets:{[sn]:PASS_CHECK},summaries:{}})).toEqual({restored:false,failures:['restricted_value_in_text:summary:en']});
    expect((await db.getReport(r.rep))!.disclosure_ok).toBe(false);
    expect(JSON.stringify([await db.getSnippet(sn),await db.getSummary(su)])).toBe(before);
    expect(await attempt({snippets:{[sn]:PASS_CHECK},summaries:{[su]:PASS_CHECK}})).toEqual({restored:true,failures:[]});
   }
  });

  it('bucket-write inventory: register before bytes, finish, per-document listing, unreconciled rows of purge-intent documents in retry order; pending cannot reconcile (P-R6-01..03)',async()=>{
   const w=await world();
   const a=await db.registerWrite({document_id:w.doc,path:`runs/${randomUUID()}.request.json`,writer:'extract'});
   const b=await db.registerWrite({document_id:w.doc,path:`reports/${w.sha}.pages.${w.parse}/`,writer:'f3'});
   expect((await db.pendingWritesFor(w.doc)).map(x=>x.write_id)).toEqual([a,b]);
   await db.finishWrite(a);await db.finishWrite(a);                                            // idempotent
   expect((await db.pendingWritesFor(w.doc)).map(x=>x.write_id)).toEqual([b]);
   expect((await db.writesFor(w.doc)).map(x=>[x.write_id,x.status])).toEqual([[a,'done'],[b,'pending']]);
   expect((await db.unreconciledWrites(500)).some(x=>x.document_id===w.doc)).toBe(false);     // the document is not withdrawn
   await db.withdrawWithIntent(w.doc,'t',false,by);
   expect(await db.getDocument(w.doc)).toMatchObject({status:'withdrawn',withdrawn_reason:'t',purge_requested_at:null,purge_requested_by:null});
   expect((await db.unreconciledWrites(500)).some(x=>x.document_id===w.doc)).toBe(false);
   await db.withdrawWithIntent(w.doc,'retry',true,by);
   expect(await db.getDocument(w.doc)).toMatchObject({status:'withdrawn',withdrawn_reason:'t',purge_requested_at:expect.any(String),purge_requested_by:by});
   await db.markReconciled(b,new Date().toISOString()); // pending must not reconcile
   const mine=(await db.unreconciledWrites(500)).filter(x=>x.document_id===w.doc);
   expect(mine.map(x=>x.write_id).sort()).toEqual([a,b].sort());
   await db.markReconciled(a,new Date().toISOString());
   expect((await db.unreconciledWrites(500)).filter(x=>x.document_id===w.doc).map(x=>x.write_id)).toEqual([b]);
   expect((await db.writesFor(w.doc)).find(x=>x.write_id===a)).toMatchObject({status:'reconciled',reconciled_at:expect.any(String)});
   const abandoned=await db.registerWrite({document_id:w.doc,path:`runs/${randomUUID()}.response.json`,writer:'extract'});
   await db.abandonWrite(abandoned);await db.finishWrite(abandoned);await db.markReconciled(abandoned,new Date().toISOString());
   expect((await db.writesFor(w.doc)).find(x=>x.write_id===abandoned)).toMatchObject({status:'abandoned',finished_at:null,reconciled_at:null});
   expect((await db.unreconciledWrites(500)).some(x=>x.write_id===abandoned)).toBe(false);
   await db.retryWrite(b,'2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',3);
   expect((await db.unreconciledWrites(500)).some(x=>x.write_id===b)).toBe(false);
   expect((await db.writesFor(w.doc)).find(x=>x.write_id===b)).toMatchObject({status:'pending',attempts:3,next_attempt_at:'2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'});
   await db.retryWrite(b,'2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',3);
   expect((await db.unreconciledWrites(500)).some(x=>x.write_id===b)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('currency facets and spread agree when currency columns exist but prices are absent (P-R6-06)',async()=>{
   for(const absent of [['target_price'],['target_price','price_at_report']]){
    const r=await ready();
    for(const f of await db.listFields(r.rep))if(absent.includes(f.field))await db.fieldReview(f.field_id,'absent',{page:1},by);
    await db.materialize(r.rep);await rules(r.rep);await db.publish(r.rep,by);await db.setPublicEnabled(true,by);
    const expected=absent.length===2?null:'HKD';
    const detail=(await db.publicReport(r.rep))!;
    expect(detail.targets[0]).toMatchObject({target_price:null,target_currency:'HKD',price_currency:'HKD'});
    // D1 adds this assertion to the A4/A5 shared contract once public-dto/public loaders exist.
    const {toPublicReport}=await import('./public-dto');
    expect(toPublicReport(detail)!.targets[0].currency).toBe(expected);
    expect(detail.report.target_facets).toContainEqual({issuer_id:r.iss,rating:'buy',security_ticker:r.tk,currency:expected});
    const f={issuerId:r.iss,securityTicker:r.tk,currency:expected,from:'2025-01-01'};
```

```ts
/** Chainable PostgREST stub: records every call; resolves rpc by name and table reads from a queue. */
function stub(o:{rpc?:Record<string,{data:unknown;error:unknown}>;rows?:unknown[]}={}){
 const calls:unknown[][]=[];const rows=[...(o.rows??[])];
 const builder=(table:string)=>{
  const b:Record<string,unknown>={};
  for(const m of ['select','insert','update','upsert','eq','is','in','like','gte','lte','lt','or','order','limit','range','single','maybeSingle'])b[m]=(...a:unknown[])=>{calls.push(['from',table,m,...a]);return b;};
  b.then=(res:(v:unknown)=>unknown,rej?:(e:unknown)=>unknown)=>Promise.resolve({data:rows.length?rows.shift():null,error:null}).then(res,rej);
  return b;
 };
 const client={rpc:(fn:string,args:unknown)=>{calls.push(['rpc',fn,args]);return Promise.resolve(o.rpc?.[fn]??{data:null,error:null});},from:builder};
 return {calls,client:client as unknown as SupabaseClient};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/postgrest-stub.ts
// Test support (not a test file): a PostgREST client over in-memory view rows with a server row cap (max_rows) —
// every response holds at most `cap` rows, like a real PostgREST max_rows. Used by db.test.ts (A4) and the public
// loader test (D1) to prove that no read silently loses rows to the cap (P-R3-05, P-R4-03).
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
/** PostgREST over in-memory public-view rows with a server row cap (max_rows): every response holds at most `cap` rows. */
export function cappedAnon(views:Record<string,Record<string,unknown>[]>,cap:number){
 type Row=Record<string,unknown>;type Pred=(r:Row)=>boolean;
 const from=(table:string)=>{
  const f:Pred[]=[];const ord:[string,boolean][]=[];let lo=0,hi:number|null=null,lim:number|null=null,single=false;
  const b:Record<string,(...a:unknown[])=>unknown>={
   select:()=>b,
   eq:(k,v)=>{f.push(r=>r[k as string]===v);return b;},
   is:(k,v)=>{f.push(r=>(r[k as string]??null)===v);return b;},
   in:(k,vs)=>{f.push(r=>(vs as unknown[]).includes(r[k as string]));return b;},
   contains:(k,vs)=>{   // PostgREST cs: a JSON string = jsonb @> (array of objects, each needle contained in ONE element)
    const needles=(typeof vs==='string'?JSON.parse(vs):vs) as unknown[];
    f.push(r=>needles.every(n=>((r[k as string]??[]) as unknown[]).some(e=>typeof n==='object'&&n!==null?Object.entries(n).every(([nk,nv])=>(e as Row)[nk]===nv):e===n)));return b;},
   gte:(k,v)=>{f.push(r=>String(r[k as string])>=String(v));return b;},
   lte:(k,v)=>{f.push(r=>String(r[k as string])<=String(v));return b;},
   or:(e)=>{const m=/^published_date\.lt\.([^,]+),and\(published_date\.eq\.([^,]+),report_id\.lt\.([^)]+)\)$/.exec(String(e))!;
    f.push(r=>String(r.published_date)<m[1]||(String(r.published_date)===m[2]&&String(r.report_id)<m[3]));return b;},
   order:(k,o)=>{ord.push([k as string,(o as {ascending?:boolean}|undefined)?.ascending!==false]);return b;},
   range:(a,z)=>{lo=a as number;hi=z as number;return b;},
   limit:(n)=>{lim=n as number;return b;},
   maybeSingle:()=>{single=true;return b;},
   then:(res,rej)=>{
    const rows=(views[table]??[]).filter(r=>f.every(p=>p(r))).sort((x,y)=>{for(const [k,asc] of ord){const a=String(x[k]),c=String(y[k]);if(a!==c)return (a<c?-1:1)*(asc?1:-1);}return 0;});
    const end=hi!==null?hi+1:lim!==null?lo+lim:rows.length;
    const out=rows.slice(lo,Math.min(end,lo+cap));
    return Promise.resolve({data:single?out[0]??null:out,error:null}).then(res as never,rej as never);
   },
  };
  return b;
 };
 return {from,rpc:async()=>({data:null,error:null})} as unknown as SupabaseClient;
}
```

```ts
 return {

  stock:async(t,m)=>{await p.query(`insert into public.stocks_universe(ticker,name,market) values($1,$1,$2::market_t) on conflict (ticker) do nothing`,[t,m]);},

  close:async()=>{await unlock?.();await p.end();},
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/pg-db.ts
// TEST-ONLY BrokerResearchDb over node-postgres calling the same SQL functions and views the
// Supabase adapter calls through rpc/PostgREST, so the shared contract (db-contract.ts) runs on the
// real schema: triggers, locks, leases, hashes, views. Nothing in src/app imports this. Uses
// pg-table-client's typeParsers (date/timestamptz as text; numeric/bigint as strings) and the
// db.ts normalisers; errors go through toBrokerResearchDbError exactly like PostgREST errors.
import type {Pool} from 'pg';
import {ident,typeParsers} from '../db/pg-table-client';
import {DEFAULT_QUEUE_LIMIT,FIELD_COLUMNS,HISTORY_COLUMNS,PUBLIC_CITATION_COLUMNS,PUBLIC_TARGET_COLUMNS,PURGE_TEXT,TARGET_COLUMNS,accessFromRow,analystFromRow,analystsDistinct,bundles,documentFromRow,dropUndefined,evalFromRow,fencedArgs,fieldFromRow,institutionFromRow,intentFromRow,licenceFromRow,outboxFromRow,publicRow,publicationFromRow,purgeFromRow,receiptFrom,reportFromRow,runFromRow,scaleFromRow,settingsFromRow,snippetFromRow,sqlColumns,summaryFromRow,targetFromRow,toBrokerResearchDbError,writeFromRow} from './db';
import type {PgErrorLike} from './db';
import {BrokerResearchDbError} from './types';
import type {BrokerResearchDb,ReportAnalystRow} from './types';

type R=Record<string,unknown>;
// Plain objects → JSON (jsonb parameters); JS arrays pass through as PostgreSQL arrays (uuid[]/text[]).
const J=(v:unknown)=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)?JSON.stringify(v):v;

export function pgBrokerResearchDb(pool:Pool):BrokerResearchDb{
 const q=async(text:string,values:unknown[]=[]):Promise<R[]>=>{
  try{return (await pool.query({text,values:values.map(J),types:typeParsers})).rows as R[];}
  catch(e){throw toBrokerResearchDbError(e as PgErrorLike);}
 };
 const fn=async<T>(call:string,values:unknown[]):Promise<T>=>(await q(`select ${call} as v`,values))[0].v as T;
 const one=async(text:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>(await q(text,values))[0]??null;
 const rel=(t:string)=>`public.${ident(t)}`;
 /** insert/update helpers over validated identifiers. */
 const insert=async(t:string,row:R,returning='*')=>{const p=dropUndefined(row);const k=Object.keys(p);
  return (await q(`insert into ${rel(t)} (${k.map(ident).join(', ')}) values (${k.map((_,i)=>`$${i+1}`).join(', ')}) returning ${returning}`,k.map(c=>p[c])))[0];};
 const update=async(t:string,patch:R,where:string,whereValues:unknown[],returning='1')=>{const p=dropUndefined(patch);const k=Object.keys(p);if(!k.length)return [] as R[];
  return q(`update ${rel(t)} set ${k.map((c,i)=>`${ident(c)} = $${i+1+whereValues.length}`).join(', ')} where ${where} returning ${returning}`,[...whereValues,...k.map(c=>p[c])]);};
 const notFound=(what:string)=>new BrokerResearchDbError('not_found',`not_found:${what}`,what);
 return {
  async getSettings(){return settingsFromRow((await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_research_settings')} where id = 1`))!);},
  async setPublicEnabled(flag,by){await q(`update ${rel('broker_research_settings')} set public_enabled = $1, updated_by = $2, updated_at = now() where id = 1`,[flag,by]);},
  async setApprovedGoldCorpus(hash,by){await q(`update ${rel('broker_research_settings')} set approved_gold_corpus_hash = $1, approved_gold_corpus_by = case when $1::text is null then null else $2::uuid end, approved_gold_corpus_at = case when $1::text is null then null else now() end, updated_by = $2, updated_at = now() where id = 1`,[hash,by]);},
  async listLicences(){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_licences')} order by created_at, licence_id`)).map(licenceFromRow);},
  async getLicence(id){const r=await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_licences')} where licence_id = $1`,[id]);return r?licenceFromRow(r):null;},
  async insertLicence(input){return licenceFromRow(await insert('broker_report_licences',input as unknown as R));},
  async updateLicence(id,patch){const [r]=await update('broker_report_licences',patch as R,'licence_id = $1',[id],'*');if(!r)throw notFound('licence');return licenceFromRow(r);},
  async confirmLicence(id,by,version){
   const hit=await q(`update ${rel('broker_report_licences')} set confirmed_by = $2, confirmed_at = now(), confirmed_version = $3 where licence_id = $1 and version = $3 returning 1`,[id,by,version]);
   if(hit.length)return 'confirmed';
   if(!await one(`select 1 from ${rel('broker_report_licences')} where licence_id = $1`,[id]))throw notFound('licence');
   return 'version_mismatch';
  },
  async insertIntent(row){await insert('broker_report_upload_intents',row as unknown as R,'intent_id');},
  async getIntent(id){const r=await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_upload_intents')} where intent_id = $1`,[id]);return r?intentFromRow(r):null;},
  async transitionIntent(id,from,to,patch){return (await update('broker_report_upload_intents',{status:to,...(patch??{})},'intent_id = $1 and status = $2',[id,from])).length>0;},
  async findDocumentBySha(sha){const r=await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_documents')} where sha256 = $1`,[sha]);return r?documentFromRow(r):null;},
  async getDocument(id){const r=await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_documents')} where document_id = $1`,[id]);return r?documentFromRow(r):null;},
  async insertDocument(row){
   try{await insert('broker_report_documents',{...row,status:'uploaded',promotion_pending:true},'document_id');return 'inserted';}
   catch(e){if(e instanceof BrokerResearchDbError&&e.code==='duplicate_key')return 'duplicate';throw e;}
  },
  withdrawWithIntent:(id,reason,purge,by)=>fn<void>('public.broker_document_withdraw($1,$2,$3,$4)',[id,reason,purge,by]),
  async updateDocument(id,patch){await update('broker_report_documents',patch as R,'document_id = $1',[id]);},
  claimLease:(id,token,ttl)=>fn<boolean>('public.broker_document_claim_lease($1,$2,$3)',[id,token,ttl]),
  renewLease:(id,token,ttl)=>fn<'ok'|'lease_lost'|'document_withdrawn'>('public.broker_document_renew_lease($1,$2,$3)',[id,token,ttl]),
  async fencedUpdateDocument(id,token,patch){const a=fencedArgs(patch);return fn<'ok'|'lease_lost'>('public.broker_document_fenced_update($1,$2,$3::jsonb,$4)',[id,token,a.patch,a.release]);},
  async insertRun(row){await insert('broker_report_runs',{...row,detail:row.detail??{}},'run_id');},
  finishRun:(id,token,patch)=>fn<'ok'|'lease_lost'>('public.broker_run_finish($1,$2,$3::jsonb)',[id,token,dropUndefined(patch as R)]),
  async getRun(id){const r=await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_runs')} where run_id = $1`,[id]);return r?runFromRow(r):null;},
  async listRuns(documentId){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_runs')} where document_id = $1 order by started_at, run_id`,[documentId])).map(runFromRow);},
  async ensureReport(documentId,codeVersion){
   await q(`insert into ${rel('broker_research_reports')} (document_id, code_version) values ($1, $2) on conflict (document_id) do nothing`,[documentId,codeVersion]);
   return reportFromRow((await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_research_reports')} where document_id = $1`,[documentId]))!);
  },
  async getReport(id){const r=await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_research_reports')} where report_id = $1`,[id]);return r?reportFromRow(r):null;},
  async reportByDocument(id){const r=await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_research_reports')} where document_id = $1`,[id]);return r?reportFromRow(r):null;},
  async listReports(o){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('broker_research_reports')} where institution_id = $1 order by created_at, report_id`,[o.institutionId])).map(reportFromRow);},
  async updateReportDraft(id,patch){await update('broker_research_reports',patch as R,'report_id = $1',[id]);},
  async setReportFlags(id,flags){const p=dropUndefined(flags as R);if(Object.keys(p).length&&!(await update('broker_research_reports',p,'report_id = $1',[id])).length)throw notFound('report');},
  async extractCommit(documentId,token,runId,rows){return receiptFrom(await fn('public.broker_extract_commit($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb)',[documentId,token,runId,JSON.stringify(rows)]));},
  async fieldReview(fieldId,action,payload,by){return receiptFrom(await fn('public.broker_field_review($1,$2,$3::jsonb,$4)',[fieldId,action,payload,by]));},
  async insertHumanField(reportId,row,by){const x=await fn<R>('public.broker_field_add($1,$2::jsonb,$3)',[reportId,row,by]);return {fieldId:String(x.field_id),receipt:receiptFrom(x.receipt)};},
  async upsertTargetOverride(row){return receiptFrom(await fn('public.broker_target_override($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)',[row.report_id,row.target_key,row.security_ticker,row.issuer_id,row.set_by,row.note]));},
  async materialize(id){return receiptFrom(await fn('public.broker_report_materialize($1)',[id]));},
  async listFields(reportId,opts){
   return (await q(`select ${sqlColumns(FIELD_COLUMNS)} from ${rel('broker_report_fields')} where report_id = $1${opts?.includeSuperseded?'':' and superseded_by_run_id is null'} order by target_key nulls first, field, occurrence, created_at, field_id`,[reportId])).map(fieldFromRow);
  },
  async listTargets(reportId){return (await q(`select ${sqlColumns(TARGET_COLUMNS)} from ${rel('broker_report_targets')} where report_id = $1 order by target_key`,[reportId])).map(targetFromRow);},
  async bindAnalyst(row){await q(`insert into ${rel('broker_report_analysts')} (report_id, analyst_id, role, field_id) values ($1,$2,$3,$4) on conflict (report_id, analyst_id) do update set role = excluded.role, field_id = excluded.field_id`,[row.report_id,row.analyst_id,row.role,row.field_id]);},
  async listReportAnalysts(reportId){return (await q(`select report_id, analyst_id, role, field_id from ${rel('broker_report_analysts')} where report_id = $1 order by analyst_id`,[reportId])) as unknown as ReportAnalystRow[];},
  async insertRuleReceipt(row){return String((await insert('broker_report_rule_receipts',{...row,results:JSON.stringify(row.results)},'receipt_id')).receipt_id);},
  async insertSnippet(row){return String((await insert('broker_report_snippets',{...row,status:'draft'},'snippet_id')).snippet_id);},
  async setSnippetStatus(id,patch){await update('broker_report_snippets',patch as R,'snippet_id = $1',[id]);},
  async getSnippet(id){const r=await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_snippets')} where snippet_id = $1`,[id]);return r?snippetFromRow(r):null;},
  async listSnippets(reportId){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_snippets')} where report_id = $1 order by created_at, snippet_id`,[reportId])).map(snippetFromRow);},
  summaryCommit:async(documentId,token,runId,row)=>String(await fn('public.broker_summary_commit($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb)',[documentId,token,runId,JSON.stringify(row)])),
  titleCommit:async(documentId,token,runId,titles)=>{await fn('public.broker_title_commit($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb)',[documentId,token,runId,JSON.stringify(titles)]);return 'ok' as const;},
  extractSetScope:async(documentId,token,runId,scope)=>receiptFrom(await fn('public.broker_extract_set_scope($1,$2,$3,$4)',[documentId,token,runId,scope])),
  extractFinalize:async(documentId,token,runId,detail)=>{await fn('public.broker_extract_finalize($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb)',[documentId,token,runId,JSON.stringify(detail)]);return 'ok' as const;},
  async insertSummary(row){return String((await insert('broker_report_summaries',row as unknown as R,'summary_id')).summary_id);},
  async setSummaryStatus(id,patch){await update('broker_report_summaries',patch as R,'summary_id = $1',[id]);},
  async getSummary(id){const r=await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_summaries')} where summary_id = $1`,[id]);return r?summaryFromRow(r):null;},
  async listSummaries(reportId){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_summaries')} where report_id = $1 order by generated_at, summary_id`,[reportId])).map(summaryFromRow);},
  async publishBlockers(id){return ((await fn<string[]|null>('public.broker_report_publish_blockers($1)',[id]))??[]).map(String);},
  async disclosureDigest(id){return String(await fn('public.broker_report_disclosure_digest($1)',[id]));},
  async disclosureRecheck(id,by,checks){const x=await fn<R>('public.broker_report_disclosure_recheck($1,$2,$3::jsonb)',[id,by,JSON.stringify(checks)]);return {restored:x.restored===true,failures:((x.failures??[]) as unknown[]).map(String)};},
  async publish(id,by){return {publicationId:String(await fn('public.broker_report_publish($1,$2)',[id,by]))};},
  async unpublish(id,by,reason){await q(`select public.broker_report_unpublish($1,$2,$3)`,[id,by,reason]);},
  async getPublication(id){const r=await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_publications')} where publication_id = $1`,[id]);return r?publicationFromRow(r):null;},
  async upsertInstitution(row){
   const r=row.institution_id
    ?await one(`insert into ${rel('research_institutions')} (institution_id, name_en, name_zh, aliases, kind, rating_disclosure_url) values ($1,$2,$3,$4::text[],$5,$6) on conflict (institution_id) do update set name_en = excluded.name_en, name_zh = excluded.name_zh, aliases = excluded.aliases, kind = excluded.kind, rating_disclosure_url = excluded.rating_disclosure_url returning institution_id`,[row.institution_id,row.name_en,row.name_zh,`{${row.aliases.map(a=>JSON.stringify(a)).join(',')}}`,row.kind,row.rating_disclosure_url])
    :await one(`insert into ${rel('research_institutions')} (name_en, name_zh, aliases, kind, rating_disclosure_url) values ($1,$2,$3::text[],$4,$5) returning institution_id`,[row.name_en,row.name_zh,`{${row.aliases.map(a=>JSON.stringify(a)).join(',')}}`,row.kind,row.rating_disclosure_url]);
   return String(r!.institution_id);
  },
  async listInstitutions(){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('research_institutions')} order by name_en, institution_id`)).map(institutionFromRow);},
  async insertRatingScale(row){return String((await insert('research_rating_scales',row as unknown as R,'scale_id')).scale_id);},
  async closeRatingScale(id,validTo,by){if(!(await q(`update ${rel('research_rating_scales')} set valid_to = $2, closed_by = $3 where scale_id = $1 returning 1`,[id,validTo,by])).length)throw notFound('rating_scale');},
  async listRatingScales(inst){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('research_rating_scales')} where institution_id = $1 order by raw_label, valid_from, scale_id`,[inst])).map(scaleFromRow);},
  async upsertAnalyst(row){
   const variants=`{${row.name_variants.map(a=>JSON.stringify(a)).join(',')}}`;
   const r=row.analyst_id
    ?await one(`insert into ${rel('research_analysts')} (analyst_id, institution_id, display_name, name_variants, public_display) values ($1,$2,$3,$4::text[],$5) on conflict (analyst_id) do update set display_name = excluded.display_name, name_variants = excluded.name_variants, public_display = excluded.public_display returning analyst_id`,[row.analyst_id,row.institution_id,row.display_name,variants,row.public_display])
    :await one(`insert into ${rel('research_analysts')} (institution_id, display_name, name_variants, public_display) values ($1,$2,$3::text[],$4) returning analyst_id`,[row.institution_id,row.display_name,variants,row.public_display]);
   return String(r!.analyst_id);
  },
  async listAnalysts(inst){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('research_analysts')} where institution_id = $1 order by display_name, analyst_id`,[inst])).map(analystFromRow);},
  async reviewQueue(opts){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('broker_research_reports')} where status = 'draft' and review_status = any($1::text[]) order by updated_at, report_id limit $2`,[opts.status?[opts.status]:['pending','in_review'],opts.limit??DEFAULT_QUEUE_LIMIT])).map(reportFromRow);},
  async logAccess(row){await insert('broker_report_access_log',row as unknown as R,'id');},
  async listAccessLog(opts){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('broker_report_access_log')}${opts.documentId?' where document_id = $2':''} order by created_at desc, id desc limit $1`,opts.documentId?[opts.limit,opts.documentId]:[opts.limit])).map(accessFromRow);},
  async insertEvalReceipt(row){return String((await insert('broker_eval_receipts',row as unknown as R,'receipt_id')).receipt_id);},
  async latestEvalReceipt(digest){const r=await one(`select * from ${rel('broker_eval_receipts')} where behavior_digest = $1 order by ran_at desc, receipt_id desc limit 1`,[digest]);return r?evalFromRow(r):null;},
  async takePendingOutbox(limit){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('broker_outbox')} where status = 'pending' order by created_at, event_id limit $1`,[limit])).map(outboxFromRow);},
  async markOutbox(id,outcome){await q(`select public.broker_outbox_mark($1,$2,$3)`,[id,outcome.delivered,outcome.delivered?null:outcome.error]);},
  async upsertPurgeStep(documentId,step,outcome){await q(`select public.broker_purge_step_record($1,$2,$3,$4)`,[documentId,step,outcome.ok,outcome.ok?null:outcome.error]);},
  async purgeSteps(documentId){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('broker_purge_steps')} where document_id = $1 order by step`,[documentId])).map(purgeFromRow);},
  async purgeReportText(reportId,step){
   const r=await one(`select r.status, d.sha256 from ${rel('broker_research_reports')} r join ${rel('broker_report_documents')} d on d.document_id = r.document_id where r.report_id = $1`,[reportId]);
   if(!r)throw notFound('report');if(r.status!=='withdrawn')throw new BrokerResearchDbError('report_not_withdrawn');
   if(step==='quarantine_payload')return (await q(`update public.dq_quarantine set payload = '{}'::jsonb where dataset = 'broker_research' and natural_key like $1 returning 1`,[`${String(r.sha256)}:%`])).length;
   const t=PURGE_TEXT[step];return (await update(t.table,t.patch,'report_id = $1',[reportId])).length;
  },
  quarantineResolve:(id,status,by,payload)=>fn<'resolved'|'not_found'|'already_resolved'>('public.broker_quarantine_resolve($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb)',[id,status,by,payload]),
  async verifyCandidates(limit){return (await q(`select d.* from ${rel('broker_report_documents')} d where exists (select 1 from ${rel('broker_research_reports')} r where r.document_id = d.document_id and r.status = 'published') order by d.last_verified_at asc nulls first, d.document_id limit $1`,[limit])).map(documentFromRow);},
  async registerWrite(row){return String((await insert('broker_storage_writes',row as unknown as R,'write_id')).write_id);},
  async abandonWrite(id){await q(`update ${rel('broker_storage_writes')} set status='abandoned' where write_id=$1 and status='pending'`,[id]);},
  async finishWrite(id){await q(`update ${rel('broker_storage_writes')} set status = 'done', finished_at = now() where write_id = $1 and status = 'pending'`,[id]);},
  async writesFor(documentId){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('broker_storage_writes')} where document_id = $1 order by started_at, write_id`,[documentId])).map(writeFromRow);},
  async pendingWritesFor(documentId){return (await q(`select * from ${rel('broker_storage_writes')} where document_id = $1 and status = 'pending' order by started_at, write_id`,[documentId])).map(writeFromRow);},
  async unreconciledWrites(limit){return (await q(`select w.* from ${rel('broker_storage_writes')} w join ${rel('broker_report_documents')} d on d.document_id = w.document_id where w.status in ('pending','done') and d.purge_requested_at is not null and w.next_attempt_at <= now() order by w.next_attempt_at, w.write_id limit $1`,[limit])).map(writeFromRow);},
  async retryWrite(id,nextAttemptAt,attempts){await q(`update ${rel('broker_storage_writes')} set next_attempt_at=$2, attempts=$3 where write_id=$1 and status in ('pending','done')`,[id,nextAttemptAt,attempts]);},
  async markReconciled(id,deletedAt){await q(`update ${rel('broker_storage_writes')} set status = 'reconciled', reconciled_at = now(), deleted_at=$2 where write_id = $1 and status='done' and finished_at <= $2::timestamptz`,[id,deletedAt]);},
  // ---- public: views only (the admin pool reads them exactly as anon would: owner rights, no caller-dependent predicate)
  async spreadReports(f){
   const rows=await q(`select report_id from public.broker_spread_latest_v where issuer_id=$1 and security_ticker=$2 and currency is not distinct from $3::text and published_date >= $4::date order by institution_id`,[f.issuerId,f.securityTicker,f.currency,f.from]);
   const out:PublicReportBundle[]=[];for(const row of rows){const r=await this.publicReport(String(row.report_id));if(r)out.push(r);}return out;
  },
  async publicReports(filter){
   const v:unknown[]=[];const w:string[]=[];const bind=(x:unknown)=>{v.push(x);return `$${v.length}`;};
   if(filter.institutionId)w.push(`r.institution_id = ${bind(filter.institutionId)}`);
   if(filter.scope)w.push(`r.scope = ${bind(filter.scope)}`);
   if(filter.from)w.push(`r.published_date >= ${bind(filter.from)}::date`);
   if(filter.to)w.push(`r.published_date <= ${bind(filter.to)}::date`);
   if(filter.issuerId||filter.rating||filter.securityTicker!==undefined||filter.currency!==undefined)w.push(`exists (select 1 from public.broker_report_targets_public_v t where t.report_id = r.report_id${filter.issuerId?` and t.issuer_id = ${bind(filter.issuerId)}`:''}${filter.rating?` and t.rating_normalized = ${bind(filter.rating)}`:''}${filter.securityTicker!==undefined?` and t.security_ticker = ${bind(filter.securityTicker)}`:''}${filter.currency!==undefined?` and case when t.target_price is not null then t.target_currency when t.price_at_report is not null then t.price_currency else null end is not distinct from ${bind(filter.currency)}`:''})`);
   if(filter.hasSummary)w.push(`exists (select 1 from public.broker_report_summaries_public_v s where s.report_id = r.report_id)`);
   if(filter.cursor)w.push(`(r.published_date, r.report_id) < (${bind(filter.cursor.publishedDate)}::date, ${bind(filter.cursor.reportId)}::uuid)`);
   const reports=await q(`select r.* from public.broker_reports_public_v r${w.length?` where ${w.join(' and ')}`:''} order by r.published_date desc, r.report_id desc limit ${bind(filter.limit)}`,v);
   if(!reports.length)return [];
   const ids=reports.map(r=>r.report_id);const insts=[...new Set(reports.map(r=>r.institution_id).filter(Boolean))];
   const [targets,summaries,snippets,institutions]=await Promise.all([
    q(`select ${sqlColumns(PUBLIC_TARGET_COLUMNS)} from public.broker_report_targets_public_v where report_id = any($1::uuid[])`,[ids]),
    q(`select report_id, lang from public.broker_report_summaries_public_v where report_id = any($1::uuid[])`,[ids]),
    q(`select report_id from public.broker_report_snippets_public_v where report_id = any($1::uuid[])`,[ids]),
    q(`select * from public.research_institutions_public_v where institution_id = any($1::uuid[])`,[insts]),
   ]);
   return bundles(reports,targets,summaries,snippets,institutions);
  },
  async publicReport(id){
   const report=await one(`select * from public.broker_reports_public_v where report_id = $1`,[id]);
   if(!report)return null;
   const [targets,citations,snippets,summaries,analysts,institutions]=await Promise.all([
    q(`select ${sqlColumns(PUBLIC_TARGET_COLUMNS)} from public.broker_report_targets_public_v where report_id = $1`,[id]),
    q(`select ${sqlColumns(PUBLIC_CITATION_COLUMNS)} from public.broker_report_citations_v where report_id = $1 order by target_key nulls first, field, occurrence`,[id]),
    q(`select * from public.broker_report_snippets_public_v where report_id = $1 order by page, snippet_id`,[id]),
    q(`select * from public.broker_report_summaries_public_v where report_id = $1 order by lang`,[id]),
    q(`select * from public.broker_analysts_public_v where report_id = $1 order by display_name`,[id]),
    report.institution_id?q(`select * from public.research_institutions_public_v where institution_id = $1`,[report.institution_id]):Promise.resolve([] as R[]),
   ]);
   const [b]=bundles([report],targets,summaries,snippets,institutions);
   return {...b,citations,snippets,summaries:summaries.map(publicRow),analysts};
  },
  async publicInstitutions(){return (await q(`select * from public.research_institutions_public_v order by name_en, institution_id`)).map(publicRow);},
  async publicAnalysts(o){return analystsDistinct(await q(`select report_id, analyst_id, display_name, institution_id from public.broker_analysts_public_v where institution_id = $1`,[o.institutionId]),o.limit);},
  async ratingHistory(opts){
   const v:unknown[]=[opts.securityTicker];let w='security_ticker = $1';
   if(opts.institutionId){v.push(opts.institutionId);w+=` and institution_id = $${v.length}`;}
   if(opts.currency){v.push(opts.currency);w+=` and target_currency = $${v.length}`;}
   v.push(opts.limit);
   return (await q(`select ${sqlColumns(HISTORY_COLUMNS)} from public.broker_rating_history_v where ${w} order by published_date desc, report_id desc limit $${v.length}`,v)).map(publicRow);
  },
 };
}
```

注：`J` 只把普通对象 JSON 化（jsonb 参数）；JS 数组原样作为 PostgreSQL 数组传入（`uuid[]`、`text[]`）。jsonb **数组**参数（`extractCommit` 的 `rows`、规则回执的 `results`）在调用处显式 `JSON.stringify`；`text[]` 列（`aliases`、`name_variants`）以数组字面量字符串 + `::text[]` 传入。

### Part A 未决风险

1. **SQL 未实跑。** 三个迁移和四个集成块按落地模式写成，未在本地 harness 上运行过。最可能的小错：`array_agg(distinct … order by …)`、`insert … with … select`、`on conflict` 对表达式唯一索引 `lower(btrim(raw_label))` 的推断、`jsonb_array_elements(...) e` 的列引用、视图里 `jsonb_agg(a - 'field_id' order by …)`。执行者按 Step 2/4 的循环修，**修改必须在该迁移锁定之前**。
2. **`claim.retract` 只发一次**（唯一键 `(claim_key, claim_seq)`）：`disclosure_ok` 先 false 再恢复 true 后该 claim 仍是撤回状态；恢复需要 unpublish 再 publish（新 `publication_id`）。
3. **内存实现的简化**（文件头 5 条，以及 override 不推断发行人）可能让服务单测在内存上绿、在 pg 上红。A5 的共享契约覆盖主路径；B/C 新增依赖内存行为时，把场景补进 `db-contract.ts`。
4. **`rules_input_hash` 覆盖面很宽**（含许可版本、分析师披露字段、标题）：任一变化都让草稿进入 `materialize_stale → rules_stale`；C6/C7 的流程必须在这些编辑之后自动"物化 + 规则"。
5. **托管实例差异**：视图依赖"迁移角色 = 表 owner，且 RLS 不对 owner 生效"；`session_replication_role=replica` 只在 A3 的一个本地测试里使用（需要超级用户）。
6. **体量**：块 2/3 的 `ready()` 每次约 30 条语句，A3 个别用例建 5–6 个已发布报告；超时 120–180 s。设置锁让持锁的 describe 串行，`test:db` 总时长再增加。
7. **`verifyCandidates` / `publicAnalysts` / `hasSummary`** 在 supabase 实现里先取 id 集合再在 TS 合并（`limit(5000)` / 分批 `in`），馆藏上千篇时需要改为视图或 RPC。
8. **子表守卫的父行锁**（P-R1-03）：子表写入先锁报告行。`broker_field_review` 等 RPC 是"报告 → 子行"，而直接 `update broker_report_fields …` 先锁子行再由触发器锁报告；两者对同一行并发时 PostgreSQL 会检测死锁并中止其一（重试即可）。服务只经 RPC 写证据行，直接写只出现在测试夹具里。
9. **已发布报告的披露恢复**（P-R1-08）：`broker_report_disclosure_recheck` 可在已发布报告上恢复 `disclosure_ok=true`（视图重新可见），但 `disclosure_ok` 变 false 时已经写过 `claim.retract`，同一 `claim_key` 不会再登记；要让 F4 重新收到 claim，必须 unpublish + publish。runbook 应写明这一点。
10. **批准摘要值的回填**：测试夹具直接插入 `approved` 行且不带 `db_digest` 时由触发器写入当前值；之后若夹具改了 targets / 许可而未回草稿，阻断第 15 条会报 `restricted_value_in_text:*`。第一次实跑时如有既有用例因此变红，修正夹具（在改动后重新批准），不要放宽阻断。
11. **抽取尾段的围栏**（P-R2-04）：`extractSetScope` 与 `extractFinalize` 在租约下执行；但两者之间的 `applyRules`（规则回执、隔离项）不在围栏内。租约在此期间被接管时，旧 worker 已写的回执与隔离项保留：回执只追加、并绑定当时的 `rules_input_hash`，新 worker 重跑后会写出更新的回执。

```ts
import {describe,it,expect} from 'vitest';
import {dec,decAdd,decCmp,decDiv,decMul,decRound,decShift,decString,decSub,round1} from './decimal';

describe('decimal',()=>{
 it('parses and prints canonical decimals without Number',()=>{
  expect(decString(dec('120.00'))).toBe('120');
  expect(decString(dec('-0.0'))).toBe('0');
  expect(decString(dec('1e-3'))).toBe('0.001');
  expect(decString(dec('12345678901234567890.123456789'))).toBe('12345678901234567890.123456789');
  expect(()=>dec('1,000')).toThrow('invalid_decimal');
 });
 it('adds, subtracts, multiplies and compares exactly',()=>{
  expect(decString(decAdd(dec('0.1'),dec('0.2')))).toBe('0.3');
  expect(decString(decSub(dec('120'),dec('96.5')))).toBe('23.5');
  expect(decString(decMul(dec('0.25'),dec('96')))).toBe('24');
  expect(decCmp(dec('0.30'),dec('0.3'))).toBe(0);
  expect(decCmp(dec('-1'),dec('0.5'))).toBe(-1);
 });
 it('shifts by powers of ten',()=>{
  expect(decString(decShift(dec('12.5'),-2))).toBe('0.125');
  expect(decString(decShift(dec('0.125'),2))).toBe('12.5');
  expect(decString(decShift(dec('3'),3))).toBe('3000');
 });
 it('rounds half away from zero',()=>{
  expect(round1('25.25')).toBe('25.3');
  expect(round1('25.24')).toBe('25.2');
  expect(round1('-25.25')).toBe('-25.3');
  expect(round1('0.05')).toBe('0.1');
  expect(round1('7')).toBe('7');
  expect(decString(decRound(dec('1.995'),2))).toBe('2');
 });
 it('divides for display with rounding',()=>{
  expect(decString(decDiv(dec('120'),dec('96'),6))).toBe('1.25');
  expect(decString(decDiv(dec('1'),dec('3'),4))).toBe('0.3333');
  expect(decString(decDiv(dec('-2'),dec('3'),2))).toBe('-0.67');
  expect(()=>decDiv(dec('1'),dec('0'),2)).toThrow('division_by_zero');
 });
});
```

```ts
import {describe,it,expect} from 'vitest';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {BEHAVIOR_DIGEST_INPUTS,behaviorDigest,behaviorDigestValues} from './behavior';
import * as V from './versions';

const base={extractorVersion:'f3/1',modelId:'model-a',registryHash:'r'.repeat(64),promptVersion:V.EXTRACT_PROMPT_VERSION,schemaVersion:V.SCHEMA_VERSION};

describe('behavior digest (spec §4.3)',()=>{
 it('lists exactly the spec §4.3 inputs in order',()=>{
  expect(BEHAVIOR_DIGEST_INPUTS).toEqual(['extractor_version','model_id','registry_hash','prompt_version','schema_version','typed_version','merge_version','locate_version','ticker_version','currency_marks_version']);
  expect(behaviorDigestValues(base)).toEqual(['f3/1','model-a','r'.repeat(64),'broker-extract/1','extract-schema/1','typed/1','merge/1','locate/1','parseBrokerTicker/1','currency-marks/1']);
 });
 it('is sha256 of the JSON string array and deterministic',()=>{
  const want=createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(behaviorDigestValues(base)),'utf8').digest('hex');
  expect(behaviorDigest(base)).toBe(want);
  expect(behaviorDigest({...base})).toBe(want);
  expect(want).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
 });
 it('changes when any run input changes',()=>{
  const d=behaviorDigest(base);
  for(const k of Object.keys(base) as (keyof typeof base)[])expect(behaviorDigest({...base,[k]:`${base[k]}x`})).not.toBe(d);
 });
 it('rejects missing inputs',()=>{
  expect(()=>behaviorDigest({...base,modelId:''})).toThrow('behavior_input_missing:model_id');
  expect(()=>behaviorDigest({...base,registryHash:' '})).toThrow('behavior_input_missing:registry_hash');
 });
 it('pins the version constants the digest and SQL depend on',()=>{
  expect(V).toMatchObject({TYPED_VERSION:'typed/1',MERGE_VERSION:'merge/1',LOCATE_VERSION:'locate/1',TICKER_VERSION:'parseBrokerTicker/1',CURRENCY_MARKS_VERSION:'currency-marks/1',RULES_VERSION:'broker-rules/1',DISCLOSURE_VERSION:'disclosure/1',GROUNDING_VERSION:'grounding/1',OVERLAP_VERSION:'overlap/1',SCHEMA_VERSION:'extract-schema/1',EXTRACT_PROMPT_VERSION:'broker-extract/1',SUMMARY_PROMPT_VERSION:'independent-summary/1',UPSIDE_FORMULA_VERSION:'upside/1',CLAIM_METHODOLOGY_VERSION:'broker-claim/1'});
 });
});
```

```ts
import {describe,it,expect} from 'vitest';
import {QUOTE_MAX_CHARS,validateExtraction} from './schema';
import fixture from '../fixtures/synthetic-extraction.json';

const clone=()=>structuredClone(fixture) as Record<string,any>;

describe('extract-schema/1 (spec §5.2)',()=>{
 it('accepts the synthetic fixture',()=>{
  const r=validateExtraction(clone());
  expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
 });
 it('accepts a minimal sector report with no targets and no analysts',()=>{
  const e={value:'x',page:1,quote:'x',confidence:0};
  expect(validateExtraction({scope:'sector',institution:e,analysts:[],published_date:e,title:e,targets:[]}).ok).toBe(true);
 });
 it('rejects additional properties at every level',()=>{
  const top=clone();top.extra=1;
  const ev=clone();ev.institution.note='x';
  const tg=clone();tg.targets[0].latest_price={value:'1',page:1,quote:'1',confidence:1};
  for(const v of [top,ev,tg]){const r=validateExtraction(v);expect(r.ok).toBe(false);if(!r.ok)expect(r.errors.join(';')).toContain('must NOT have additional properties');}
 });
 it('requires the top-level and target keys',()=>{
  for(const k of ['scope','institution','analysts','published_date','title','targets']){const v=clone();delete v[k];expect(validateExtraction(v).ok).toBe(false);}
  const v=clone();delete v.targets[0].ticker;expect(validateExtraction(v).ok).toBe(false);
 });
 it('enforces Evidence bounds: page ≥ 1 integer, confidence 0..1, non-empty quote ≤ 400',()=>{
  const bad=[(v:any)=>{v.title.page=0;},(v:any)=>{v.title.page=1.5;},(v:any)=>{v.title.confidence=1.01;},(v:any)=>{v.title.confidence=-0.1;},
   (v:any)=>{v.title.quote='';},(v:any)=>{v.title.quote='a'.repeat(QUOTE_MAX_CHARS+1);},(v:any)=>{v.title.value='';},(v:any)=>{v.scope='company';},
   (v:any)=>{v.analysts=[{value:'x',page:1,quote:'x'}];},(v:any)=>{v.targets[0].exchange_hint='';}];
  for(const f of bad){const v=clone();f(v);expect(validateExtraction(v).ok).toBe(false);}
  const ok=clone();ok.title.quote='字'.repeat(QUOTE_MAX_CHARS);expect(validateExtraction(ok).ok).toBe(true);
 });
 it('counts the quote cap in code points (an astral char is one)',()=>{
  const v=clone();v.title.quote='🚀'.repeat(QUOTE_MAX_CHARS);expect(validateExtraction(v).ok).toBe(true);
 });
 it('reports error paths',()=>{
  const v=clone();v.targets[1].target_price.page='2';
  const r=validateExtraction(v);
  expect(r.ok).toBe(false);if(!r.ok)expect(r.errors).toContain('/targets/1/target_price/page must be integer');
  const root=validateExtraction(null);expect(root.ok).toBe(false);if(!root.ok)expect(root.errors[0]).toMatch(/^\/ /);
 });
});
```

```ts
import {describe,it,expect} from 'vitest';
import {locateQuote,pageText,sliceText,type PageText} from './locate';
import pages from '../fixtures/synthetic-pages.json';

const P:PageText=pages;

describe('locateQuote (spec §5.2, UTF-16 code units)',()=>{
 it('locates a quote and the span slices back verbatim',()=>{
  const r=locateQuote(P,1,'US$120.00');
  expect(r).toMatchObject({status:'located',page:1,multiple_hits:null,version:'locate/1'});
  if(r.status==='located')expect(sliceText(P,1,r.char_start,r.char_end)).toBe('US$120.00');
 });
 it('counts an astral character before the quote as two code units',()=>{
  const r=locateQuote(P,2,'platforms');
  const text=pageText(P,2)!;
  expect(r.status).toBe('located');
  if(r.status==='located'){
   expect(r.char_start).toBe(text.indexOf('platforms'));
   expect(text.indexOf('platforms')-text.indexOf('🚀')).toBe(3);   // 2 units for the emoji + 1 space
   expect(sliceText(P,2,r.char_start,r.char_end)).toBe('platforms');
  }
 });
 it('locates a quote containing a surrogate pair',()=>{
  const r=locateQuote(P,2,'Internet 🚀 platforms');
  expect(r.status).toBe('located');
  if(r.status==='located')expect(r.char_end-r.char_start).toBe('Internet 🚀 platforms'.length);
 });
 it('never reports a hit that splits a surrogate pair',()=>{
  const low='🚀'.charAt(1),high='🚀'.charAt(0);
  expect(locateQuote(P,2,`${low} platforms`)).toMatchObject({status:'unverified',reason:'splits_surrogate_pair'});
  expect(locateQuote(P,2,`Internet ${high}`)).toMatchObject({status:'unverified',reason:'splits_surrogate_pair'});
 });
 it('reports every hit (overlapping ones too) and uses the first',()=>{
  const r=locateQuote(P,1,'Overweight');
  const text=pageText(P,1)!;
  expect(r).toMatchObject({status:'located',char_start:text.indexOf('Overweight'),multiple_hits:[text.indexOf('Overweight'),text.lastIndexOf('Overweight')]});
  expect(locateQuote([{page:1,text:'aaa'}],1,'aa')).toMatchObject({char_start:0,multiple_hits:[0,1]});
 });
 it('a quote that differs by one space is unverified (acceptance sample 2)',()=>{
  expect(locateQuote(P,1,'US$ 120.00')).toMatchObject({status:'unverified',reason:'not_found'});
  expect(locateQuote(P,1,'target price  US$120.00')).toMatchObject({status:'unverified',reason:'not_found'});
 });
 it('does not search other pages, normalize case or width',()=>{
  expect(locateQuote(P,2,'US$120.00').status).toBe('unverified');
  expect(locateQuote(P,1,'us$120.00').status).toBe('unverified');
  expect(locateQuote(P,1,'ＵＳ$120.00').status).toBe('unverified');
 });
 it('missing page and empty quote',()=>{
  expect(locateQuote(P,9,'x')).toMatchObject({status:'unverified',reason:'page_missing',page:9});
  expect(locateQuote(P,1,'')).toMatchObject({status:'unverified',reason:'empty_quote'});
 });
 it('rejects duplicate page numbers in an artifact',()=>{
  expect(()=>locateQuote([{page:1,text:'a'},{page:1,text:'b'}],1,'a')).toThrow('duplicate_page:1');
 });
});

describe('sliceText',()=>{
 const T:PageText=[{page:1,text:'ab🚀cd'}];
 it('slices by code units and fails closed on bad spans',()=>{
  expect(sliceText(T,1,2,4)).toBe('🚀');
  expect(sliceText(T,1,0,0)).toBe('');
  expect(sliceText(T,1,3,4)).toBeNull();      // starts inside the pair
  expect(sliceText(T,1,2,3)).toBeNull();      // ends inside the pair
  expect(sliceText(T,1,-1,2)).toBeNull();
  expect(sliceText(T,1,3,2)).toBeNull();
  expect(sliceText(T,1,0,7)).toBeNull();
  expect(sliceText(T,1,0.5,2)).toBeNull();
  expect(sliceText(T,2,0,1)).toBeNull();
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/decimal.ts
// Exact decimal arithmetic on decimal strings for rules and text checks (plan §契约补充 数值;
// spec §5.3, §7.1 R2/R6, §4.11, §6.4). Values never pass through Number: a decimal is a scaled
// BigInt (units / 10^scale) parsed from canonicalDecimal. Rounding is half away from zero.
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../facts/json-numbers';

export interface Dec{units:bigint;scale:number}
const pow10=(n:number)=>10n**BigInt(n);
/** Parses any decimal literal accepted by canonicalDecimal (throws invalid_decimal otherwise). */
export function dec(raw:string):Dec{
 const c=canonicalDecimal(raw);
 const neg=c.startsWith('-');
 const [i,f='']=(neg?c.slice(1):c).split('.');
 const units=BigInt(i+f);
 return {units:neg?-units:units,scale:f.length};
}
export function decString(d:Dec):string{
 const neg=d.units<0n;
 let digits=(neg?-d.units:d.units).toString();
 if(d.scale>0){digits=digits.padStart(d.scale+1,'0');digits=`${digits.slice(0,-d.scale)}.${digits.slice(-d.scale)}`;}
 return canonicalDecimal(`${neg?'-':''}${digits}`);
}
const align=(a:Dec,b:Dec):[bigint,bigint,number]=>{const s=Math.max(a.scale,b.scale);return [a.units*pow10(s-a.scale),b.units*pow10(s-b.scale),s];};
export const decAdd=(a:Dec,b:Dec):Dec=>{const [x,y,s]=align(a,b);return {units:x+y,scale:s};};
export const decSub=(a:Dec,b:Dec):Dec=>{const [x,y,s]=align(a,b);return {units:x-y,scale:s};};
export const decMul=(a:Dec,b:Dec):Dec=>({units:a.units*b.units,scale:a.scale+b.scale});
export const decCmp=(a:Dec,b:Dec):-1|0|1=>{const [x,y]=align(a,b);return x<y?-1:x>y?1:0;};
export const decAbs=(a:Dec):Dec=>({units:a.units<0n?-a.units:a.units,scale:a.scale});
export const decNeg=(a:Dec):Dec=>({units:-a.units,scale:a.scale});
export const decSign=(a:Dec):-1|0|1=>a.units<0n?-1:a.units>0n?1:0;
/** a × 10^k (k may be negative). */
export function decShift(a:Dec,k:number):Dec{
 if(k<=0)return {units:a.units,scale:a.scale-k};
 return a.scale>=k?{units:a.units,scale:a.scale-k}:{units:a.units*pow10(k-a.scale),scale:0};
}
/** Rounds half away from zero to `dp` decimal places. */
export function decRound(a:Dec,dp:number):Dec{
 if(a.scale<=dp)return a;
 const drop=pow10(a.scale-dp);
 const neg=a.units<0n,abs=neg?-a.units:a.units;
 let q=abs/drop;
 if((abs%drop)*2n>=drop)q+=1n;
 return {units:neg?-q:q,scale:dp};
}
/** a / b rounded half away from zero to `dp` places; throws division_by_zero. Display only. */
export function decDiv(a:Dec,b:Dec,dp:number):Dec{
 if(b.units===0n)throw new Error('division_by_zero');
 // a/b = (a.units·10^b.scale)/(b.units·10^a.scale); scale numerator by 10^(dp+1) for rounding
 const num=a.units*pow10(b.scale+dp+1),den=b.units*pow10(a.scale);
 const neg=(num<0n)!==(den<0n);
 const q=(num<0n?-num:num)/(den<0n?-den:den);
 const r=q%10n>=5n?q/10n+1n:q/10n;
 return {units:neg?-r:r,scale:dp};
}
/** Canonical decimal string rounded to one decimal place (spec §4.11, §6.4 comparisons). */
export const round1=(raw:string):string=>decString(decRound(dec(raw),1));
export const decimalCompare=(a:string,b:string)=>decCmp(dec(a),dec(b));
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/behavior.ts
// Extraction behavior digest (spec §4.3 broker_report_runs.behavior_digest, §4.10 eval receipts,
// §4.4 blocker 13). The digest identifies everything that changes extraction output and nothing
// else: it is independent of the deployment code_version, so an unrelated deploy does not
// invalidate a gold evaluation receipt. Changing the list below requires a new version string.
// Hash = sha256 hex of the UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify(<ordered string array>); for an array of
// strings this is byte-identical to canonicalJson (hash.ts, Task A4).
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {CURRENCY_MARKS_VERSION,LOCATE_VERSION,MERGE_VERSION,TICKER_VERSION,TYPED_VERSION} from './versions';

/** Ordered names of the digest inputs (spec §4.3; asserted verbatim by behavior.test.ts). */
export const BEHAVIOR_DIGEST_INPUTS=['extractor_version','model_id','registry_hash','prompt_version','schema_version','typed_version','merge_version','locate_version','ticker_version','currency_marks_version'] as const;
export interface BehaviorInputs{extractorVersion:string;modelId:string;registryHash:string;promptVersion:string;schemaVersion:string}

/** Input values in BEHAVIOR_DIGEST_INPUTS order; run-supplied values first, module constants after. */
export function behaviorDigestValues(i:BehaviorInputs):string[]{
 const run=[i.extractorVersion,i.modelId,i.registryHash,i.promptVersion,i.schemaVersion];
 run.forEach((v,k)=>{if(typeof v!=='string'||v.trim()==='')throw new Error(`behavior_input_missing:${BEHAVIOR_DIGEST_INPUTS[k]}`);});
 return [...run,TYPED_VERSION,MERGE_VERSION,LOCATE_VERSION,TICKER_VERSION,CURRENCY_MARKS_VERSION];
}
export function behaviorDigest(i:BehaviorInputs):string{
 return createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(behaviorDigestValues(i)),'utf8').digest('hex');
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/extract/schema.ts
// Extraction schema extract-schema/1 (spec §5.2) compiled with ajv (strict, all errors). One
// Evidence = {value, page ≥ 1, quote ≤ QUOTE_MAX_CHARS, confidence 0..1}; currencies are their own
// Evidence whose quote is the mark on the page and whose value is the ISO code. Every object is
// additionalProperties:false. The retry-once policy on failure lives in extract/run.ts (Task C5).
import Ajv from 'ajv';
import {SCHEMA_VERSION} from '../versions';

/** Spec §15.3 proposal (D7): quote cap in characters (ajv counts Unicode code points). */
export const QUOTE_MAX_CHARS=400;
export type ExtractionScope='single_issuer'|'multi_issuer'|'sector'|'macro_strategy';
export interface Evidence{value:string;page:number;quote:string;confidence:number}
export interface TargetExtraction{
 ticker:Evidence;exchange_hint?:string;rating?:Evidence;target_price?:Evidence;target_currency?:Evidence;target_horizon_months?:Evidence;
 price_at_report?:Evidence;price_currency?:Evidence;price_as_of_date?:Evidence;upside_stated?:Evidence;
}
export interface DocumentExtraction{
 scope:ExtractionScope;institution:Evidence;analysts:Evidence[];published_date:Evidence;title:Evidence;
 sector?:Evidence;valuation_method?:Evidence;wacc?:Evidence;terminal_growth?:Evidence;terminal_value_share?:Evidence;
 targets:TargetExtraction[];
}

const evidence={type:'object',additionalProperties:false,required:['value','page','quote','confidence'],properties:{
 value:{type:'string',minLength:1},page:{type:'integer',minimum:1},
 quote:{type:'string',minLength:1,maxLength:QUOTE_MAX_CHARS},confidence:{type:'number',minimum:0,maximum:1},
}};
const ev={$ref:'#/$defs/evidence'};
/** JSON Schema of one chunk's extraction; also the schema sent to the LLM (Task C5). */
export const EXTRACT_SCHEMA={
 $id:SCHEMA_VERSION,$defs:{evidence},
 type:'object',additionalProperties:false,required:['scope','institution','analysts','published_date','title','targets'],
 properties:{
  scope:{enum:['single_issuer','multi_issuer','sector','macro_strategy']},
  institution:ev,analysts:{type:'array',items:ev},published_date:ev,title:ev,
  sector:ev,valuation_method:ev,wacc:ev,terminal_growth:ev,terminal_value_share:ev,
  targets:{type:'array',items:{type:'object',additionalProperties:false,required:['ticker'],properties:{
   ticker:ev,exchange_hint:{type:'string',minLength:1,maxLength:40},rating:ev,target_price:ev,target_currency:ev,
   target_horizon_months:ev,price_at_report:ev,price_currency:ev,price_as_of_date:ev,upside_stated:ev,
  }}},
 },
} as const;

const validate=new Ajv({strict:true,allErrors:true}).compile(EXTRACT_SCHEMA);
export type ValidationResult={ok:true;value:DocumentExtraction}|{ok:false;errors:string[]};
/** Validates one parsed LLM response; errors are `<instancePath> <message>` strings (empty path = root). */
export function validateExtraction(json:unknown):ValidationResult{
 if(validate(json))return {ok:true,value:json as unknown as DocumentExtraction};
 return {ok:false,errors:(validate.errors??[]).map(e=>`${e.instancePath||'/'} ${e.message??'invalid'}`)};
}
```

`src/lib/broker-research/extract/locate.ts`:
```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/extract/locate.ts
// Quote location in parsed page text (spec §5.2 定位, §4.6 offsets, §7.1 R1). Offsets are UTF-16
// code units of the page string exactly as stored in the parse artifact (JavaScript string
// indices). A hit may not start or end inside a surrogate pair. First hit wins; more than one hit
// is reported as multiple_hits (all start offsets, overlapping hits included). No normalization of
// any kind: a quote that differs by one space is not found → 'unverified'.
// PageText is the minimal artifact reader shape shared with rules.ts (R1) and the verify cron;
// the F3 artifact adapter (Task C4) maps the artifact JSON onto it.
import {LOCATE_VERSION} from '../versions';

export type PageText={page:number;text:string}[];
export type LocateResult=
 |{version:string;status:'located';page:number;char_start:number;char_end:number;multiple_hits:number[]|null}
 |{version:string;status:'unverified';page:number;reason:'page_missing'|'empty_quote'|'not_found'|'splits_surrogate_pair'};

const isHigh=(c:number)=>c>=0xd800&&c<=0xdbff;
const isLow=(c:number)=>c>=0xdc00&&c<=0xdfff;
/** True when offset `i` falls between the two halves of a surrogate pair. */
const insidePair=(t:string,i:number)=>i>0&&i<t.length&&isHigh(t.charCodeAt(i-1))&&isLow(t.charCodeAt(i));

/** Text of one page; null when the page is absent. Duplicate page numbers are an artifact error. */
export function pageText(pages:PageText,page:number):string|null{
 const hits=pages.filter(p=>p.page===page);
 if(hits.length>1)throw new Error(`duplicate_page:${page}`);
 return hits[0]?.text??null;
}

export function locateQuote(pages:PageText,page:number,quote:string):LocateResult{
 const miss=(reason:'page_missing'|'empty_quote'|'not_found'|'splits_surrogate_pair'):LocateResult=>({version:LOCATE_VERSION,status:'unverified',page,reason});
 if(quote.length===0)return miss('empty_quote');
 const text=pageText(pages,page);
 if(text===null)return miss('page_missing');
 const hits:number[]=[];let raw=0;
 for(let i=text.indexOf(quote);i!==-1;i=text.indexOf(quote,i+1)){
  raw++;
  if(!insidePair(text,i)&&!insidePair(text,i+quote.length))hits.push(i);
 }
 if(hits.length===0)return miss(raw>0?'splits_surrogate_pair':'not_found');
 return {version:LOCATE_VERSION,status:'located',page,char_start:hits[0],char_end:hits[0]+quote.length,multiple_hits:hits.length>1?hits:null};
}

/** The artifact text at (page, [start, end)); null for a missing page, out-of-range, non-integer or pair-splitting span (fails closed for R1). */
export function sliceText(pages:PageText,page:number,start:number,end:number):string|null{
 const text=pageText(pages,page);
 if(text===null||!Number.isInteger(start)||!Number.isInteger(end)||start<0||end<start||end>text.length)return null;
 if(insidePair(text,start)||insidePair(text,end))return null;
 return text.slice(start,end);
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/extract/typed.ts
// Typed conversion of an evidence value (spec §5.3 table, TYPED_VERSION) and the versioned
// currency-mark table (spec §5.2, CURRENCY_MARKS_VERSION). A failed conversion never throws:
// value_num/value_date/value_currency stay null, value_unit is null, value_text keeps the
// original string, and `failure` names why (the field can still be confirmed; materialization
// then produces no number, spec §5.3). Numbers are canonical decimal strings, never JS numbers.
// Price rows carry no currency: it comes from the same target's *_currency field at
// materialization (spec §5.3).
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../../facts/json-numbers';
import {dec,decShift,decString} from '../decimal';
import type {FieldName,TypedValue} from '../types';

/** Page marks → ISO 4217 (currency-marks/1). Keys are matched after ASCII upper-casing. Bare '$', '¥', '元' are ambiguous and deliberately absent. */
export const CURRENCY_MARKS:Readonly<Record<string,string>>=Object.freeze({
 'US$':'USD','USD':'USD','美元':'USD','美金':'USD',
 'HK$':'HKD','HKD':'HKD','港元':'HKD','港币':'HKD','港幣':'HKD',
 'RMB':'CNY','CNY':'CNY','CN¥':'CNY','人民币':'CNY','人民幣':'CNY',
});
const KNOWN_ISO=new Set(Object.values(CURRENCY_MARKS));
const MARKS_LONGEST_FIRST=Object.keys(CURRENCY_MARKS).sort((a,b)=>b.length-a.length);
export type TypedFailure='not_a_number'|'not_a_percentage'|'not_months'|'not_a_date'|'unknown_currency'|'currency_mark_mismatch';
export interface TypedResult{value:TypedValue;failure:TypedFailure|null}

const PRICE_FIELDS:readonly FieldName[]=['target_price','price_at_report'];
const CURRENCY_FIELDS:readonly FieldName[]=['target_currency','price_currency'];
const PCT_FIELDS:readonly FieldName[]=['upside_stated','wacc','terminal_growth','terminal_value_share'];
const DATE_FIELDS:readonly FieldName[]=['published_date','price_as_of_date'];

const upperAscii=(s:string)=>s.replace(/[a-z]/g,c=>c.toUpperCase());
/** NFKC (full-width digits, '％', 'ＨＫ＄'), U+2212 minus → '-', trimmed. */
const clean=(s:string)=>s.normalize('NFKC').replace(/−/g,'-').trim();
const plain=(value_text:string,failure:TypedFailure|null=null):TypedResult=>({value:{value_text,value_num:null,value_currency:null,value_unit:null,value_date:null},failure});

/** ISO codes of every currency mark occurring in `s`, longest mark first at each position. */
export function currencyMarksIn(s:string):Set<string>{
 const t=upperAscii(clean(s));const out=new Set<string>();
 for(let i=0;i<t.length;){
  const m=MARKS_LONGEST_FIRST.find(k=>t.startsWith(k,i));
  if(m){out.add(CURRENCY_MARKS[m]);i+=m.length;}else i++;
 }
 return out;
}
const NUMBER=/^([+-]?)(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)(\.\d+)?$/;
/** Canonical decimal of a plain number with optional sign, thousands commas and decimals; null otherwise. */
function parseNumber(s:string):string|null{
 const m=NUMBER.exec(s);
 return m?canonicalDecimal(`${m[1]==='-'?'-':''}${m[2].replace(/,/g,'')}${m[3]??''}`):null;
}
/** A price string: currency marks, '$', '¥', '元' and whitespace removed around one plain number. */
function parsePrice(s:string):string|null{
 let t=upperAscii(clean(s));
 for(const m of MARKS_LONGEST_FIRST)t=t.split(m).join('');
 return parseNumber(t.replace(/[$¥元]/g,'').replace(/\s+/g,''));
}
function parsePct(s:string):string|null{
 const m=/^(.*?)\s*%$/.exec(clean(s));
 const n=m?parseNumber(m[1].replace(/\s+/g,'')):null;
 return n===null?null:decString(decShift(dec(n),-2));
}
const CN_HORIZON:Readonly<Record<string,number>>={'半年':6,'一年':12,'两年':24,'二年':24,'兩年':24};
function parseMonths(s:string):string|null{
 const t=clean(s);
 if(CN_HORIZON[t]!==undefined)return String(CN_HORIZON[t]);
 const mo=/^(\d{1,3})\s*-?\s*(?:months?|mos?|个月|個月)$/i.exec(t);
 if(mo)return canonicalDecimal(mo[1]);
 const yr=/^(\d{1,2})\s*-?\s*(?:years?|yrs?|年)$/i.exec(t);
 return yr?String(Number(yr[1])*12):null;
}
const MONTHS=['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'];
function monthIndex(name:string):number|null{
 const n=name.toLowerCase().replace(/\.$/,'');
 const i=MONTHS.indexOf(n.slice(0,3));
 if(i<0)return null;
 const full=['january','february','march','april','may','june','july','august','september','october','november','december'][i];
 return n.length===3||n===full||(i===8&&n==='sept')?i+1:null;
}
function isoDate(y:number,m:number,d:number):string|null{
 const iso=`${String(y).padStart(4,'0')}-${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d).padStart(2,'0')}`;
 const ms=Date.parse(`${iso}T00:00:00Z`);
 return Number.isNaN(ms)||new Date(ms).toISOString().slice(0,10)!==iso?null:iso;
}
/** Unambiguous date forms only; D/M/Y vs M/D/Y numeric forms (e.g. 05/11/2026) are rejected. */
function parseDate(s:string):string|null{
 const t=clean(s).replace(/\s+/g,' ');
 let m=/^(\d{4})[-/.](\d{1,2})[-/.](\d{1,2})$/.exec(t)??/^(\d{4}) ?年 ?(\d{1,2}) ?月 ?(\d{1,2}) ?日$/.exec(t);
 if(m)return isoDate(Number(m[1]),Number(m[2]),Number(m[3]));
 m=/^(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)? ([A-Za-z]+\.?),? (\d{4})$/.exec(t);
 if(m){const mi=monthIndex(m[2]);return mi?isoDate(Number(m[3]),mi,Number(m[1])):null;}
 m=/^([A-Za-z]+\.?) (\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?,? (\d{4})$/.exec(t);
 if(m){const mi=monthIndex(m[1]);return mi?isoDate(Number(m[3]),mi,Number(m[2])):null;}
 return null;
}

/**
 * Spec §5.3 conversion. `quote` is used only for currency fields: the page mark it contains must
 * map to exactly the ISO code of the value (spec §5.2), otherwise currency_mark_mismatch.
 */
export function toTyped(field:FieldName,valueText:string,quote?:string):TypedResult{
 if(PRICE_FIELDS.includes(field)){
  const n=parsePrice(valueText);
  return n===null?plain(valueText,'not_a_number'):{value:{value_text:n,value_num:n,value_currency:null,value_unit:'price',value_date:null},failure:null};
 }
 if(CURRENCY_FIELDS.includes(field)){
  const v=upperAscii(clean(valueText));
  const iso=/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(v)?v:CURRENCY_MARKS[v];
  if(!iso||!KNOWN_ISO.has(iso))return plain(valueText,'unknown_currency');
  if(quote!==undefined){const marks=currencyMarksIn(quote);if(marks.size!==1||!marks.has(iso))return plain(valueText,'currency_mark_mismatch');}
  return {value:{value_text:iso,value_num:null,value_currency:iso,value_unit:null,value_date:null},failure:null};
 }
 if(PCT_FIELDS.includes(field)){
  const n=parsePct(valueText);
  return n===null?plain(valueText,'not_a_percentage'):{value:{value_text:valueText,value_num:n,value_currency:null,value_unit:'pct',value_date:null},failure:null};
 }
 if(field==='target_horizon'){
  const n=parseMonths(valueText);
  return n===null?plain(valueText,'not_months'):{value:{value_text:valueText,value_num:n,value_currency:null,value_unit:'months',value_date:null},failure:null};
 }
 if(DATE_FIELDS.includes(field)){
  const d=parseDate(valueText);
  return d===null?plain(valueText,'not_a_date'):{value:{value_text:valueText,value_num:null,value_currency:null,value_unit:null,value_date:d},failure:null};
 }
 return plain(valueText);
}
```
