```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/withdraw.ts
// Withdraw and purge (spec §6.5). Withdraw flips the document (the DB trigger withdraws the report and writes
// claim.retract). Purge is a resumable step table broker_purge_steps: each step runs only if not yet done; a failure is
// recorded (attempts+1, last_error) and the other steps still run; purged_at is set when all are done. Text purges of
// fields/snippets/summaries/quarantine payloads are BrokerResearchDb.purgeReportText (contract); O11 default: summary
// text is kept, status → rejected.
import {auditAdmin} from './audit';
import {BrokerError,conflict,notFound} from './errors';
import {LEASE_SECONDS} from './parse';
import {brokerPaths} from './storage';
import {deleteRegisteredPath} from './tracked-write';
import type {CoreDeps} from './deps';
import type {DocumentRow,PurgeStep,PurgeStepRow} from './types';

export const PURGE_STEPS:readonly PurgeStep[]=['pdf','artifacts','runs','fields_text','snippets_text','summaries','quarantine_payload'];
type WDeps=Pick<CoreDeps,'db'|'storage'|'tables'|'now'|'newId'>;

export async function withdrawDocument(deps:WDeps,documentId:string,i:{reason:string;purge:boolean},by:string):Promise<{purge:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof purgeDocument>>|null}>{
 const doc=await deps.db.getDocument(documentId);if(!doc)throw notFound('document_not_found');
 await deps.db.withdrawWithIntent(documentId,i.reason,i.purge,by); // one atomic DB operation, also on already-withdrawn retries
 if(doc.status!=='withdrawn'){
  await deps.db.logAccess({document_id:documentId,user_id:by,action:'withdraw',detail:{reason:i.reason}});
  await auditAdmin(deps.tables,by,'broker_research.withdraw',documentId,{reason:i.reason},deps.now());
 }
 if(!i.purge)return {purge:null};
 try{return {purge:await purgeDocument(deps,documentId,by)};}
 catch(e){if(e instanceof BrokerError&&e.code==='lease_held')return {purge:null};throw e;}   // a writer holds the lease: retry purge later (409 from the purge route)
}

export async function purgeDocument(deps:WDeps,documentId:string,by:string):Promise<{done:boolean;steps:PurgeStepRow[]}>{
 const doc=await deps.db.getDocument(documentId);if(!doc)throw notFound('document_not_found');
 if(doc.status!=='withdrawn')throw conflict('document_not_withdrawn');
 // Persist intent BEFORE attempting the lease or any purge step. It survives lease_held and incomplete purges.
 if(!doc.purge_requested_at)await deps.db.updateDocument(documentId,{purge_requested_at:deps.now().toISOString(),purge_requested_by:by});
 // The lease prevents new workers, but cannot cancel already-dispatched remote writes.
 const token=deps.newId();
 if(!await deps.db.claimLease(documentId,token,LEASE_SECONDS))throw conflict('lease_held');
 try{return await purgeSteps(deps,doc,by);}
 finally{await deps.db.fencedUpdateDocument(documentId,token,{releaseLease:true});}
}
/** Every object the bucket may hold for a document: exact paths (PDF, parse artifacts, run request/response) that still
 * exist, plus everything under its listable prefixes (page images, gold-evaluation calls). Removes them; returns them.
 * Used by purge's final sweep and the verify cron's purged-document reconciliation (E1). */
export async function sweepDocumentObjects(deps:Pick<CoreDeps,'db'|'storage'|'now'>,doc:DocumentRow):Promise<string[]>{
 const runs=await deps.db.listRuns(doc.document_id);const parses=runs.filter(r=>r.kind==='parse');
 const exact=[doc.storage_path,...parses.map(r=>brokerPaths.artifact(doc.sha256,r.run_id)),...runs.flatMap(r=>[r.request_path,r.response_path]).filter((p):p is string=>p!==null)];
 const found:string[]=[];
 for(const p of exact)if(await deps.storage.exists(p))found.push(p);
 for(const prefix of [brokerPaths.evalPrefix(doc.sha256),...parses.map(r=>brokerPaths.pagesPrefix(doc.sha256,r.run_id))])found.push(...await deps.storage.list(prefix));
 if(found.length)await deps.storage.remove(found);
 for(const w of await deps.db.writesFor(doc.document_id)){
  if(w.status==='abandoned')continue;
  found.push(...await deleteRegisteredPath(deps.storage,w.path));
  const deletedAt=deps.now().toISOString();
  if(w.status==='done'&&w.finished_at!==null&&w.finished_at<=deletedAt)await deps.db.markReconciled(w.write_id,deletedAt);
 }   // the durable inventory (P-R5-01..03)
 return [...new Set(found)];
}
async function purgeSteps(deps:WDeps,doc:DocumentRow,by:string):Promise<{done:boolean;steps:PurgeStepRow[]}>{
 const documentId=doc.document_id;
 const report=await deps.db.reportByDocument(documentId);
 const done=new Set((await deps.db.purgeSteps(documentId)).filter(s=>s.status==='done').map(s=>s.step));
 const runs=await deps.db.listRuns(documentId);
 const exec:Record<PurgeStep,()=>Promise<void>>={
  pdf:()=>deps.storage.remove([doc.storage_path]),
  artifacts:async()=>{for(const r of runs.filter(x=>x.kind==='parse')){await deps.storage.remove([brokerPaths.artifact(doc.sha256,r.run_id)]);const pages=await deps.storage.list(brokerPaths.pagesPrefix(doc.sha256,r.run_id));if(pages.length)await deps.storage.remove(pages);}},
  runs:async()=>{
   const paths=runs.flatMap(r=>[r.request_path,r.response_path]).filter((p):p is string=>p!==null);
   paths.push(...await deps.storage.list(brokerPaths.evalPrefix(doc.sha256)));          // gold-evaluation calls of this document (P-R2-02)
   if(paths.length)await deps.storage.remove(paths);
   // Known paths are deleted now; uncertain remote writes remain eligible for daily reconciliation indefinitely.
   for(const w of await deps.db.writesFor(documentId)){
    if(w.status==='abandoned')continue;
    await deleteRegisteredPath(deps.storage,w.path);
    const deletedAt=deps.now().toISOString();
    if(w.status==='done'&&w.finished_at!==null&&w.finished_at<=deletedAt)await deps.db.markReconciled(w.write_id,deletedAt);
   }
  },
  fields_text:async()=>{if(report)await deps.db.purgeReportText(report.report_id,'fields_text');},
  snippets_text:async()=>{if(report)await deps.db.purgeReportText(report.report_id,'snippets_text');},
  summaries:async()=>{if(report)await deps.db.purgeReportText(report.report_id,'summaries');},
  quarantine_payload:async()=>{if(report)await deps.db.purgeReportText(report.report_id,'quarantine_payload');},
 };
 for(const step of PURGE_STEPS){
  if(done.has(step))continue;
  try{await exec[step]();await deps.db.upsertPurgeStep(documentId,step,{ok:true});}
  catch(e){await deps.db.upsertPurgeStep(documentId,step,{ok:false,error:(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)).slice(0,500)});}
 }
 const steps=await deps.db.purgeSteps(documentId);
 let all=PURGE_STEPS.every(s=>steps.some(x=>x.step===s&&x.status==='done'));
 // final sweep (P-R4-04): before completion is recorded, every exact path and prefix of the document is listed and
 // emptied once more. Remote writes can still land later; daily reconciliation continues after purged_at.
 let swept:string[]=[];
 if(all){try{swept=await sweepDocumentObjects(deps,doc);}catch{all=false;}}
 if(all&&!doc.purged_at)await deps.db.updateDocument(documentId,{purged_at:deps.now().toISOString()});
 await deps.db.logAccess({document_id:documentId,user_id:by,action:'purge',detail:{done:all,failed:steps.filter(s=>s.status!=='done').map(s=>s.step),swept:swept.length}});
 if(all)await auditAdmin(deps.tables,by,'broker_research.purge',documentId,{},deps.now());
 return {done:all,steps};
}
```

（四个文本步都走契约方法 `purgeReportText`，内存实现与 pg 实现同规则；`withdraw.test.ts` 在内存库上断言，C8 的 pg 集成测试在真实库上再断言一次。）

**评测匹配（规格 §11.3）**：同 `(target_key, field, occurrence)`；完整类型化值相等（`value_num` 用 `decimalEquals`、容差 0，`value_currency`/`value_unit`/`value_date` 逐项相等，null 只等于 null；两边都没有任何类型化分量时才比较小写并折叠空白的 `value_text`）；页码相等；跨度重叠（未定位的候选不匹配）。`per_field[field] = {tp,fp,fn,precision,recall}`，`precision = tp/(tp+fp)`（分母 0 → null），`recall = tp/(tp+fn)`（分母 0 → null）；`absence`：标注 `absent` 且抽取无该 `(target_key,field)` → tp，标注 `absent` 但抽取有 → fp，标注有值但抽取完全没有该 `(target_key,field)` → fn。`precision_min/recall_min` = 非 null 值的最小值；`passed = precision_min ≥ 0.95 && recall_min ≥ 0.95`（任一为 null → false）。`corpus_hash = sha256Hex(canonicalJson(按 sha256 排序的 manifest.docs))`。

```ts
  const s=evalStats(gold,[{sha256:'a'.repeat(64),rows:[g('target_price','120.0','120.0',1,2,8),g('rating','overweight',null,1,30,40),g('wacc','9%','0.09',2,0,5,null,{value_unit:'pct'})]}]);

  expect(s.per_field.rating).toEqual({tp:0,fp:1,fn:1,precision:0,recall:0});   // span does not overlap
  expect(s.per_field.wacc).toEqual({tp:0,fp:1,fn:0,precision:0,recall:null});

  const cur:GoldDoc[]=[{sha256:'c'.repeat(64),fields:[g('target_currency','US$',null,1,0,3,'ZZBR',{value_currency:'USD',value_unit:null}),g('published_date','5 Nov 2026',null,1,10,20,null,{value_date:'2026-11-05',value_unit:null}),g('upside_stated','25%','0.25',1,30,33,'ZZBR',{value_unit:'pct'}),g('target_price','120','120',1,40,43)],absent:[]}];

 it('a reparse between preflight and extraction is refused: no receipt labelled with the old parser (P-R2-03)',async()=>{
  const d=memoryBrokerDeps();const lic=await seedLicence(d.db);

describe('gold-evaluation calls and purge (P-R2-02)',()=>{
 it('the calls are stored under the document, and purge removes them, also after a partial evaluation failure',async()=>{
  const d=memoryBrokerDeps();const lic=await seedLicence(d.db);

  const d=memoryBrokerDeps();const lic=await seedLicence(d.db);const a=await seedDocument(d,lic.licence_id);

  d.llm={info:()=>base.info(),complete:async(req)=>{await gate;return base.complete(req);}};
  const run=runGoldEval(d,[{sha256:a.sha256,fields:[],absent:[]}],{by:ADMIN_ID,dryRun:false});
  const outcome=run.then(()=>'resolved',(e:{code?:string})=>e.code);
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));                                                      // the evaluation holds the lease, waiting on the LLM
  expect((await withdrawDocument(d,a.document_id,{reason:'licence ended',purge:true},ADMIN_ID)).purge).toBeNull();

  expect(await d.storage.list(brokerPaths.evalPrefix(a.sha256))).toEqual([]);
  expect((await d.db.getDocument(a.document_id))!.lease_token).toBeNull();                    // released
  const p=await purgeDocument(d,a.document_id,ADMIN_ID);
  expect(p.done).toBe(true);expect((await d.db.getDocument(a.document_id))!.purged_at).not.toBeNull();
  expect([...d.storage.objects.keys()].filter(k=>k.startsWith(`eval/${a.sha256}/`))).toEqual([]);

 it('an upload in flight past the lease: purge deletes known paths; the late object is self-deleted (or removed by the purge retry); a terminated worker stays pending indefinitely (P-R5-01)',async()=>{
  const tables=memoryTableClient({dq_quarantine:['id'],ingest_batches:['batch_id'],research_audit_log:['id']});
  for(const mode of ['self_delete','self_delete_fails','worker_terminated'] as const){
   const clock={t:T0.getTime()};const mdb=memoryBrokerResearchDb({tables,now:()=>new Date(clock.t)});
   const d=memoryBrokerDeps({tables,db:mdb});const tick=(ms:number)=>{clock.t+=ms;d.advance(ms);};
   const lic=await seedLicence(d.db);const a=await seedDocument(d,lic.licence_id,syntheticPdf(`late-${mode}`));
   await runParse(d,a.document_id,ADMIN_ID,{deadline:DEADLINE()});
   d.llm=recordedLlmPort([EXTRACT_RESPONSE]);
   const upload=d.storage.upload.bind(d.storage);let release!:()=>void;const gate=new Promise<void>(r=>{release=r;});let started=false;
   d.storage.upload=async(path,body,type)=>{if(path.startsWith('eval/')&&!started){started=true;await gate;}return upload(path,body,type);};
   const outcome=runGoldEval(d,[{sha256:a.sha256,fields:[],absent:[]}],{by:ADMIN_ID,dryRun:false}).then(()=>'resolved',(e:{code?:string})=>e.code);
   for(let k=0;k<50&&!started;k++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));
   expect(started).toBe(true);                                                                // registered, fenced, bytes in flight
   expect((await d.db.pendingWritesFor(a.document_id)).map(w=>w.writer)).toEqual(['eval']);
   tick(301_000);                                                                             // the upload outlives the lease
   const w=await withdrawDocument(d,a.document_id,{reason:'licence ended',purge:true},ADMIN_ID);
   expect(w.purge?.done).toBe(true);
   expect((await d.db.purgeSteps(a.document_id)).find(s=>s.step==='runs')).toMatchObject({status:'done'});
   expect((await d.db.getDocument(a.document_id))!.purged_at).not.toBeNull();
   if(mode==='worker_terminated'){
    // Worker termination is not completion; purged_at does not remove pending rows from reconciliation.
    expect((await purgeDocument(d,a.document_id,ADMIN_ID)).done).toBe(true);
    tick(30*86_400_000);
    expect((await purgeDocument(d,a.document_id,ADMIN_ID)).done).toBe(true);
    expect((await d.db.unreconciledWrites(10)).map(x=>x.writer)).toEqual(['eval']);           // still queued for the verify cron (E1)
    release();expect(await outcome).toBe('document_withdrawn');                                      // (test teardown: let the stuck call end)
    continue;
   }
   if(mode==='self_delete_fails')d.storage.failNext('remove','down');
   release();
   expect(await outcome).toBe('document_withdrawn');                                                  // post-upload fence fails
   const left=()=>[...d.storage.objects.keys()].filter(k=>k.startsWith(`eval/${a.sha256}/`));
   expect(left()).toHaveLength(mode==='self_delete'?0:1);
   const retry=await purgeDocument(d,a.document_id,ADMIN_ID);                                 // the write is finished: purge can complete
   expect(retry.done).toBe(true);expect(left()).toEqual([]);
   expect((await d.db.getDocument(a.document_id))!.purged_at).not.toBeNull();
  }
 });

});
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/eval.ts
// Gold-set evaluation receipts (spec §4.10, §11.3, §12.4; blocker 13). evalStats() is pure: it matches extracted
// candidate rows to annotated rows by identity, the COMPLETE typed value (value_num with numeric tolerance 0, plus
// value_currency, value_unit and value_date, nullability included; text only when no typed component exists), page
// and span overlap. runGoldEval() applies claimForProcessing's document and processing-authorization checks to every
// document BEFORE any external call (and again right before each document is sent), records the authorized licence
// version per document, makes no LLM call in dry-run, and writes the receipt keyed by behavior_digest. Blocker 13
// accepts corpus_kind='gold' only (with approved_gold_corpus_hash); 'synthetic' receipts never lift it.
import {decimalEquals} from '../facts/json-numbers';
import {behaviorDigest} from './behavior';
import {BrokerError,conflict,gone,notFound} from './errors';
import {extractCandidates} from './extract/run';
import {canonicalJson,sha256Hex} from './hash';
import {processingAllowed,utcToday} from './licences';
import {LEASE_SECONDS,artifactLoader} from './parse';
import {brokerPaths} from './storage';
import {trackedUpload} from './tracked-write';
import {documentForAccess} from './upload';
import {EXTRACT_PROMPT_VERSION,SCHEMA_VERSION} from './versions';
import type {BrokerDeps} from './deps';
import type {DocumentRow,EvalFieldStats,EvalReceiptRow,LicenceRow,RunRow,ValueUnit} from './types';

/** One annotated or extracted evidence row: identity, the full TypedValue, page and span. */
export interface EvalRow{target_key:string|null;field:string;occurrence:number;value_text:string;value_num:string|null;value_currency:string|null;value_unit:ValueUnit|null;value_date:string|null;page:number|null;char_start:number|null;char_end:number|null}
export interface GoldDoc{sha256:string;fields:EvalRow[];absent:{target_key:string|null;field:string}[]}
export interface ExtractedDoc{sha256:string;rows:EvalRow[]}
export const EVAL_THRESHOLD=0.95,GOLD_MIN_DOCS=30;
const id=(r:{target_key:string|null;field:string;occurrence?:number})=>`${r.target_key??''}\u0000${r.field}\u0000${r.occurrence??1}`;
const tf=(r:{target_key:string|null;field:string})=>`${r.target_key??''}\u0000${r.field}`;
const norm=(s:string)=>s.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
const sameNum=(a:string|null,b:string|null)=>a===null||b===null?a===b:decimalEquals(a,b);
/** Typed comparison: every component must agree (null only equals null); text decides only for untyped rows. */
const sameValue=(a:EvalRow,b:EvalRow)=>{
 const typed=[a.value_num,a.value_currency,a.value_unit,a.value_date,b.value_num,b.value_currency,b.value_unit,b.value_date].some(v=>v!==null);
 if(!typed)return norm(a.value_text)===norm(b.value_text);
 return sameNum(a.value_num,b.value_num)&&a.value_currency===b.value_currency&&a.value_unit===b.value_unit&&a.value_date===b.value_date;
};
const overlaps=(a:EvalRow,b:EvalRow)=>a.char_start!==null&&a.char_end!==null&&b.char_start!==null&&b.char_end!==null&&a.char_start<b.char_end&&b.char_start<a.char_end;
const matches=(gold:EvalRow,x:EvalRow)=>sameValue(gold,x)&&gold.page===x.page&&overlaps(gold,x);
const ratio=(n:number,d:number)=>d===0?null:n/d;

export function evalStats(gold:GoldDoc[],extracted:ExtractedDoc[]):Pick<EvalReceiptRow,'n_docs'|'per_field'|'absence'|'precision_min'|'recall_min'|'passed'>{
 const per:Record<string,{tp:number;fp:number;fn:number}>={};const bump=(f:string,k:'tp'|'fp'|'fn')=>{(per[f]??={tp:0,fp:0,fn:0})[k]++;};
 const absence={tp:0,fp:0,fn:0};
 for(const gd of gold){
  const rows=extracted.find(e=>e.sha256===gd.sha256)?.rows??[];
  const byId=new Map<string,EvalRow[]>();for(const r of rows){const k=id(r);byId.set(k,[...(byId.get(k)??[]),r]);}
  const used=new Set<EvalRow>();
  for(const gr of gd.fields){
   const hit=(byId.get(id(gr))??[]).find(x=>!used.has(x)&&matches(gr,x));
   if(hit){used.add(hit);bump(gr.field,'tp');}else bump(gr.field,'fn');
  }
  for(const r of rows)if(!used.has(r))bump(r.field,'fp');
  const present=new Set(rows.map(tf));
  for(const a of gd.absent)present.has(tf(a))?absence.fp++:absence.tp++;
  for(const k of new Set(gd.fields.map(tf)))if(!present.has(k))absence.fn++;
 }
 const per_field:Record<string,EvalFieldStats>=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(per).sort(([a],[b])=>a<b?-1:1).map(([f,c])=>[f,{...c,precision:ratio(c.tp,c.tp+c.fp),recall:ratio(c.tp,c.tp+c.fn)}]));
 const mins=(k:'precision'|'recall')=>{const v=Object.values(per_field).map(s=>s[k]).filter((x):x is number=>x!==null);return v.length?Math.min(...v):null;};
 const precision_min=mins('precision'),recall_min=mins('recall');
 return {n_docs:gold.length,per_field,absence,precision_min,recall_min,passed:precision_min!==null&&recall_min!==null&&precision_min>=EVAL_THRESHOLD&&recall_min>=EVAL_THRESHOLD};
}
export const corpusHash=(docs:GoldDoc[])=>sha256Hex(canonicalJson([...docs].sort((a,b)=>a.sha256<b.sha256?-1:1)));

export async function writeEvalReceipt(deps:Pick<BrokerDeps,'db'>,r:Omit<EvalReceiptRow,'receipt_id'|'ran_at'>):Promise<string>{
 if(r.corpus_kind==='gold'&&r.n_docs<GOLD_MIN_DOCS)console.warn(`[broker-research] gold receipt with ${r.n_docs} < ${GOLD_MIN_DOCS} docs will not lift blocker 13`);
 return deps.db.insertEvalReceipt(r);
}

/** What a gold run is allowed to evaluate, pinned at preflight (P-R2-03): the licence version AND the exact parse run. */
export interface AuthorizedDoc{sha256:string;licence_id:string;licence_version:number;parse_run_id:string;artifact_hash:string|null;extractor_version:string|null}
/** claimForProcessing's preconditions without a lease (an eval writes nothing but the receipt): the document is
 * reachable (withdrawn → 410 document_withdrawn, promotion pending → 409), parsed, and its licence authorises
 * processing today (confirmed for the current version, inside the validity dates, allows_llm_processing). */
export async function authorizeGoldDoc(deps:Pick<BrokerDeps,'db'|'now'>,sha256:string):Promise<{doc:DocumentRow;licence:LicenceRow;parseRun:RunRow}>{
 const found=await deps.db.findDocumentBySha(sha256);if(!found)throw notFound('document_not_found');
 const doc=await documentForAccess(deps,found.document_id);
 if(doc.status!=='parsed'||!doc.current_parse_run_id)throw conflict('document_not_parsed');
 const licence=await deps.db.getLicence(doc.licence_id);
 if(!licence||!processingAllowed(licence,utcToday(deps.now())))throw conflict('licence_forbids_processing');
 const parseRun=await deps.db.getRun(doc.current_parse_run_id);if(!parseRun)throw conflict('document_not_parsed');
 return {doc,licence,parseRun};
}
/** Lease heartbeat during long waits (liveness; registration + fence prevent new writes; remote writes still require reconciliation). */
export const HEARTBEAT_MS=60_000;
export interface GoldEvalResult{receiptId:string|null;authorized:AuthorizedDoc[];corpusHash:string;behaviorDigest:string;approved:boolean;stats:ReturnType<typeof evalStats>|null}
export async function runGoldEval(deps:BrokerDeps,docs:GoldDoc[],o:{by:string;dryRun:boolean;deadlineMs?:number;log?:(line:string)=>void}):Promise<GoldEvalResult>{
 const info=deps.llm.info();if(!info)throw new BrokerError('llm_unavailable',503);
 const authorized:AuthorizedDoc[]=[];const versions=new Set<string>();
 for(const g of docs){const a=await authorizeGoldDoc(deps,g.sha256);authorized.push({sha256:g.sha256,licence_id:a.licence.licence_id,licence_version:a.licence.version,parse_run_id:a.parseRun.run_id,artifact_hash:a.parseRun.artifact_hash,extractor_version:a.parseRun.extractor_version});versions.add(a.parseRun.extractor_version??'unknown');}
 if(versions.size>1)throw conflict('mixed_extractor_versions',{versions:[...versions]});
 const extractorVersion=[...versions][0]??'unknown';
 const hash=corpusHash(docs);
 const digest=behaviorDigest({extractorVersion,modelId:info.modelId,registryHash:info.registryHash,promptVersion:EXTRACT_PROMPT_VERSION,schemaVersion:SCHEMA_VERSION});
 const approved=(await deps.db.getSettings()).approved_gold_corpus_hash===hash;
 if(o.dryRun)return {receiptId:null,authorized,corpusHash:hash,behaviorDigest:digest,approved,stats:null};      // no external call
 const load=artifactLoader(deps);const extracted:ExtractedDoc[]=[];
 for(const g of docs){
  const a=await authorizeGoldDoc(deps,g.sha256);                                                   // re-checked right before this document is sent
  const pin=authorized.find(x=>x.sha256===g.sha256)!;
  if(a.licence.version!==pin.licence_version)throw conflict('licence_changed_during_eval');
  // the receipt's extractor_version / behavior_digest describe the pinned parse runs: a reparse in between is refused
  if(a.parseRun.run_id!==pin.parse_run_id||a.parseRun.artifact_hash!==pin.artifact_hash||a.parseRun.extractor_version!==pin.extractor_version)throw conflict('parse_run_changed_during_eval',{sha256:g.sha256});
  // the document lease serializes new work with purge (P-R6-02); it cannot cancel remote writes already sent. Held for
  // bucket writes; purge claims the same lease and answers 409 lease_held while an evaluation holds it
  const token=deps.newId();
  if(!await deps.db.claimLease(a.doc.document_id,token,LEASE_SECONDS))throw conflict('lease_held',{sha256:g.sha256});
  let b:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof extractCandidates>>;
  try{
   // heartbeat: a long LLM wait keeps the lease alive; a failed renewal is reported after the call returns
   let lost:'lease_lost'|'document_withdrawn'|null=null;
   const hb=setInterval(()=>{void deps.db.renewLease(a.doc.document_id,token,LEASE_SECONDS).then(x=>{if(x!=='ok')lost=x;},()=>{lost='lease_lost';});},HEARTBEAT_MS);
   try{b=await extractCandidates(deps.llm,info,await load(pin.parse_run_id),{deadline:new Date(deps.now().getTime()+(o.deadlineMs??600_000)),now:deps.now});}
   finally{clearInterval(hb);}
   if(lost==='document_withdrawn')throw gone();
   if(lost)throw conflict('lease_lost',{sha256:g.sha256});
   const evalRun=deps.newId();
   const put=(path:string,body:string)=>trackedUpload(deps,{documentId:a.doc.document_id,path,writer:'eval',body,contentType:'application/json',lease:{token,ttlSeconds:LEASE_SECONDS}});
   await put(brokerPaths.evalRequest(g.sha256,evalRun),JSON.stringify({run_id:evalRun,purpose:'eval-gold',sha256:g.sha256,licence_id:a.licence.licence_id,licence_version:a.licence.version,calls:b.requests}));
   await put(brokerPaths.evalResponse(g.sha256,evalRun),JSON.stringify({run_id:evalRun,calls:b.responses}));
  }finally{await deps.db.fencedUpdateDocument(a.doc.document_id,token,{releaseLease:true});}
  extracted.push({sha256:g.sha256,rows:b.rows});
  o.log?.(`${g.sha256.slice(0,12)} licence_v=${a.licence.version} candidates=${b.rows.length} unverified=${b.unverified} calls=${b.requests.length}`);
 }
 const stats=evalStats(docs,extracted);
 const receiptId=await writeEvalReceipt(deps,{corpus_kind:'gold',corpus_hash:hash,behavior_digest:digest,extractor_version:extractorVersion,model_id:info.modelId,registry_hash:info.registryHash,
  prompt_version:EXTRACT_PROMPT_VERSION,schema_version:SCHEMA_VERSION,code_version:deps.codeVersion,...stats,ran_by:o.by});
 return {receiptId,authorized,corpusHash:hash,behaviorDigest:digest,approved,stats};
}
```

```ts
// scripts/broker-research/eval-gold.ts
// Gold-set runner (spec §11.3, §12.4; owner action O14 / FR-5). Usage:
//   npx tsx scripts/broker-research/eval-gold.ts --manifest <private gold manifest.json> --by <admin uuid> [--dry-run]
// The manifest (never committed; lives with the owner) is {docs: GoldDoc[]} with the full typed value of every
// annotated row (value_text, value_num, value_currency, value_unit, value_date, page, span, target_key, occurrence).
// eval.ts::runGoldEval refuses the whole run before any LLM call if a document is withdrawn, not parsed, or its licence
// does not authorise processing today; --dry-run stops after those checks (no LLM call, no receipt). Prints the
// authorized licence version of every document, the receipt and whether corpus_hash equals approved_gold_corpus_hash.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';
import {brokerDeps} from '../../src/lib/broker-research/deps';
import {runGoldEval} from '../../src/lib/broker-research/eval';
import type {GoldDoc} from '../../src/lib/broker-research/eval';

const arg=(k:string)=>{const i=process.argv.indexOf(k);return i>0?process.argv[i+1]:undefined;};
async function main(){
 const manifestPath=arg('--manifest'),by=arg('--by'),dryRun=process.argv.includes('--dry-run');
 if(!manifestPath||!by)throw new Error('usage: --manifest <file> --by <uuid> [--dry-run]');
 const docs=(JSON.parse(readFileSync(manifestPath,'utf8')) as {docs:GoldDoc[]}).docs;
 const deps={...brokerDeps(),codeVersion:resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true})??'unknown'};
 const r=await runGoldEval(deps,docs,{by,dryRun,log:line=>console.log(line)});
 console.log(JSON.stringify(r,null,1));
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?`${(e as {code?:string}).code??''} ${e.message}`:e);process.exit(1);});
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/replay.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {replayFromSnapshot} from './replay';
import {effectiveValue} from './effective';
import {runExtract} from './extract/run';
import {sha256Hex} from './hash';
import {runParse} from './parse';
import {ADMIN_ID,DEADLINE,memoryBrokerDeps,seedDocument,seedLicence} from './testing';
import type {FieldRow,PublicationRow} from './types';

/** Snapshot rows in the shape broker_report_publish writes (A2): spans, artifact_hash, frozen source text + its hash,
 * framing provenance, the extracted and the effective value. */
const snap=(f:FieldRow,artifactHash:string|null,status=f.status)=>({field_id:f.field_id,target_key:f.target_key,field:f.field,occurrence:f.occurrence,status,extractor:f.extractor,
 parse_run_id:f.parse_run_id,run_id:f.run_id,artifact_hash:artifactHash,page:f.page,char_start:f.char_start,char_end:f.char_end,
 value_source_text:f.value_source_text,value_source_sha256:f.value_source_text===null?null:sha256Hex(f.value_source_text),framed:f.detail.framed===true,
 extracted:{value_text:f.value_text,value_num:f.value_num,value_currency:f.value_currency,value_unit:f.value_unit,value_date:f.value_date},value:effectiveValue(f)});
async function extracted(){
 const d=memoryBrokerDeps();const doc=await seedDocument(d,(await seedLicence(d.db)).licence_id);
 await runParse(d,doc.document_id,ADMIN_ID,{deadline:DEADLINE()});
 const ex=await runExtract(d,doc.document_id,ADMIN_ID,{deadline:DEADLINE()});
 const run=(await d.db.getRun(ex.runId))!;const parse=(await d.db.getRun(run.parse_run_id!))!;
 const rows=(await d.db.listFields(ex.reportId)).filter(f=>f.status==='extracted');
 const pub={publication_id:'p',report_id:ex.reportId,snapshot:{report:{report_id:ex.reportId},fields:rows.map(f=>snap(f,parse.artifact_hash,'confirmed'))},snapshot_hash:'h'} as unknown as PublicationRow;
 return {d,ex,parse,rows,pub};
}
describe('replayFromSnapshot',()=>{
 it('rebuilds candidates from stored responses and verifies every span against the artifact; flags a shifted span',async()=>{
  const {d,ex,parse,rows,pub}=await extracted();
  const ok=await replayFromSnapshot(d,pub);
  expect(ok.mismatches).toEqual([]);expect(ok.ok).toBe(true);expect(ok.checked).toBe(rows.length);
  const shifted={...snap(rows[0],parse.artifact_hash,'confirmed'),char_start:rows[0].char_start!+1};
  const r=await replayFromSnapshot(d,{...pub,snapshot:{report:{report_id:ex.reportId},fields:[shifted]}} as unknown as PublicationRow);
  expect(r.ok).toBe(false);expect(r.mismatches[0]).toMatchObject({field_id:rows[0].field_id,check:'span_verbatim'});
  const tampered={...snap(rows[0],parse.artifact_hash,'confirmed'),value_source_sha256:'0'.repeat(64)};
  expect((await replayFromSnapshot(d,{...pub,snapshot:{report:{report_id:ex.reportId},fields:[tampered]}} as unknown as PublicationRow)).mismatches[0]).toMatchObject({check:'snapshot_source'});
 });
 it('replays an old publication from its snapshot only: editing the same field afterwards (new span, framed) changes nothing (P-R1-10)',async()=>{
  const {d,ex,rows,pub}=await extracted();
  const before=await replayFromSnapshot(d,pub);expect(before.ok).toBe(true);
  // the next revision edits the same live row: different span + framing provenance (allowed on a draft)
  const f=rows.find(x=>x.char_start!==null&&x.char_end!==null&&x.char_end-x.char_start>1)!;
  await d.db.fieldReview(f.field_id,'confirm',{page:f.page,char_start:f.char_start!,char_end:f.char_end!-1,value_source_text:f.value_source_text!.slice(0,-1),detail:{framed:true}},ADMIN_ID);
  expect((await d.db.listFields(ex.reportId)).find(x=>x.field_id===f.field_id)).toMatchObject({char_end:f.char_end!-1,detail:expect.objectContaining({framed:true})});
  const after=await replayFromSnapshot(d,pub);
  expect(after).toEqual(before);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/replay.ts
// Publication replay without DB writes (spec §4.8 / §5.5, constraint 2). It reads ONLY the immutable publication
// snapshot, the immutable run rows and the bucket — never live field rows, whose span / source text / detail may be
// edited after an unpublish (P-R1-10). For every evidence row of the snapshot: (0) the frozen value_source_text matches
// its frozen sha256; (1) the parse artifact named by parse_run_id still hashes to the snapshot's artifact_hash;
// (2) slicing it at (page, char_start, char_end) gives the frozen value_source_text; (3) for LLM rows, the stored
// runs/{run_id}.response.json re-validated, re-merged and re-located (B1/B3) reproduces a candidate with the same
// identity and span and the snapshot's extracted value — rows whose snapshot says framed=true are exempt from (3) —
// and the run's behavior_digest recomputes from its recorded versions.
import {behaviorDigest} from './behavior';
import {sliceText} from './extract/locate';
import {buildCandidateRows,mergeChunks} from './extract/merge';
import type {ChunkExtraction} from './extract/merge';
import {validateExtraction} from './extract/schema';
import {sha256Hex} from './hash';
import {artifactLoader} from './parse';
import type {F3Artifact} from './ports/f3';
import type {BrokerDeps} from './deps';
import type {CandidateFieldInput,PublicationRow,RunRow,TypedValue} from './types';

interface SnapField{field_id:string;field:string;target_key:string|null;occurrence:number;status:string;extractor:string;parse_run_id:string|null;run_id:string|null;artifact_hash:string|null;
 page:number|null;char_start:number|null;char_end:number|null;value_source_text:string|null;value_source_sha256:string|null;framed:boolean;extracted:TypedValue;value:TypedValue}
export interface ReplayMismatch{field_id:string;check:'snapshot_source'|'artifact_hash'|'span_verbatim'|'candidate_missing'|'candidate_value'|'behavior_digest'|'response_unreadable';detail?:string}
type RDeps=Pick<BrokerDeps,'db'|'storage'>;

async function candidatesOf(deps:RDeps,run:RunRow,artifact:F3Artifact,extractor:string):Promise<CandidateFieldInput[]|null>{
 const bytes=run.response_path?await deps.storage.download(run.response_path):null;
 if(!bytes)return null;
 const calls=(JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes)) as {calls:{chunk:number;content:string|null}[]}).calls;
 const last=new Map<number,ChunkExtraction['extraction']>();
 for(const c of calls){if(c.content===null)continue;let v:unknown;try{v=JSON.parse(c.content.trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```$/,''));}catch{continue;}const r=validateExtraction(v);if(r.ok)last.set(c.chunk,r.value);}
 const merge=mergeChunks([...last.entries()].sort(([a],[b])=>a-b).map(([chunk,extraction])=>({chunk,extraction})));
 return buildCandidateRows(merge,{pages:artifact.pages,extractor});
}
export async function replayFromSnapshot(deps:RDeps,pub:PublicationRow):Promise<{publicationId:string;ok:boolean;checked:number;mismatches:ReplayMismatch[]}>{
 const snapshot=pub.snapshot as {fields?:SnapField[]};
 const fields=snapshot.fields??[];const load=artifactLoader(deps);const mismatches:ReplayMismatch[]=[];
 const runCache=new Map<string,Promise<CandidateFieldInput[]|null>>();
 for(const f of fields){
  if(f.status==='absent'||f.parse_run_id===null||f.page===null||f.char_start===null||f.char_end===null)continue;
  if(f.value_source_text===null||f.value_source_sha256===null||sha256Hex(f.value_source_text)!==f.value_source_sha256){mismatches.push({field_id:f.field_id,check:'snapshot_source'});continue;}
  const parse=await deps.db.getRun(f.parse_run_id);
  if(!parse||parse.artifact_hash!==f.artifact_hash){mismatches.push({field_id:f.field_id,check:'artifact_hash'});continue;}
  const artifact=await load(f.parse_run_id).catch(()=>null);
  if(!artifact){mismatches.push({field_id:f.field_id,check:'artifact_hash',detail:'unreadable'});continue;}
  if(sliceText(artifact.pages,f.page,f.char_start,f.char_end)!==f.value_source_text){mismatches.push({field_id:f.field_id,check:'span_verbatim'});continue;}
  if(!f.extractor.startsWith('llm:')||!f.run_id)continue;
  const run=await deps.db.getRun(f.run_id);
  if(!run){mismatches.push({field_id:f.field_id,check:'response_unreadable'});continue;}
  const digest=behaviorDigest({extractorVersion:run.extractor_version??'unknown',modelId:run.model_id??'',registryHash:run.registry_hash??'',promptVersion:run.prompt_version??'',schemaVersion:run.schema_version??''});
  if(digest!==run.behavior_digest)mismatches.push({field_id:f.field_id,check:'behavior_digest'});
  if(f.framed)continue;   // human-framed span (snapshot provenance): the candidate never had this span
  let p=runCache.get(run.run_id);if(!p){p=candidatesOf(deps,run,artifact,f.extractor);runCache.set(run.run_id,p);}
  const cands=await p;if(!cands){mismatches.push({field_id:f.field_id,check:'response_unreadable'});continue;}
  const c=cands.find(x=>x.target_key===f.target_key&&x.field===f.field&&x.occurrence===f.occurrence&&x.char_start===f.char_start&&x.char_end===f.char_end);
  if(!c){mismatches.push({field_id:f.field_id,check:'candidate_missing'});continue;}
  if(c.value_text!==f.extracted.value_text)mismatches.push({field_id:f.field_id,check:'candidate_value'});
 }
 return {publicationId:pub.publication_id,ok:mismatches.length===0,checked:fields.filter(f=>f.status!=='absent'&&f.char_start!==null).length,mismatches};
}
export async function replayPublication(deps:RDeps,publicationId:string){
 const pub=await deps.db.getPublication(publicationId);if(!pub)throw new Error(`publication_not_found:${publicationId}`);
 return replayFromSnapshot(deps,pub);
}
```

回放只读快照：A2 `broker_report_publish` 把每个证据行的 `value_source_text`、`value_source_sha256`、`framed`、`extracted`（抽取值）与生效值 `value` 一并冻结进快照；取消发布后同一行的跨度 / 原文 / `detail` 再被编辑，旧发布的回放结果不变（用例 2）。框选确认的行（快照 `framed=true`）只做 (0)(1)(2) 与摘要重算，不要求候选重现。

```ts
// scripts/broker-research/replay.ts
// Usage: npx tsx scripts/broker-research/replay.ts --publication <uuid>   (read-only; exit 1 on any mismatch)
import {coreDeps} from '../../src/lib/broker-research/deps';
import {replayPublication} from '../../src/lib/broker-research/replay';

const i=process.argv.indexOf('--publication');const id=i>0?process.argv[i+1]:undefined;
if(!id){console.error('usage: --publication <uuid>');process.exit(2);}
replayPublication(coreDeps(),id!).then(r=>{console.log(JSON.stringify(r,null,1));process.exit(r.ok?0:1);},e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/pipeline.integration.test.ts
// Critical end-to-end suite (spec §12.4) on real PostgreSQL (S4_TEST_STATE harness): synthetic PDF → resumable upload

// confirm, bind institution/analyst, rating scale, rules) → re-extract keeps effective rows and supersedes old
// candidates → snippet + summary approved → a GOLD eval receipt plus approved_gold_corpus_hash written in the TEST
// database (blocker 13 accepts gold only; Part A convention 5) → review approve → publish → anon views → replay →
// unpublish → revision 2. The single broker_research_settings row is global: this describe holds the session advisory
// lock pg_advisory_lock(hashtext('broker_research_settings')) for its whole duration (same lock as A3's settings

 });
```

### 管理员路由一览（C 定稿）

前缀 `/api/admin/broker-research`。全部：`requireAdminUser`（401 `authentication_required` / 403 `admin_required`）；POST/PATCH 另有 415 `unsupported_media_type`、403 `forbidden_origin`、400 `invalid_json`；参数错误 400 `invalid_parameter:<name>`；全部响应 `Cache-Control: no-store`；错误体 `{error:{code,message,...extra}}`；SQL 错误码映射见 `admin-route.ts::DB_ERROR_STATUS`（`publish_blocked` 409 带 `error.reasons:string[]`）。★ = 先写访问日志（失败 500 `access_log_failed`、无正文），撤回文档 410 `document_withdrawn`。请求体字段名就是路由解析的名字（多数为 camelCase；许可与上传意向为 snake_case 行字段名）。

| 方法 | 路径 | 请求体 / 查询 | 成功体 | 主要错误码 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `licences` | — | `{licences:LicenceRow[],settings:SettingsRow}` | — |
| POST | `licences` | `LicenceInput`（snake_case：`source_label,licence_kind,holder,terms_summary,evidence_path?,allows_llm_processing?,allows_public_metadata?,allows_public_snippets?,allows_public_summary?,allows_public_target_price?,snippet_max_chars,valid_from,valid_to?`；布尔缺省 false） | 201 `{licence:LicenceRow}` | 400 `invalid_licence:<key>` |
| GET | `licences/[licenceId]` | — | `{licence:LicenceRow}` | 404 `licence_not_found` |
| PATCH | `licences/[licenceId]` | `Partial<LicenceInput>`（至少一键） | `{licence:LicenceRow,material:boolean}` | 400 `invalid_licence:<key>`、404 |
| POST | `licences/[licenceId]/confirm` | `{version:number}` | `{licence:LicenceRow}` | 409 `version_mismatch`（`error.current_version`）、404 |
| POST | `settings/public` | `{enabled:boolean}` | `{settings:SettingsRow}` | — |
| POST | `documents/intent` | `{sha256,byte_size,licence_id,original_filename}`（snake_case） | 201 `{intentId,uploadUrl,token,expiresAt,replacesDocumentId:string\|null}` | 404 `licence_not_found`、409 `duplicate_document`（`error.documentId`）、409 `intent_mismatch`（`error.reason`）、413 `file_too_large` |
| POST | `documents/commit` | `{intentId}` | `{documentId,status:'committed'}` | 409 `intent_busy`/`intent_not_uploaded`/`intent_mismatch`/`duplicate_document`、410、422 `sha_mismatch`/`size_mismatch`/`not_pdf`、500 `promotion_lost`/`document_insert_lost`、`storage_failed` |
| POST | `documents/orphan-cleanup` | `{}` | `{removed:string[],kept:number}` | — |
| ★ GET | `documents/[documentId]/url` | — | `{url,expiresIn}` | 404、409 `promotion_pending`、410 |
| POST | `documents/[documentId]/parse` | `{}` | `{runId,status:'succeeded',batchStatus}` | 409 `licence_forbids_processing`/`lease_held`/`promotion_pending`/`lease_lost`、410、502 `<f3 code>`（`error.runId,batchStatus`）、503 `f3_unavailable` |
| POST | `documents/[documentId]/extract` | `{}` | `ExtractResult` = `{runId,reportId,status:'succeeded',counts,batchStatus,receipt,ruleReceiptId}` | 409 `document_not_parsed`/`licence_forbids_processing`/`lease_held`/`lease_lost`、410、502 `llm_schema_invalid`/`llm_quota`/`llm_failed`/`extract_deadline`/`storage_failed`（`error.runId,batchStatus`）、503 `llm_unavailable`、500（规则阶段异常：运行 failed、批次非信息码 `rules_error`） |
| ★ GET | `documents/[documentId]/pages/[n]` | — | `{documentId,parseRunId,page,text,pageCount}` | 400 `invalid_parameter:n`、404 `page_not_found`、409 `document_not_parsed`、410 |
| POST | `documents/[documentId]/withdraw` | `{reason:string(≤500),purge?:boolean}` | `{purge:{done:boolean,steps:PurgeStepRow[]}\|null}`（`purge:true` 但文档租约被占用时为 `null`，稍后重试 purge） | 404 |
| POST | `documents/[documentId]/purge` | `{}` | `{done:boolean,steps:PurgeStepRow[]}` | 404、409 `document_not_withdrawn` / `lease_held`（解析、抽取、摘要或黄金集评测正持有文档租约） |
| ★ GET | `reports/[reportId]` | — | `ReviewPayload`（契约） | 404 `report_not_found`、410 |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/fields/[fieldId]` | `{action:'confirm'\|'correct'\|'reject'\|'absent',payload?:object}`；confirm `payload={page?,charStart?,charEnd?}`（给跨度 = 框选）；correct `payload={valueText,valueNum?,valueCurrency?,valueUnit?,valueDate?,page?,charStart?,charEnd?}`；absent `payload={page}`；reject `{}` | `{receipt:MaterializeReceipt,rules:RulesOutcome}` | 400 `span_required`/`span_not_verbatim`/`span_out_of_range`/`invalid_correction:<key>`/`invalid_parameter:field`、404 `field_not_found`、409 `published_immutable`/`effective_exists` |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/fields` | `{field,targetKey?:string\|null,occurrence?:number,valueText,page,charStart,charEnd}` | 201 `{fieldId,receipt,rules}` | 400 `span_not_verbatim`/`span_required`、409 |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/fields/absent` | `{field:'rating'\|'target_price'\|'analyst'\|'target_horizon',targetKey?:string,page:number}` | 201 `{fieldId,receipt,rules}` | 400 |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/bind` | `{institutionId?:uuid\|null,scope?,reportType?:string\|null,primaryTargetKey?:string\|null,supersedesReportId?:uuid\|null,titlePublic?:string\|null,analyst?:{analystId:uuid,fieldId:uuid,role?:string}}` | `{receipt,rules}` | 400 `invalid_parameter:<key>`/`analyst_field_required`、409 |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/overrides` | `{targetKey,securityTicker,note?}` | `{receipt,rules}` | 400 `invalid_parameter:securityTicker` |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/review` | `{action:'start'\|'approve'\|'reject'}` | `{report:ReportRow}` | 409 `review_not_ready`（`error.blockers`） |
| GET | `reports/[reportId]/publish-blockers` | — | `{blockers:string[],reviewReady:boolean}` | 404 |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/publish` | `{}` | `{publicationId}` | 409 `publish_blocked`（`error.reasons`）/`published_immutable`/`report_withdrawn` |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/unpublish` | `{reason:string(≤500)}` | `{report:ReportRow}` | 409 `not_published` |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/disclosure-recheck` | `{}` | `{restored:boolean,failures:string[]}`（`restored=false` 时不改任何东西） | 404、409 `disclosure_inputs_changed` / `report_withdrawn` |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/summary` | `{lang:'zh'\|'en'}` | 201 `{summaryId,runId,status:'draft'\|'rejected',reasons:string[]}` | 409 `materialize_stale`/`document_not_parsed`/`lease_held`/`licence_forbids_processing`/`published_immutable`、429 `llm_quota`、502 `llm_failed`、503 `llm_unavailable` |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/translate` | `{}` | `{runId,zh,en}` | 409 `report_incomplete:title`/`lease_held`、502 `llm_schema_invalid`/`llm_failed`、503 |
| POST | `reports/[reportId]/snippets` | `{purpose,targetKey?,fieldId?:uuid\|null,page,charStart,charEnd,text?}` | 201 `{snippetId,passed:boolean}` | 400 `snippet_page`/`snippet_span`/`snippet_cross_page`/`snippet_too_long`（`error.max`）/`snippet_not_verbatim`、409 `published_immutable`/`document_not_parsed`、410 |
| POST | `snippets/[snippetId]` | `{action:'approve'\|'reject'}` | `{snippetId,status:'approved'\|'rejected'}` | 404 `snippet_not_found`、409 `snippet_not_draft`/`snippet_too_long`/`restricted_value`/`restricted_name` |
| POST | `summaries/[summaryId]` | `{action:'approve'\|'reject'}` | approve `{summary:SummaryRow}`；reject `{summaryId,status:'rejected'}` | 404 `summary_not_found`、409 `summary_not_draft`/`summary_stale`/`summary_overlap`/`summary_ungrounded`/`restricted_value`/`restricted_name` |
| GET | `review-queue` | `?status=pending\|in_review\|approved\|rejected&limit=1..200`（默认 50） | `{reports:ReportRow[]}` | 400 |
| GET | `access-log` | `?document=<uuid>&limit=1..500`（默认 100） | `{rows:(AccessLogInput&{id,created_at})[]}` | 400 |
| GET | `publications/[publicationId]` | — | `{publication:PublicationRow}` | 404 `publication_not_found` |

另：`POST /api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]`（共享路由，C6 加 `broker_research` 分支）请求体 `{status:'resolved_accept'|'resolved_reject',payload?:object}`，经 `BrokerResearchDb.quarantineResolve`；`published_immutable` → 409、`hook_params_required` → 400（体 `{id,outcome}`）。

### Part C 未决风险

- **偏移单位**：本模块偏移是 UTF-16 码元（规格 §4.6），F3 规格 §7.2 以码点计；生产 F3 适配器必须转换。F3 §8.3 目前没有 §11.1 的 `extractDocument`（O13 未签字），`productionF3Port` 保持 `adapter_not_wired`。
- **产物写入方**：C4 由 `parse.ts` 写 `reports/{sha}.extract.{run_id}.json`（`artifact_hash` = 所写字节），F3 只写页图；需 F3 作者确认（规格 §11.1/§4.12 写的是 F3 写）。
- **摘要夹具没有数字**：`SUMMARY_RESPONSE` 不含数字，端到端测试不覆盖数值落地的正向路径（B5 单测覆盖）。
- **token 估算**：`estimateTokens = UTF-16 长度` 偏保守（D5），英文报告分块偏碎、调用数偏多（每文档调用上限 = 分块数）。
- **commit 内存**：`commitIntent` 一次下载 ≤ 50 MiB 复算哈希（规格 §16 问题 8）；Vercel 内存不足时需改流式哈希。
- **审计外键**：`research_audit_log.user_id` 引用 `auth.users`，审计尽力而为，缺行不报错。
- **共享文件**：C6 改 `dq/quarantine/[id]/route.ts` 及其测试、`dq/batches.ts`；C8 改 `research-checks.ts`（独立 `(C8)` 围栏）。并行模块同时改这些文件需手工合并。
- **R7 同行读取**：`applyRules` 对同机构每篇报告各读一次 targets（`listReports` + `listTargets`），机构报告数很大时变慢；馆藏数百篇时可接受。

设计要点（实施前读完）：
- DTO 每个输出键都在 `public-dto.ts` 里逐个写出，**从不展开（spread）视图行**；视图新增列不会泄露。纵深防御：`target_price_public !== true` 时目标价 / 币种 / 期限 / 空间值一律丢弃（即使行里有值），目标价类引用行丢弃；片段长于许可 N（或 N 未知）丢弃；`summary_public !== true` 时摘要丢弃。
- 数值列输出十进制字符串（PostgREST 可能给 JSON number；指数形式视为畸形 → `null`，绝不猜值）。
- `public-read.ts` 是路由与服务端页面共用的加载器；页面不经 HTTP 调自己的 API。
- ticker 经 `resolveIssuer`（按今天的归属；**不**用 facts 的 `resolvePublicIssuer`，因为它拒绝 HK，而本模块覆盖港股）。
- 列表：无任何筛选参数（`limit` 除外）且 0 行 → `404 not_found`（对外开关关闭与空馆藏对匿名用户不可区分，这是视图的设计）；有筛选 0 行 → `200 {reports:[]}`。其余路由 0 行 / 不存在 → 404。全部响应 `Cache-Control: no-store`，`dynamic='force-dynamic'`。
- 响应在规格 §8.1 字段之外只多出 `targets[].publicationId`（来源抽屉要显示发布快照 id，来自 `broker_report_targets_public_v.publication_id`）与 `primaryTargetKey`；记入 §17。

```ts
  expect(dec('1980.00')).toBe('1980.00');expect(dec(1980)).toBe('1980');expect(dec(-0.5)).toBe('-0.5');
  expect(dec(1e21)).toBeNull();expect(dec('1e3')).toBeNull();expect(dec('12,5')).toBeNull();expect(dec(null)).toBeNull();expect(dec(Number.NaN)).toBeNull();
 });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 实现 `public-dto.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/public-dto.ts
// Whitelist serializers for the public read API and pages (spec §8.1, §12.1 "dto"). Every output key
// is written here explicitly — view rows are never spread — so a column added to a §4.11 view, or a
// private column reaching a bundle by mistake, cannot leak. Defence in depth on top of the views:
// target-price values (and citations of target-price fields) are dropped whenever
// target_price_public is not true; snippets longer than the licence N, or with N unknown, are
// dropped; summaries are dropped unless summary_public is true. Numeric columns become decimal
// strings; malformed or exponent forms become null (never a guessed value). upside_pct / upsidePct is
// a FRACTION (upside/1 = round(tp/pr − 1, 6)); only the display layer (components/format.ts) ×100.
import type {FieldName,NormalizedRating,PublicReportBundle,PublicReportDetail,ReportScope,SnippetPurpose,ValueUnit} from './types';

type Row=Record<string,unknown>;
export const PUBLIC_RATINGS:readonly NormalizedRating[]=['buy','overweight','neutral','underweight','sell','not_rated'];
export const PUBLIC_SCOPES:readonly ReportScope[]=['single_issuer','multi_issuer','sector','macro_strategy'];
export const SNIPPET_PURPOSES:readonly SnippetPurpose[]=['rating','target','thesis','risk','method','other'];
const UNITS:readonly ValueUnit[]=['pct','ratio','months','price'];
const FIELDS:readonly FieldName[]=['institution','analyst','published_date','price_as_of_date','ticker','rating','target_price','target_currency','target_horizon','price_at_report','price_currency','upside_stated','wacc','terminal_growth','terminal_value_share','valuation_method','sector','title'];
export const TARGET_PRICE_FIELDS:ReadonlySet<string>=new Set(['target_price','target_currency','target_horizon','upside_stated']);
const DEC=/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/;
const CITATION_STATUSES=['confirmed','corrected','absent'] as const;
const EXTRACTOR_KINDS=['llm','human'] as const;

const str=(v:unknown):string|null=>typeof v==='string'&&v.length>0?v:null;
const oneOf=<T extends string>(v:unknown,all:readonly T[]):T|null=>typeof v==='string'&&(all as readonly string[]).includes(v)?v as T:null;
const int=(v:unknown):number|null=>typeof v==='number'&&Number.isSafeInteger(v)?v:typeof v==='string'&&/^-?\d{1,9}$/.test(v)?Number(v):null;
const day=(v:unknown):string|null=>{const s=str(v);return s!==null&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(s)?s.slice(0,10):null;};
const instant=(v:unknown):string|null=>{const s=str(v);return s!==null&&Number.isFinite(Date.parse(s))?s:null;};
export const notNull=<T>(v:T|null|undefined):v is T=>v!==null&&v!==undefined;
/** numeric column → decimal string, or null. */
export function dec(v:unknown):string|null{
 const s=typeof v==='string'?v:typeof v==='number'&&Number.isFinite(v)?String(v):null;
 return s!==null&&DEC.test(s)?s:null;
}

export interface PublicInstitutionDto{id:string;nameEn:string;nameZh:string|null;aliases:string[];kind:string|null;ratingDisclosureUrl:string|null;reportCount:number;lastPublishedDate:string|null;lastAvailableAt:string|null}
export type PublicInstitutionRef=Pick<PublicInstitutionDto,'id'|'nameEn'|'nameZh'>;
export interface PublicInstitutionAnalystDto{analystId:string;displayName:string;reportCount:number}
export interface PublicTargetDto{
 currency:string|null; // effective public currency: public target price, else report price, else null
 targetKey:string;tickerAsStated:string;securityTicker:string|null;issuerId:string|null;publicationId:string|null;
 rating:{raw:string|null;normalized:NormalizedRating|null;scaleId:string|null};
 target:{price:string;currency:string|null;horizonMonths:number|null}|null;
 priceAtReport:{value:string;currency:string|null;asOf:string|null}|null;
 upsidePct:string|null;upsideFormulaVersion:string|null;
}
export interface PublicTitleDto{text:string;isRewritten:boolean;zh:string|null;en:string|null;isTranslation:boolean;modelId:string|null}
export interface PublicReportDto{
 reportId:string;revision:number;scope:ReportScope|null;institution:PublicInstitutionRef|null;targets:PublicTargetDto[];primaryTargetKey:string|null;
 title:PublicTitleDto;publishedDate:string|null;reportType:string|null;sectorAsStated:string|null;availableAt:string|null;codeVersion:string|null;
 hasSummary:{zh:boolean;en:boolean};snippetCount:number;targetPricePublic:boolean;rulesVersion:string|null;
}
export interface PublicCitationDto{fieldId:string|null;targetKey:string|null;field:FieldName;occurrence:number;page:number|null;valueText:string;valueNum:string|null;valueCurrency:string|null;valueUnit:ValueUnit|null;valueDate:string|null;status:typeof CITATION_STATUSES[number];extractorKind:typeof EXTRACTOR_KINDS[number]|null}
export interface PublicSnippetDto{snippetId:string;fieldId:string|null;targetKey:string|null;purpose:SnippetPurpose;page:number|null;text:string}
export interface PublicGroundingDto{sentenceIdx:number;targetKey:string;field:FieldName;value:string;unit:ValueUnit}
export interface PublicSummaryDto{summaryId:string;lang:'zh'|'en';label:'independent_summary';modelId:string|null;promptVersion:string|null;generatedAt:string|null;markdown:string;groundingAssertions:PublicGroundingDto[]}
export interface PublicAnalystDto{analystId:string;displayName:string;role:string|null}
export interface PublicReportDetailDto extends PublicReportDto{
 citations:PublicCitationDto[];snippets:PublicSnippetDto[];summaries:{zh:PublicSummaryDto|null;en:PublicSummaryDto|null};analysts:PublicAnalystDto[];
 licence:{snippetMaxChars:number|null;targetPricePublic:boolean;summaryPublic:boolean};settlement:null;
}
export interface PublicHistoryRowDto{
 reportId:string;prevReportId:string|null;institutionId:string|null;securityTicker:string;issuerId:string|null;publishedDate:string|null;prevPublishedDate:string|null;
 ratingNormalized:NormalizedRating|null;prevRatingNormalized:NormalizedRating|null;scaleId:string|null;prevScaleId:string|null;targetPrice:string|null;prevTargetPrice:string|null;
 targetCurrency:string|null;upsideFormulaVersion:string|null;prevUpsideFormulaVersion:string|null;codeVersion:string|null;prevCodeVersion:string|null;availableAt:string|null;prevAvailableAt:string|null;
}

export function toPublicInstitution(row:Row|null|undefined):PublicInstitutionDto|null{
 if(!row)return null;
 const id=str(row.institution_id),nameEn=str(row.name_en);if(!id||!nameEn)return null;
 const aliases=Array.isArray(row.aliases)?row.aliases.filter((a):a is string=>typeof a==='string'&&a.length>0):[];
 const url=str(row.rating_disclosure_url);
 return {id,nameEn,nameZh:str(row.name_zh),aliases,kind:str(row.kind),ratingDisclosureUrl:url!==null&&/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)?url:null,
  reportCount:int(row.report_count)??0,lastPublishedDate:day(row.last_published_date),lastAvailableAt:instant(row.last_available_at)};
}
export function toPublicInstitutionAnalyst(row:Row):PublicInstitutionAnalystDto|null{
 const analystId=str(row.analyst_id),displayName=str(row.display_name);
 return analystId&&displayName?{analystId,displayName,reportCount:int(row.report_count)??0}:null;
}

export function toPublicTarget(row:Row,targetPricePublic:boolean):PublicTargetDto|null{
 const targetKey=str(row.target_key);if(!targetKey)return null;
 const allowed=targetPricePublic&&row.target_price_public===true;
 const price=allowed?dec(row.target_price):null,par=dec(row.price_at_report);
 return {
  currency:price!==null?str(row.target_currency):par!==null?str(row.price_currency):null,
  targetKey,tickerAsStated:str(row.ticker_as_stated)??targetKey,securityTicker:str(row.security_ticker),issuerId:str(row.issuer_id),publicationId:str(row.publication_id),
  rating:{raw:str(row.rating_raw),normalized:oneOf(row.rating_normalized,PUBLIC_RATINGS),scaleId:str(row.scale_id)},
  target:price===null?null:{price,currency:str(row.target_currency),horizonMonths:int(row.target_horizon_months)},
  priceAtReport:par===null?null:{value:par,currency:str(row.price_currency),asOf:day(row.price_as_of_date)},
  upsidePct:allowed?dec(row.upside_pct):null,upsideFormulaVersion:str(row.upside_formula_version),
 };
}

export function toPublicReport(b:PublicReportBundle):PublicReportDto|null{
 const r=b.report;const reportId=str(r.report_id),text=str(r.title);if(!reportId||!text)return null;
 const tpp=r.target_price_public===true;
 const inst=toPublicInstitution(b.institution);
 const snippetCount=typeof b.snippetCount==='number'&&Number.isSafeInteger(b.snippetCount)&&b.snippetCount>0?b.snippetCount:0;
 return {
  reportId,revision:int(r.revision)??1,scope:oneOf(r.scope,PUBLIC_SCOPES),institution:inst?{id:inst.id,nameEn:inst.nameEn,nameZh:inst.nameZh}:null,
  targets:b.targets.map(t=>toPublicTarget(t,tpp)).filter(notNull),primaryTargetKey:str(r.primary_target_key),
  title:{text,isRewritten:r.title_is_rewritten===true,zh:str(r.title_zh),en:str(r.title_en),isTranslation:r.title_is_translation===true,modelId:r.title_is_translation===true?str(r.title_model_id):null},
  publishedDate:day(r.published_date),reportType:str(r.report_type),sectorAsStated:str(r.sector_as_stated),availableAt:instant(r.available_at),codeVersion:str(r.code_version),
  hasSummary:{zh:b.hasSummary?.zh===true,en:b.hasSummary?.en===true},snippetCount,targetPricePublic:tpp,rulesVersion:str(r.rules_version),
 };
}

function toCitation(row:Row,tpp:boolean):PublicCitationDto|null{
 const field=oneOf(row.field,FIELDS),status=oneOf(row.status,CITATION_STATUSES),valueText=str(row.value_text);
 if(!field||!status||valueText===null)return null;
 if(!tpp&&TARGET_PRICE_FIELDS.has(field))return null;
 return {fieldId:str(row.field_id),targetKey:str(row.target_key),field,occurrence:int(row.occurrence)??1,page:int(row.page),valueText,valueNum:dec(row.value_num),valueCurrency:str(row.value_currency),
  valueUnit:oneOf(row.value_unit,UNITS),valueDate:day(row.value_date),status,extractorKind:oneOf(row.extractor_kind,EXTRACTOR_KINDS)};
}
function toSnippet(row:Row,max:number|null):PublicSnippetDto|null{
 const snippetId=str(row.snippet_id),text=str(row.text),purpose=oneOf(row.purpose,SNIPPET_PURPOSES);
 if(!snippetId||text===null||!purpose||max===null||text.length>max)return null;
 return {snippetId,fieldId:str(row.field_id),targetKey:str(row.target_key),purpose,page:int(row.page),text};
}
function toSummary(row:Row,tpp:boolean):PublicSummaryDto|null{
 const summaryId=str(row.summary_id),lang=oneOf(row.lang,['zh','en'] as const),markdown=str(row.summary_md);
 if(!summaryId||!lang||markdown===null||row.kind!=='independent_summary')return null;
 const groundingAssertions=(Array.isArray(row.grounding_assertions)?row.grounding_assertions:[]).map((a:unknown)=>{
  const x=(a??{}) as Row;const sentenceIdx=int(x.sentence_idx),targetKey=str(x.target_key),field=oneOf(x.field,FIELDS),value=dec(x.value),unit=oneOf(x.unit,UNITS);
  return sentenceIdx!==null&&targetKey&&field&&value!==null&&unit&&(tpp||!TARGET_PRICE_FIELDS.has(field))?{sentenceIdx,targetKey,field,value,unit}:null;}).filter(notNull);
 return {summaryId,lang,label:'independent_summary',modelId:str(row.model_id),promptVersion:str(row.prompt_version),generatedAt:instant(row.generated_at),markdown,groundingAssertions};
}

export function toPublicReportDetail(d:PublicReportDetail):PublicReportDetailDto|null{
 const base=toPublicReport(d);if(!base)return null;
 const r=d.report,tpp=base.targetPricePublic,summaryPublic=r.summary_public===true,max=int(r.snippet_max_chars);
 const summaries:{zh:PublicSummaryDto|null;en:PublicSummaryDto|null}={zh:null,en:null};
 if(summaryPublic)for(const s of d.summaries.map(x=>toSummary(x,tpp)).filter(notNull))if(summaries[s.lang]===null)summaries[s.lang]=s;
 const snippets=d.snippets.map(s=>toSnippet(s,max)).filter(notNull);
 return {
  ...base,   // base is our own whitelisted DTO, not a view row
  hasSummary:{zh:summaries.zh!==null,en:summaries.en!==null},snippetCount:snippets.length,
  citations:d.citations.map(c=>toCitation(c,tpp)).filter(notNull),snippets,summaries,
  analysts:d.analysts.map(a=>{const analystId=str(a.analyst_id),displayName=str(a.display_name);return analystId&&displayName?{analystId,displayName,role:str(a.role)}:null;}).filter(notNull),
  licence:{snippetMaxChars:max,targetPricePublic:tpp,summaryPublic},settlement:null,
 };
}

export function toPublicHistoryRow(row:Row):PublicHistoryRowDto|null{
 const reportId=str(row.report_id),securityTicker=str(row.security_ticker);if(!reportId||!securityTicker)return null;
 return {
  reportId,prevReportId:str(row.prev_report_id),institutionId:str(row.institution_id),securityTicker,issuerId:str(row.issuer_id),
  publishedDate:day(row.published_date),prevPublishedDate:day(row.prev_published_date),
  ratingNormalized:oneOf(row.rating_normalized,PUBLIC_RATINGS),prevRatingNormalized:oneOf(row.prev_rating_normalized,PUBLIC_RATINGS),
  scaleId:str(row.scale_id),prevScaleId:str(row.prev_scale_id),targetPrice:dec(row.target_price),prevTargetPrice:dec(row.prev_target_price),targetCurrency:str(row.target_currency),
  upsideFormulaVersion:str(row.upside_formula_version),prevUpsideFormulaVersion:str(row.prev_upside_formula_version),codeVersion:str(row.code_version),prevCodeVersion:str(row.prev_code_version),
  availableAt:instant(row.available_at),prevAvailableAt:instant(row.prev_available_at),
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/public-read.test.ts

vi.mock('@/lib/entities/resolve',async(orig)=>({...await orig<typeof import('@/lib/entities/resolve')>(),resolveIssuer:mocks.resolveIssuer}));

import type {PublicReadDeps,ReportCursor} from './public-read';
import type {BrokerResearchDb,PublicReportBundle} from './types';

const uuid=(n:number)=>`00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12,'0')}`;
function b(n:number,o:{inst?:number;date?:string;ticker?:string;currency?:string|null;price?:string|null;summary?:boolean;public?:boolean}={}):PublicReportBundle{
 const inst=uuid(900+(o.inst??1));
 return {report:{report_id:uuid(n),title:`T${n}`,published_date:o.date??'2026-10-01',available_at:`${o.date??'2026-10-01'}T08:00:00+00:00`,primary_target_key:o.ticker??'600000.SH',target_price_public:o.public??true,snippet_max_chars:100,summary_public:true},
  targets:[{target_key:o.ticker??'600000.SH',security_ticker:o.ticker??'600000.SH',issuer_id:'iss-1',target_price:o.price===undefined?'10':o.price,target_currency:o.currency===undefined?'CNY':o.currency,price_at_report:'8',price_currency:'CNY',target_price_public:o.public??true,publication_id:uuid(500+n)}],
  hasSummary:{zh:o.summary??false,en:false},snippetCount:0,institution:{institution_id:inst,name_en:`Inst ${o.inst??1}`}};
}
function deps(db:Partial<BrokerResearchDb>):PublicReadDeps{return {db:db as BrokerResearchDb,tables:{} as PublicReadDeps['tables']};}

beforeEach(()=>vi.clearAllMocks());

describe('cursor',()=>{

  expect(decodeCursor(encodeCursor(c))).toEqual(c);
  for(const s of ['','!!!',Buffer.from('2026-10-01|nope').toString('base64url'),Buffer.from(`2026-1-01|${uuid(1)}`).toString('base64url')])expect(decodeCursor(s)).toBeNull();
 });

describe('listPublicReports',()=>{

  const publicReports=vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([b(1,{summary:true}),b(2,{date:'2026-09-01',summary:true})]);
  const page=await listPublicReports(deps({publicReports}),{limit:2,rating:'buy',summaryOnly:true});
  expect(publicReports).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({limit:2,rating:'buy',hasSummary:true}));
  expect(page.reports.map(r=>r.reportId)).toEqual([uuid(1),uuid(2)]);
  expect(decodeCursor(page.nextCursor!)).toEqual({publishedDate:'2026-09-01',reportId:uuid(2)});
  publicReports.mockResolvedValue([b(3)]);
  expect((await listPublicReports(deps({publicReports}),{limit:2})).nextCursor).toBeNull();
 });
 it('walks nextCursor to the end through the Supabase adapter under a server row cap below the page size (P-R4-03)',async()=>{
  const rows=Array.from({length:7},(_,i)=>b(i+1,{date:`2026-0${9-i}-01`}));
  const anon=cappedAnon({broker_reports_public_v:rows.map(x=>({...x.report,target_facets:[],has_summary:false})),broker_report_targets_public_v:rows.flatMap(x=>x.targets),
   broker_report_summaries_public_v:[],broker_report_snippets_public_v:[],research_institutions_public_v:[]},2);
  const d:PublicReadDeps={db:supabaseBrokerResearchDb({anon}),tables:{} as never};
  const seen:string[]=[];const sizes:number[]=[];let cursor:ReportCursor|undefined;
  for(let g=0;g<10;g++){
   const p=await listPublicReports(d,{limit:3,cursor});seen.push(...p.reports.map(r=>r.reportId));sizes.push(p.reports.length);
   if(!p.nextCursor)break;cursor=decodeCursor(p.nextCursor)!;
  }
  expect(sizes).toEqual([3,3,1]);                                                              // full pages despite the cap of 2 rows per response
  expect(seen).toEqual(rows.map((_,i)=>uuid(i+1)));
 });
});

describe('resolveTicker',()=>{

 it('merged issuer: OLD keeps its own security (read from the source rows), never the destination primary listing (P-R2-05)',async()=>{
  const tables=memoryTableClient({issuer_securities:['ticker','valid_from']});
  await tables.insert('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:'iss-old',ticker:'OLDCO',valid_from:'2000-01-01',valid_to:null});

  expect(await resolveTicker(tables,'oldco','2026-11-06')).toEqual({issuerId:'iss-new',securityTicker:'OLDCO'});
  await tables.update('issuer_securities',{ticker:'OLDCO'},{valid_to:'2026-01-01'});              // the old line is no longer current
  expect(await resolveTicker(tables,'oldco','2026-11-06')).toBeNull();                          // not NEWCO
  expect(await resolveTicker(tables,'ghost','2026-11-06')).toBeNull();
 });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 7: 实现 `public-read.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/public-read.ts
// Public read loaders shared by the /api/broker-research/* routes and the /intel/foreign-research
// server pages (spec §8.1, §9.2–9.3). Anon client over the §4.11 views only; whitelist DTOs from
// public-dto.ts; ticker → issuer via resolveIssuer by today's ownership (HK included — unlike the
// facts layer there is no market restriction); opaque base64url cursors; rating history and the
// cross-institution spread (same security + currency, newest report per institution, 12 months).
import {getAnonSupabase} from '../supabase/anon';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {isCurrentSecurity,resolveIssuer} from '../entities/resolve';
import {inferCoreMarket,normalizeSecurityTicker} from '../securities/ticker';
import {supabaseBrokerResearchDb} from './db';
import type {BrokerResearchDb,NormalizedRating,PublicReportBundle,ReportScope} from './types';
import {notNull,toPublicHistoryRow,toPublicInstitution,toPublicInstitutionAnalyst,toPublicReport,toPublicReportDetail} from './public-dto';
import type {PublicHistoryRowDto,PublicInstitutionAnalystDto,PublicInstitutionDto,PublicInstitutionRef,PublicReportDetailDto,PublicReportDto,PublicTargetDto} from './public-dto';

export const LIST_DEFAULT_LIMIT=50,LIST_MAX_LIMIT=200,BY_TICKER_DEFAULT_LIMIT=5,BY_TICKER_MAX_LIMIT=20;
export const HISTORY_DEFAULT_LIMIT=50,HISTORY_MAX_LIMIT=200,SPREAD_WINDOW_MONTHS=12,INSTITUTION_ANALYSTS_LIMIT=50;
// Spread selection is performed by broker_spread_latest_v, without a report traversal limit.

export interface PublicReadDeps{db:BrokerResearchDb;tables:TableClient}
export function anonPublicDeps():PublicReadDeps{const sb=getAnonSupabase();return {db:supabaseBrokerResearchDb({anon:sb}),tables:supabaseTableClient(sb)};}

export interface ReportCursor{publishedDate:string;reportId:string}
const CURSOR_RE=/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\|([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})$/i;
export const encodeCursor=(c:ReportCursor)=>Buffer.from(`${c.publishedDate}|${c.reportId}`,'utf8').toString('base64url');
export function decodeCursor(s:string):ReportCursor|null{
 if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,200}$/.test(s))return null;
 const m=CURSOR_RE.exec(Buffer.from(s,'base64url').toString('utf8'));
 return m?{publishedDate:m[1],reportId:m[2].toLowerCase()}:null;
}
const cursorOf=(b:PublicReportBundle):string|null=>{
 const d=b.report.published_date,id=b.report.report_id;
 return typeof d==='string'&&typeof id==='string'?encodeCursor({publishedDate:d.slice(0,10),reportId:id}):null;
};

export interface ListQuery{institutionId?:string;issuerId?:string;rating?:NormalizedRating;securityTicker?:string;currency?:string|null;scope?:ReportScope;from?:string;to?:string;limit:number;cursor?:ReportCursor;summaryOnly?:boolean}
export interface ReportPage{reports:PublicReportDto[];nextCursor:string|null;count:number}
/** One view page. summaryOnly → PublicReportFilter.hasSummary (filtered in the db layer, so pages stay full); nextCursor follows the last fetched row. */
export async function listPublicReports(deps:PublicReadDeps,q:ListQuery):Promise<ReportPage>{
 const bundles=await deps.db.publicReports({institutionId:q.institutionId,issuerId:q.issuerId,rating:q.rating,scope:q.scope,from:q.from,to:q.to,limit:q.limit,cursor:q.cursor,...(q.summaryOnly?{hasSummary:true}:{}),
  ...(q.securityTicker!==undefined?{securityTicker:q.securityTicker}:{}),...(q.currency!==undefined?{currency:q.currency}:{})});
 const last=bundles.at(-1);
 const reports=bundles.map(x=>toPublicReport(x)).filter(notNull);
 return {reports,nextCursor:bundles.length>=q.limit&&last?cursorOf(last):null,count:reports.length};
}

export interface LibraryTotals{reports:number;institutions:number;lastAvailableAt:string|null}
/** Public institutions with their counts (report_count / last_* come from research_institutions_public_v in one query) and the library totals. */
export async function listPublicInstitutions(deps:PublicReadDeps):Promise<{institutions:PublicInstitutionDto[];totals:LibraryTotals}>{
 const institutions=(await deps.db.publicInstitutions()).map(r=>toPublicInstitution(r)).filter(notNull)
  .sort((a,b)=>b.reportCount-a.reportCount||a.nameEn.localeCompare(b.nameEn));
 const last=institutions.map(i=>i.lastAvailableAt).filter(notNull).sort().at(-1)??null;
 return {institutions,totals:{reports:institutions.reduce((n,i)=>n+i.reportCount,0),institutions:institutions.length,lastAvailableAt:last}};
}

/** Universe ticker → issuer (today's owner) and EXACTLY the security that resolved the request (exact form, then the
 * normalised form). A merged issuer: resolveIssuer returns the destination's securities, so the requested OLD ticker is
 * read from the source issuer_securities rows with the landed current-security predicate (same as facts'
 * resolvePublicIssuer). Never substitutes a primary / first listing: no matching current row → null (P-R2-05). */
export async function resolveTicker(tables:TableClient,raw:string,today:string):Promise<{issuerId:string;securityTicker:string}|null>{
 const given=raw.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\//g,'.');
 const r=await resolveIssuer(tables,{ticker:given},{today});
 if(!r)return null;
 const core=inferCoreMarket(given),norm=core?normalizeSecurityTicker(given,core):null;
 let ticker=(r.securities.find(s=>s.ticker.toUpperCase()===given)??(norm?r.securities.find(s=>s.ticker.toUpperCase()===norm):undefined))?.ticker;
 if(ticker===undefined){
  for(const t of norm&&norm!==given?[given,norm]:[given]){
   const rows=await tables.select('issuer_securities',{ticker:t});
   if(rows.length===0)continue;
   if(rows.some(x=>isCurrentSecurity(x,today)))ticker=t;
   break;
  }
 }
 return ticker===undefined?null:{issuerId:r.issuer_id,securityTicker:ticker};
}

export async function getPublicReport(deps:PublicReadDeps,reportId:string):Promise<PublicReportDetailDto|null>{
 const d=await deps.db.publicReport(reportId);return d?toPublicReportDetail(d):null;
}
export async function publicHistory(deps:PublicReadDeps,q:{securityTicker:string;institutionId?:string;currency?:string;limit:number}):Promise<PublicHistoryRowDto[]>{
 return (await deps.db.ratingHistory(q)).map(r=>toPublicHistoryRow(r)).filter(notNull);
}

export function monthsBefore(today:string,months:number):string{
 const d=new Date(`${today}T00:00:00Z`);d.setUTCMonth(d.getUTCMonth()-months);return d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
}
export const currencyOf=(t:PublicTargetDto):string|null=>t.currency;
export const focusTarget=(r:PublicReportDto):PublicTargetDto|null=>r.targets.find(t=>t.targetKey===r.primaryTargetKey)??r.targets[0]??null;
const newestFirst=(a:PublicReportDto,b:PublicReportDto)=>(b.publishedDate??'').localeCompare(a.publishedDate??'')||b.reportId.localeCompare(a.reportId);

export interface PublicSpreadRowDto{currency:string|null;reportId:string;institution:PublicInstitutionRef;publishedDate:string|null;rating:{raw:string|null;normalized:NormalizedRating|null};targetPricePublic:boolean;target:{price:string;currency:string|null}|null;priceAtReport:{value:string;currency:string|null}|null;upsidePct:string|null}
export async function publicSpread(deps:PublicReadDeps,q:{issuerId:string;securityTicker:string;currency:string|null;today:string;windowMonths?:number}):Promise<PublicSpreadRowDto[]>{
 const reports=(await deps.db.spreadReports({issuerId:q.issuerId,securityTicker:q.securityTicker,currency:q.currency,from:monthsBefore(q.today,q.windowMonths??SPREAD_WINDOW_MONTHS)})).map(toPublicReport).filter(notNull);
 const latest=new Map<string,PublicSpreadRowDto>();
 for(const r of [...reports].sort(newestFirst)){
  if(!r.institution||latest.has(r.institution.id))continue;
  const t=r.targets.find(x=>x.securityTicker===q.securityTicker&&currencyOf(x)===q.currency);
  if(!t)continue;
  latest.set(r.institution.id,{currency:t.currency,reportId:r.reportId,institution:r.institution,publishedDate:r.publishedDate,rating:{raw:t.rating.raw,normalized:t.rating.normalized},targetPricePublic:r.targetPricePublic,
   target:t.target?{price:t.target.price,currency:t.target.currency}:null,priceAtReport:t.priceAtReport?{value:t.priceAtReport.value,currency:t.priceAtReport.currency}:null,upsidePct:t.upsidePct});
 }
 return [...latest.values()];
}

export interface ReportPageData{report:PublicReportDetailDto;history:PublicHistoryRowDto[];spread:PublicSpreadRowDto[];focusTargetKey:string|null}
export async function reportPageData(deps:PublicReadDeps,reportId:string,today:string):Promise<ReportPageData|null>{
 const report=await getPublicReport(deps,reportId);if(!report)return null;
 const t=focusTarget(report);
 if(!t||!t.securityTicker)return {report,history:[],spread:[],focusTargetKey:t?.targetKey??null};
 const sec=t.securityTicker,histCurrency=t.target?.currency??null;
 const [history,spread]=await Promise.all([
  report.institution?publicHistory(deps,{securityTicker:sec,institutionId:report.institution.id,currency:histCurrency??undefined,limit:HISTORY_MAX_LIMIT}):Promise.resolve([] as PublicHistoryRowDto[]),
  t.issuerId?publicSpread(deps,{issuerId:t.issuerId,securityTicker:sec,currency:currencyOf(t),today}):Promise.resolve([] as PublicSpreadRowDto[]),
 ]);
 return {report,history:history.filter(h=>h.targetCurrency===histCurrency),spread,focusTargetKey:t.targetKey};
}

export interface InstitutionPageData{institution:PublicInstitutionDto;reports:PublicReportDto[];analysts:PublicInstitutionAnalystDto[];securities:number;lastPublishedDate:string|null;moreReports:boolean}
/** Counts come from the institutions view (exact); the report list is the newest LIST_MAX_LIMIT; securities count the listed reports. */
export async function institutionPageData(deps:PublicReadDeps,institutionId:string):Promise<InstitutionPageData|null>{
 const institution=(await deps.db.publicInstitutions()).map(r=>toPublicInstitution(r)).filter(notNull).find(i=>i.id===institutionId);
 if(!institution)return null;
 const [page,analysts]=await Promise.all([listPublicReports(deps,{institutionId,limit:LIST_MAX_LIMIT}),deps.db.publicAnalysts({institutionId,limit:INSTITUTION_ANALYSTS_LIMIT})]);
 const securities=new Set(page.reports.flatMap(r=>r.targets.map(t=>t.securityTicker??t.tickerAsStated)));
 return {institution,reports:page.reports,analysts:analysts.map(toPublicInstitutionAnalyst).filter(notNull),securities:securities.size,lastPublishedDate:institution.lastPublishedDate,moreReports:page.nextCursor!==null};
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/broker-research/reports/route.ts
// GET /api/broker-research/reports (spec §8.1): anon views only, whitelist DTO, no-store. An
// unfiltered empty library is 404 not_found (anon cannot tell "switch off" from "empty" — by design);
// a filtered empty page is 200 []. ticker resolves through resolveIssuer (404 unknown_ticker).
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {QueryError,TICKER_RE,UUID_RE,dateParam,errorResponse,failureResponse,flagParam,intParam,paramErrorResponse,readParams,utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {LIST_DEFAULT_LIMIT,LIST_MAX_LIMIT,anonPublicDeps,decodeCursor,listPublicReports,resolveTicker} from '@/lib/broker-research/public-read';
import type {ListQuery} from '@/lib/broker-research/public-read';
import {PUBLIC_RATINGS,PUBLIC_SCOPES} from '@/lib/broker-research/public-dto';
import type {NormalizedRating,ReportScope} from '@/lib/broker-research/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['institution','ticker','rating','scope','from','to','limit','cursor','summary'] as const;

export async function GET(req:Request){
 const today=utcDate(new Date());
 let q:ListQuery,ticker:string|undefined,filtered:boolean;
 try{
  const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS);
  const institution=p.get('institution');if(institution!==undefined&&!UUID_RE.test(institution))throw new QueryError('institution');
  ticker=p.get('ticker');if(ticker!==undefined&&!TICKER_RE.test(ticker))throw new QueryError('ticker');
  const rating=p.get('rating');if(rating!==undefined&&!(PUBLIC_RATINGS as readonly string[]).includes(rating))throw new QueryError('rating');
  const scope=p.get('scope');if(scope!==undefined&&!(PUBLIC_SCOPES as readonly string[]).includes(scope))throw new QueryError('scope');
  const from=dateParam(p,'from'),to=dateParam(p,'to');if(from!==undefined&&to!==undefined&&from>to)throw new QueryError('to');
  const c=p.get('cursor'),cursor=c===undefined?undefined:decodeCursor(c);if(cursor===null)throw new QueryError('cursor');
  const limit=intParam(p,'limit',LIST_DEFAULT_LIMIT,LIST_MAX_LIMIT);
  q={institutionId:institution?.toLowerCase(),rating:rating as NormalizedRating|undefined,scope:scope as ReportScope|undefined,from,to,limit,cursor,summaryOnly:flagParam(p,'summary')};
  filtered=[...p.keys()].some(k=>k!=='limit');
 }catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const deps=anonPublicDeps();
  if(ticker!==undefined){
   const t=await resolveTicker(deps.tables,ticker,today);
   if(!t)return errorResponse('unknown_ticker','no issuer for ticker',404);
   q.issuerId=t.issuerId;
  }
  const page=await listPublicReports(deps,q);
  if(!filtered&&page.reports.length===0)return errorResponse('not_found','no public reports',404);
  return NextResponse.json(page,{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 }catch(e){return failureResponse(e,'broker-research/reports','reports unavailable');}
}
```
