- Create: `src/lib/broker-research/cron-auth.ts`（两条 cron 共用的 Bearer 校验）
- Create: `src/app/api/admin/broker-research/documents/[documentId]/verify/route.ts`、`route.test.ts`（单文档"重跑核验"，规格 §8.3；C 的 `adminPost` + `coreDeps()`）
- Modify: `src/app/(app)/admin/broker-research/documents/[documentId]/DocumentClient.tsx`（D5 创建；加"重跑核验"按钮）
- Create: `scripts/broker-research/storage-check.ts`
- Modify: `package.json`（`scripts` 对象**末尾**追加 `"test:storage"`；JSON 无注释，在实施记录里写明）
- Create: `docs/runbooks/broker-research.md`
- **不改** `vercel.json`（两条 cron 都不登记，骨架范围表 FR-5；登记是 owner 合并后事项，runbook 给出片段）
- Modify: `docs/audits/2026-11-06-foreign-research/10-implementation-log.md`

设计要点：
- 核验（规格 §8.3）：候选 = `db.verifyCandidates(VERIFY_CANDIDATE_LIMIT)`（已发布报告的文档，`last_verified_at` 升序、`null` 最先，A4/A5 在 SQL 里排序）；预算 250 s（每个文档开始前检查，到点写 plan 1 既有信息码 `deadline_hit` 停止——`INFO_CODES` 不另加）；对生效且带跨度的证据行（`confirmed/corrected`）重跑 R1：`sliceText(artifact.pages, page, char_start, char_end) === value_source_text`（`extract/locate.ts`，UTF-16 码元）。`evidence_ok` 一律经 `db.setReportFlags`（已发布报告上也允许，reports_guard 的 k_live 列）。**无论结果都写** `last_verified_at=now()` 与 `verify_status`（`ok` / `failed` / `error`），单个文档抛错也写 `error` 后继续，后面的文档不会饿死。不一致 → `evidence_ok=false`（视图即时隐藏，SQL 触发器写 `claim.retract`）+ 隔离 `span_drift`（键 `${sha256}:span_drift:${target_key??'-'}`，载荷只含字段名与页码）；产物不可读 → `evidence_ok=false` + 隔离 `artifact_unreadable`。cron 是本 dataset **唯一** `recordAttempt` 调用者（`cadence:'daily'`，`ok = batch status ≠ failed`）。cron **不恢复** `evidence_ok=true`；管理员单文档重跑（`restore:true`，不调 `recordAttempt`）通过才恢复。批次计数：每文档 `fetched+1`，结果三选一 `inserted`（ok）/ `quarantined`（failed 或 error，各 1）/ `failed`（抛错）；非信息错误 `span_drift` / `artifact_unreadable` / `verify_error` 使批次 `partial`。
- outbox（规格 §8.3、§10.2、§11.2）：`BROKER_RESEARCH_F4_URL` 未设（或不是 https / 本机）→ 端口 `enabled=false` → 路由返回 `{skipped:'f4_disabled'}`，**不读取、不改动**任何事件（`attempts` 不增加，事件保持 `pending`）。启用时每次最多 50 条、预算 50 s；投递前校验载荷形状（`claim_key` 含 `publication_id`、`claim_seq` register=1 / retract=2、`methodology_version='broker-claim/1'`、`visibility_ref.view`），不合格 → `markOutbox(failed:payload_invalid:<字段>)`；`attempts ≥ 10` 的 `failed` 由 `markOutbox`（A4）判定。投递体 = 载荷 + `event_id` + `kind`，`POST <F4>/claims/events`，`Bearer BROKER_RESEARCH_F4_TOKEN`（可选），10 s 超时。

P-R6-01..04：verify.test.ts 包含保留证据、下载中撤回、F3 迟到页图、无限 pending 与跨调用持久失败回归；使用 C4/C5/C7 已创建服务。

- [ ] **Step 1: 写核验的失败测试**

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/verify.test.ts
import {ADMIN_ID,DEADLINE} from './testing';
import {runParse} from './parse';
import {runExtract} from './extract/run';
import {pipelineExtraction} from './fixtures/pipeline';
import {withdrawDocument} from './withdraw';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {beforeEach,describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
import {memoryTableClient} from '../db/memory-table-client';
import {brokerPaths} from './storage';
import {memoryBrokerDeps,seedDocument,seedLicence,syntheticPdf} from './testing';
import {CRON_ACTOR,runVerify} from './verify';
import type {VerifyDeps} from './verify';
import type {BrokerResearchDb,DocumentRow,FieldRow} from './types';

const enc=(o:unknown)=>new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(o));
/** F3Artifact shape (C4): pages[{page,text}]; offsets are UTF-16 code units of text. */
const artifactOf=(text:string)=>enc({extractor_version:'f3/1',content_sha256:'x',page_count:1,ocr_used:false,ocr_version:null,pages:[{page:1,text}]});
const doc=(id:string,last:string|null):DocumentRow=>({document_id:id,sha256:`sha-${id}`,storage_path:'',byte_size:1,page_count:1,licence_id:'L',uploaded_by:'u',uploaded_at:'',original_filename:'',current_parse_run_id:`pr-${id}`,status:'parsed',lease_token:null,lease_until:null,promotion_pending:false,last_verified_at:last,verify_status:null,withdrawn_at:null,withdrawn_reason:null,purged_at:null,purge_requested_at:null,purge_requested_by:null});
const field=(report:string,o:Partial<FieldRow>={}):FieldRow=>({field_id:`f-${report}`,report_id:report,parse_run_id:`pr-${report.slice(2)}`,run_id:'x',superseded_by_run_id:null,target_key:'T',field:'target_price',occurrence:1,page:1,char_start:6,char_end:11,value_source_text:'12.34',
 extractor:'llm:m@r',extractor_confidence:null,status:'confirmed',corrected:null,conflict_group:null,detail:{},reviewed_by:null,reviewed_at:null,created_at:'',value_text:'12.34',value_num:'12.34',value_currency:'CNY',value_unit:'price',value_date:null,...o});

let tables:ReturnType<typeof memoryTableClient>,docs:Map<string,DocumentRow>,db:BrokerResearchDb,artifacts:Record<string,Uint8Array|undefined>,hashes:Record<string,string>,clock:number;
const sha=(b:Uint8Array)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
/** tamper: the stored artifact is changed OUTSIDE the cited span after its hash was recorded (P-R1-13). */
async function setup(entries:{id:string;last:string|null;text?:string;fields?:Partial<FieldRow>[];throws?:boolean;tamper?:boolean}[]){
 tables=memoryTableClient({dq_freshness:['dataset']});docs=new Map();artifacts={};hashes={};clock=Date.parse('2026-11-06T02:00:00Z');
 const fieldsBy=new Map<string,FieldRow[]>();
 for(const e of entries){
  docs.set(e.id,doc(e.id,e.last));
  if(e.text!==undefined){const b=artifactOf(e.text);hashes[`a-${e.id}`]=sha(b);artifacts[`a-${e.id}`]=e.tamper?artifactOf(`${e.text} (edited later)`):b;}
  fieldsBy.set(`r-${e.id}`,(e.fields??[{}]).map(o=>field(`r-${e.id}`,o)));
 }
 const order=(d:DocumentRow)=>`${d.last_verified_at===null?'0':'1'}${d.last_verified_at??''}|${d.document_id}`;   // what verifyCandidates returns (A4: SQL order)
 db={
  verifyCandidates:vi.fn(async(limit:number)=>[...docs.values()].sort((a,b)=>order(a).localeCompare(order(b))).slice(0,limit)),
  unreconciledWrites:vi.fn(async()=>[]),
  reportByDocument:vi.fn(async(id:string)=>docs.has(id)?{report_id:`r-${id}`,document_id:id,status:'published',evidence_ok:true}:null),
  getDocument:vi.fn(async(id:string)=>docs.get(id)??null),
  listFields:vi.fn(async(r:string)=>{if(entries.find(e=>`r-${e.id}`===r)?.throws)throw new Error('boom');return fieldsBy.get(r)??[];}),
  getRun:vi.fn(async(id:string)=>({run_id:id,kind:'parse',status:'succeeded',artifact_path:`a-${id.slice(3)}`,artifact_hash:hashes[`a-${id.slice(3)}`]??null})),
  updateDocument:vi.fn(async(id:string,p:Partial<DocumentRow>)=>{docs.set(id,{...docs.get(id)!,...p});}),
  setReportFlags:vi.fn(async()=>{}),
  getReport:vi.fn(async(id:string)=>({report_id:id,evidence_ok:false})),
 } as unknown as BrokerResearchDb;
}
const deps=():VerifyDeps=>({db,tables,codeVersion:'c',now:()=>new Date(clock),storage:{download:vi.fn(async(p:string)=>artifacts[p]??null)} as unknown as VerifyDeps['storage']});
const deadline=()=>new Date(clock+250_000);

describe('candidates',()=>{
 beforeEach(()=>setup([{id:'b',last:'2026-11-05T00:00:00Z',text:'price 12.34 CNY'},{id:'a',last:null,text:'price 12.34 CNY'},{id:'c',last:'2026-11-01T00:00:00Z',text:'price 12.34 CNY'}]));
 it('takes db.verifyCandidates order (never-verified first, then oldest) with the candidate limit',async()=>{
  const r=await runVerify(deps(),{deadline:deadline(),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:false});
  expect(r.results.map(x=>x.documentId)).toEqual(['a','c','b']);
  expect(db.verifyCandidates).toHaveBeenCalledWith(500);
 });
});

describe('runVerify',()=>{
 it('under 10 seconds skips cleanup inventory and still verifies evidence (NEW-03)',async()=>{
  await setup([{id:'ok',last:null,text:'price 12.34 CNY'}]);
  const r=await runVerify(deps(),{deadline:new Date(clock+9_000),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:false});
  expect(db.unreconciledWrites).not.toHaveBeenCalled();expect(r.checked).toBe(1);
 });
 it('cleanup consumes its full quarter, leaving evidence its reserved budget (NEW-03)',async()=>{
  await setup([{id:'ok',last:null,text:'price 12.34 CNY'}]);const start=clock;
  vi.mocked(db.unreconciledWrites).mockImplementationOnce(async()=>{clock+=20_000;return [];});
  const r=await runVerify(deps(),{deadline:new Date(start+80_000),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:false});
  expect(clock).toBe(start+20_000);expect(r.checked).toBe(1);expect(clock).toBeLessThan(start+80_000);
 });

 it('ok / drift / unreadable each write last_verified_at and verify_status; drift and unreadable hide and quarantine',async()=>{
  await setup([{id:'ok',last:null,text:'price 12.34 CNY'},{id:'dr',last:null,text:'price 12.3 CNY'},{id:'un',last:null}]);
  const r=await runVerify(deps(),{deadline:deadline(),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:true});
  expect(Object.fromEntries(r.results.map(x=>[x.documentId,x.outcome]))).toEqual({ok:'ok',dr:'failed',un:'error'});
  for(const id of ['ok','dr','un'])expect(docs.get(id)!.last_verified_at).toBe('2026-11-06T02:00:00.000Z');
  expect(docs.get('dr')!.verify_status).toBe('failed');expect(docs.get('un')!.verify_status).toBe('error');
  expect(db.setReportFlags).toHaveBeenCalledWith('r-dr',{evidence_ok:false});expect(db.setReportFlags).toHaveBeenCalledWith('r-un',{evidence_ok:false});
  expect(db.setReportFlags).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith('r-ok',expect.anything());
  const q=tables.rows('dq_quarantine').map(x=>[x.natural_key,x.reason_code]).sort();
  expect(q).toEqual([['sha-dr:span_drift:T','span_drift'],['sha-un:artifact_unreadable:-','artifact_unreadable']]);
  expect(JSON.stringify(tables.rows('dq_quarantine'))).not.toContain('12.3');      // payload holds field names and pages only
  const [batch]=tables.rows('ingest_batches');
  expect(batch).toMatchObject({producer:'broker-research-verify',status:'partial',counts:{fetched:3,inserted:1,quarantined:2,failed:0}});
  expect(tables.rows('dq_freshness')[0]).toMatchObject({dataset:'broker_research',expected_cadence:'daily',consecutive_errors:0});
  expect(r.freshness).toBe('fresh');
 });
 it('one throwing document still gets a timestamp and does not starve the next',async()=>{
  await setup([{id:'x',last:null,throws:true},{id:'y',last:'2026-11-01T00:00:00Z',text:'price 12.34 CNY'}]);
  const r=await runVerify(deps(),{deadline:deadline(),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:true});
  expect(docs.get('x')!.verify_status).toBe('error');expect(docs.get('y')!.verify_status).toBe('ok');
  expect(r.checked).toBe(2);expect(tables.rows('ingest_batches')[0].counts).toMatchObject({failed:1,inserted:1});
 });
 it('stops at the deadline with deadline_hit and leaves the rest for tomorrow',async()=>{
  await setup([{id:'a',last:null,text:'price 12.34 CNY'},{id:'b',last:'2026-11-01T00:00:00Z',text:'price 12.34 CNY'}]);
  const d=deps();(d.db.updateDocument as ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>).mockImplementation(async(id:string,p:Partial<DocumentRow>)=>{docs.set(id,{...docs.get(id)!,...p});clock+=300_000;});
  const r=await runVerify(d,{deadline:deadline(),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:true});
  expect(r.checked).toBe(1);expect(r.remaining).toBe(1);expect(docs.get('b')!.last_verified_at).toBe('2026-11-01T00:00:00Z');
  expect(tables.rows('ingest_batches')[0].errors).toEqual([{code:'deadline_hit'}]);expect(tables.rows('ingest_batches')[0].status).toBe('success');
 });
 it('manual single-document re-run restores evidence_ok and never records freshness',async()=>{
  await setup([{id:'a',last:null,text:'price 12.34 CNY'},{id:'b',last:null,text:'price 12.34 CNY'}]);
  const r=await runVerify(deps(),{deadline:deadline(),triggeredBy:'manual',recordFreshness:false,documentId:'b',restore:true});
  expect(r.results.map(x=>x.documentId)).toEqual(['b']);expect(db.setReportFlags).toHaveBeenCalledWith('r-b',{evidence_ok:true});
  expect(tables.rows('dq_freshness')).toEqual([]);expect(r.freshness).toBeNull();
 });
 it('an artifact changed outside the cited span fails its recorded hash: error, hidden, quarantined, and a manual re-run does not restore (P-R1-13)',async()=>{
  await setup([{id:'t',last:null,text:'price 12.34 CNY',tamper:true}]);
  const r=await runVerify(deps(),{deadline:deadline(),triggeredBy:'manual',recordFreshness:false,documentId:'t',restore:true});
  expect(r.results[0].outcome).toBe('error');
  expect(db.setReportFlags).toHaveBeenCalledWith('r-t',{evidence_ok:false});expect(db.setReportFlags).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith('r-t',{evidence_ok:true});
  expect(tables.rows('dq_quarantine').map(x=>x.reason_code)).toEqual(['artifact_unreadable']);
 });
 it('ignores candidate and absent rows',async()=>{
  await setup([{id:'a',last:null,text:'nothing here',fields:[{status:'extracted'},{status:'absent',page:1,char_start:null,char_end:null,value_source_text:null}]}]);
  const r=await runVerify(deps(),{deadline:deadline(),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:false});
  expect(r.results[0].outcome).toBe('ok');
 });
});
describe('withdrawal and port reconciliation regressions (P-R6-01/04)',()=>{
 let d:ReturnType<typeof memoryBrokerDeps>;
 beforeEach(()=>{d=memoryBrokerDeps();});
 const ready=async()=>{const doc=await seedDocument(d,(await seedLicence(d.db)).licence_id);await runParse(d,doc.document_id,ADMIN_ID,{deadline:DEADLINE()});await runExtract(d,doc.document_id,ADMIN_ID,{deadline:DEADLINE()});return {doc};};
 it('withdraw purge:false preserves parse artifacts and model request/response objects through successive daily cron runs (P-R6-01)',async()=>{
  const {doc}=await ready();
  const paths=[...d.storage.objects.keys()];
  expect(paths.some(p=>p.includes('.extract.'))).toBe(true);
  expect(paths.some(p=>p.endsWith('.request.json'))).toBe(true);
  expect(paths.some(p=>p.endsWith('.response.json'))).toBe(true);
  const before=new Map(d.storage.objects);
  await withdrawDocument(d,doc.document_id,{reason:'retain evidence',purge:false},ADMIN_ID);
  for(let day=0;day<3;day++){d.advance(86_400_000);await runVerify(d,{deadline:new Date(d.now().getTime()+250_000),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:false});}
  expect(d.storage.objects).toEqual(before);
  expect(await d.db.unreconciledWrites(100)).toEqual([]);
  expect((await d.db.getDocument(doc.document_id))!.purge_requested_at).toBeNull();
 });
 it('all seven purge steps fail but atomic withdrawal intent survives (P-R6-01)',async()=>{
  const doc=await seedDocument(d,(await seedLicence(d.db)).licence_id);
  vi.spyOn(d.db,'reportByDocument').mockResolvedValue({report_id:'forced-report'} as never);
  vi.spyOn(d.storage,'remove').mockRejectedValue(new Error('delete failed'));
  vi.spyOn(d.storage,'list').mockRejectedValue(new Error('list failed'));
  vi.spyOn(d.db,'listRuns').mockResolvedValue([{kind:'parse',run_id:'forced-run',request_path:'runs/forced.request.json',response_path:null}] as never);
  vi.spyOn(d.db,'purgeReportText').mockRejectedValue(new Error('text step failed'));
  await withdrawDocument(d,doc.document_id,{reason:'all fail',purge:true},ADMIN_ID);
  expect(await d.db.getDocument(doc.document_id)).toMatchObject({status:'withdrawn',withdrawn_reason:'all fail',withdrawn_at:expect.any(String),purge_requested_at:expect.any(String),purge_requested_by:ADMIN_ID});
  const steps=await d.db.purgeSteps(doc.document_id);expect(steps).toHaveLength(7);expect(steps.every(x=>x.status==='failed')).toBe(true);
 });
 it('purge reconciles done paths after deletion but leaves pending paths eligible (NEW-02)',async()=>{
  const doc=await seedDocument(d,(await seedLicence(d.db)).licence_id);
  const ids:string[]=[];
  for(const complete of [true,false]){
   const path=`runs/${d.newId()}.response.json`;
   const id=await d.db.registerWrite({document_id:doc.document_id,path,writer:'extract'});ids.push(id);
   await d.storage.upload(path,'{}','application/json');if(complete)await d.db.finishWrite(id);
  }
  await withdrawDocument(d,doc.document_id,{reason:'purge',purge:true},ADMIN_ID);
  const rows=await d.db.writesFor(doc.document_id),done=rows.find(x=>x.write_id===ids[0])!,pending=rows.find(x=>x.write_id===ids[1])!;
  expect(done.status).toBe('reconciled');expect(Date.parse(done.deleted_at!)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(Date.parse(done.finished_at!));
  expect(pending).toMatchObject({status:'pending',finished_at:null,reconciled_at:null});
  for(const w of rows)expect(d.storage.objects.has(w.path)).toBe(false);
  expect((await d.db.unreconciledWrites(100)).map(x=>x.write_id)).toContain(pending.write_id);
 });
 it('purge intent survives lease_held before any deletion step (P-R6-01)',async()=>{
  const doc=await seedDocument(d,(await seedLicence(d.db)).licence_id);
  await d.db.claimLease(doc.document_id,d.newId(),300);
  await withdrawDocument(d,doc.document_id,{reason:'purge',purge:true},ADMIN_ID);
  expect(await d.db.getDocument(doc.document_id)).toMatchObject({purge_requested_at:expect.any(String),purge_requested_by:ADMIN_ID});
  expect(await d.db.purgeSteps(doc.document_id)).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('withdrawal during PDF download prevents F3 invocation (P-R6-04)',async()=>{
  const doc=await seedDocument(d,(await seedLicence(d.db)).licence_id);
  const download=d.storage.download.bind(d.storage);let called=false;
  d.storage.download=async p=>{const bytes=await download(p);await withdrawDocument(d,doc.document_id,{reason:'during download',purge:false},ADMIN_ID);return bytes;};
  d.f3={available:()=>true,extractDocument:async i=>{called=true;return pipelineExtraction(i.sha256);}};
  expect(await runParse(d,doc.document_id,ADMIN_ID,{deadline:DEADLINE()})).toMatchObject({status:'failed',errorCode:'document_withdrawn'});
  expect(called).toBe(false);
 });
 it('resolved F3 with post-fence failure: a late page survives purge only until reconciliation (P-R6-04)',async()=>{
  const doc=await seedDocument(d,(await seedLicence(d.db)).licence_id);let prefix='';
  d.f3={available:()=>true,extractDocument:async i=>{
   prefix=i.pagesPrefix;
   // Deliberately release the lease before successful resolution; post-fence must retain pending.
   const held=(await d.db.getDocument(doc.document_id))!.lease_token!;
   await d.db.fencedUpdateDocument(doc.document_id,held,{releaseLease:true});
   return pipelineExtraction(i.sha256);
  }};
  await runParse(d,doc.document_id,ADMIN_ID,{deadline:DEADLINE()});
  expect((await d.db.writesFor(doc.document_id)).find(w=>w.writer==='f3')).toMatchObject({status:'pending',finished_at:null});
  // Nonconforming fake writes after resolve, then explicit withdrawal + purge deletes it.
  await d.storage.upload(`${prefix}1.png`,new Uint8Array([1]),'image/png');
  await withdrawDocument(d,doc.document_id,{reason:'purge',purge:true},ADMIN_ID);
  // A still later arrival proves the pending prefix remains eligible after a completed purge.
  await d.storage.upload(`${prefix}2.png`,new Uint8Array([2]),'image/png');
  await runVerify(d,{deadline:new Date(d.now().getTime()+250_000),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:false});
  expect(d.storage.objects.has(`${prefix}1.png`)).toBe(false);expect(d.storage.objects.has(`${prefix}2.png`)).toBe(false);
  expect((await d.db.writesFor(doc.document_id)).find(w=>w.writer==='f3')).toMatchObject({status:'pending',finished_at:null});
 });
 it('F3 timeout leaves pending prefix; a late page after purge is deleted on the next daily run (P-R6-04)',async()=>{
  const doc=await seedDocument(d,(await seedLicence(d.db)).licence_id);let prefix='';
  d.f3={available:()=>true,extractDocument:async i=>{prefix=i.pagesPrefix;throw new Error('timeout');}};
  await runParse(d,doc.document_id,ADMIN_ID,{deadline:DEADLINE()});
  expect((await d.db.pendingWritesFor(doc.document_id)).map(w=>w.writer)).toEqual(['f3']);
  await withdrawDocument(d,doc.document_id,{reason:'purge',purge:true},ADMIN_ID);
  await runVerify(d,{deadline:new Date(d.now().getTime()+250_000),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:false});
  await d.storage.upload(`${prefix}1.png`,new Uint8Array([1]),'image/png');d.advance(86_400_000);
  await runVerify(d,{deadline:new Date(d.now().getTime()+250_000),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:false});
  expect(d.storage.objects.has(`${prefix}1.png`)).toBe(false);
  expect((await d.db.unreconciledWrites(100)).map(w=>w.writer)).toEqual(['f3']);
 });
});
describe('purge-intent reconciliation (P-R6-01..03)',()=>{
 const deadline=(d:{now:()=>Date})=>new Date(d.now().getTime()+250_000);
 const sweep=(d:ReturnType<typeof memoryBrokerDeps>)=>runVerify(d,{deadline:deadline(d),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:false});
 async function fixture(){
  const d=memoryBrokerDeps();const x=await seedDocument(d,(await seedLicence(d.db)).licence_id);
  const path=`runs/${d.newId()}.request.json`;
  const id=await d.db.registerWrite({document_id:x.document_id,path,writer:'extract'});
  await d.db.updateDocument(x.document_id,{status:'withdrawn',withdrawn_at:d.now().toISOString(),withdrawn_reason:'test',purge_requested_at:d.now().toISOString(),purge_requested_by:CRON_ACTOR});
  return {d,x,path,id};
 }
 it('uncertain forever: late writes after previous sweeps and worker termination remain swept; only confirmed completion drains',async()=>{
  const {d,x,path,id}=await fixture();
  for(let day=0;day<35;day++){
   d.advance(86_400_000);await d.storage.upload(path,'{}','application/json');
   expect((await sweep(d)).writesReconciled).toBe(0);
   expect(d.storage.objects.has(path)).toBe(false);
   expect((await d.db.unreconciledWrites(10)).map(w=>w.write_id)).toContain(id);
  }
  await d.db.finishWrite(id); // positive completion, not elapsed time
  expect((await sweep(d)).writesReconciled).toBe(1);
  expect(await d.db.unreconciledWrites(10)).toEqual([]);
  expect((await d.db.writesFor(x.document_id))[0]).toMatchObject({status:'reconciled',deleted_at:expect.any(String)});
 });
 it('persistent hanging storage failures across invocations back off; later rows AND evidence verification progress',async()=>{
  vi.useFakeTimers();
  try{
   const {d,x,path,id}=await fixture();
   const exists=d.storage.exists.bind(d.storage);
   d.storage.exists=async p=>p===path?new Promise<boolean>(()=>{}):exists(p);
   const evidence=vi.spyOn(d.db,'verifyCandidates');
   // A visible candidate proves the evidence loop executes, even while cleanup repeatedly hangs.
   const healthy=await seedDocument(d,(await seedLicence(d.db)).licence_id);
   evidence.mockResolvedValue([healthy]);
   vi.spyOn(d.db,'reportByDocument').mockResolvedValue({report_id:'evidence',status:'published'} as never);
   const checked=vi.spyOn(d.db,'updateDocument');
   for(let day=0;day<3;day++){
    const later=`runs/${d.newId()}.response.json`;
    const done=await d.db.registerWrite({document_id:x.document_id,path:later,writer:'extract'});await d.db.finishWrite(done);
    await d.storage.upload(later,'{}','application/json');
    const running=sweep(d);await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(6_000);await running;
    expect(d.storage.objects.has(later)).toBe(false);
    expect(checked).toHaveBeenCalledWith(healthy.document_id,expect.objectContaining({last_verified_at:expect.any(String)}));
    const row=(await d.db.writesFor(x.document_id)).find(w=>w.write_id===id)!;
    expect(row.attempts).toBe(day+1);expect(Date.parse(row.next_attempt_at)).toBeGreaterThan(d.now().getTime());
    expect(row.status).toBe('pending');d.advance(86_400_000);
   }
  }finally{vi.useRealTimers();}
 });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 实现 `verify.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/verify.ts
// Daily evidence verification (spec §8.3): published reports' documents in last_verified_at order (null
// first), a 250 s budget, R1 re-run on effective span rows. Every attempted document gets
// last_verified_at and verify_status whatever happens, so a failing document never starves the rest.
// Drift → evidence_ok=false + quarantine span_drift; unreadable artifact → evidence_ok=false +
// quarantine artifact_unreadable. The cron is the dataset's only recordAttempt caller; only the
// admin single-document re-run (restore) may set evidence_ok back to true.
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import type {BatchError} from '../dq/batches';
import {quarantine} from '../dq/quarantine';
import {recordAttempt} from '../dq/freshness';
import type {FreshnessStatus} from '../dq/freshness';
import type {CoreDeps} from './deps';
import {sliceText} from './extract/locate';
import {loadArtifact} from './parse';
import type {StorageWriteRow} from './types';
import {deleteRegisteredPath,withinLiveness} from './tracked-write';
import type {PageText} from './extract/locate';
import type {DocumentRow,FieldRow} from './types';

export type VerifyDeps=Pick<CoreDeps,'db'|'storage'|'tables'|'now'|'codeVersion'>;
export const VERIFY_BUDGET_MS=250_000,VERIFY_CANDIDATE_LIMIT=500;
export const VERIFY_PRODUCER='broker-research-verify';
/** Reconciliation: at most 60 s of the cron's 250 s budget; queue read in batches of 200 (P-R5-02). */
export const RECONCILE_BUDGET_MS=60_000,RECONCILE_BATCH=200;
/** access-log actor of cron writes (the log's user_id has no FK; spec §4.12). */
export const CRON_ACTOR='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
export type VerifyOutcome='ok'|'failed'|'error';
export interface VerifyDocResult{documentId:string;reportId:string;outcome:VerifyOutcome;driftedFieldIds:string[];quarantineItems:number}
export interface VerifyReceipt{batchId:string;status:string;checked:number;remaining:number;results:VerifyDocResult[];freshness:FreshnessStatus|null;orphansRemoved:number;writesReconciled:number}
export interface VerifyOptions{deadline:Date;triggeredBy:'cron'|'manual';recordFreshness:boolean;documentId?:string;restore?:boolean}

/** Documents of published reports in verification order (db.verifyCandidates: last_verified_at asc, never verified first). */
async function candidates(deps:VerifyDeps):Promise<{doc:DocumentRow;reportId:string}[]>{
 const out:{doc:DocumentRow;reportId:string}[]=[];
 for(const doc of await deps.db.verifyCandidates(VERIFY_CANDIDATE_LIMIT)){
  if(doc.status==='withdrawn')continue;
  const r=await deps.db.reportByDocument(doc.document_id);
  if(r&&r.status==='published')out.push({doc,reportId:r.report_id});
 }
 return out;
}

/** The parse artifact through C4's loadArtifact: the COMPLETE stored bytes must hash to the run's recorded
 * artifact_hash (immutable-artifact provenance) before any span is checked or visibility restored; missing, changed
 * anywhere (also outside the cited spans) or malformed → null → outcome 'error' (P-R1-13). */
async function readArtifact(deps:VerifyDeps,parseRunId:string):Promise<PageText|null>{
 try{
  const run=await deps.db.getRun(parseRunId);if(!run)return null;
  const pages=(await loadArtifact(deps,run)).pages as unknown;
  return Array.isArray(pages)&&pages.every(p=>p&&typeof (p as {page?:unknown}).page==='number'&&typeof (p as {text?:unknown}).text==='string')?pages as PageText:null;
 }catch{return null;}
}
const hasSpan=(f:FieldRow)=>(f.status==='confirmed'||f.status==='corrected')&&f.superseded_by_run_id===null&&f.page!==null&&f.char_start!==null&&f.char_end!==null&&f.parse_run_id!==null;

export async function verifyDocument(deps:VerifyDeps,doc:DocumentRow,reportId:string,batchId:string,opts:{restore:boolean}):Promise<VerifyDocResult>{
 const fields=(await deps.db.listFields(reportId)).filter(hasSpan);
 const artifacts=new Map<string,PageText|null>();
 let unreadable=false;const drifted:FieldRow[]=[];
 for(const f of fields){
  const runId=f.parse_run_id!;
  if(!artifacts.has(runId))artifacts.set(runId,await readArtifact(deps,runId));
  const art=artifacts.get(runId);
  if(art===null||art===undefined){unreadable=true;continue;}
  if(sliceText(art,f.page!,f.char_start!,f.char_end!)!==f.value_source_text)drifted.push(f);
 }
 const outcome:VerifyOutcome=unreadable?'error':drifted.length?'failed':'ok';
 let quarantineItems=0;
 if(outcome!=='ok'){
  await deps.db.setReportFlags(reportId,{evidence_ok:false});
  const items=new Map<string,{reason:string;fields:{field:string;page:number|null}[]}>();
  if(unreadable)items.set(`${doc.sha256}:artifact_unreadable:-`,{reason:'artifact_unreadable',fields:[]});
  for(const f of drifted){
   const k=`${doc.sha256}:span_drift:${f.target_key??'-'}`;
   const e=items.get(k)??{reason:'span_drift',fields:[]};e.fields.push({field:f.field,page:f.page});items.set(k,e);
  }
  for(const [naturalKey,e] of items){
   await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:'broker_research',table:'broker_research_reports',naturalKey,reasonCode:e.reason,payload:{fields:e.fields},detail:{report_id:reportId,document_id:doc.document_id},batchId});
   quarantineItems++;
  }
 }else if(opts.restore){
  const rep=await deps.db.getReport(reportId);
  if(rep&&!rep.evidence_ok)await deps.db.setReportFlags(reportId,{evidence_ok:true});
 }
 await deps.db.updateDocument(doc.document_id,{last_verified_at:deps.now().toISOString(),verify_status:outcome});
 return {documentId:doc.document_id,reportId,outcome,driftedFieldIds:drifted.map(f=>f.field_id),quarantineItems};
}

export async function runVerify(deps:VerifyDeps,opts:VerifyOptions):Promise<VerifyReceipt>{
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:VERIFY_PRODUCER,dataset:'broker_research',codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy});
 const counts=emptyCounts(),errors:BatchError[]=[],results:VerifyDocResult[]=[];
 let all:{doc:DocumentRow;reportId:string}[];
 if(opts.documentId!==undefined){   // admin re-run: the one document, if it has a published report
  const doc=await deps.db.getDocument(opts.documentId),r=doc?await deps.db.reportByDocument(doc.document_id):null;
  all=doc&&doc.status!=='withdrawn'&&r?.status==='published'?[{doc,reportId:r.report_id}]:[];
 }else all=await candidates(deps);
 // Purge-intent reconciliation has a separate budget and durable retry ordering. No elapsed-time completion.
 let orphansRemoved=0,writesReconciled=0;
 const remainingMs=Math.max(0,opts.deadline.getTime()-deps.now().getTime());
 const cleanupMs=remainingMs<10_000?0:Math.min(RECONCILE_BUDGET_MS,remainingMs*0.25);
 const evidenceMs=remainingMs-cleanupMs; // reserved even if cleanup consumes its entire allocation
 const until=deps.now().getTime()+cleanupMs;
 const cleanupCall=<T>(invoke:()=>Promise<T>):Promise<T>=>{const ms=until-deps.now().getTime();return ms>0?withinLiveness(invoke(),ms):Promise.reject(new Error('cleanup_deadline'));};
 if(opts.documentId===undefined&&cleanupMs>0){
  const kept=new Set<string>();
  drain:for(;;){
   if(deps.now().getTime()>=until)break;
   let rows:StorageWriteRow[];
   try{rows=(await withinLiveness(deps.db.unreconciledWrites(RECONCILE_BATCH+kept.size),until-deps.now().getTime())).filter(w=>!kept.has(w.write_id));}
   catch{errors.push({code:'verify_error',key:'cleanup_inventory'});break;}
   if(!rows.length)break;
   for(const w of rows){
    if(deps.now().getTime()>=until)break drain;
    kept.add(w.write_id);
    try{
     const removed=await deleteRegisteredPath(deps.storage,w.path,{until,now:deps.now});
     const deletedAt=deps.now().toISOString(); // successful deletion COMPLETED; snapshot-pending still waits for another sweep
     if(removed.length){orphansRemoved+=removed.length;await cleanupCall(()=>deps.db.logAccess({document_id:w.document_id,user_id:CRON_ACTOR,action:'orphan_cleanup',detail:{reason:'purge_requested_write',write_id:w.write_id,writer:w.writer,removed:removed.length}}));}
     if(w.status==='done'&&w.finished_at!==null&&w.finished_at<=deletedAt){await cleanupCall(()=>deps.db.markReconciled(w.write_id,deletedAt));writesReconciled++;}
     // Pending rows are deliberately NOT reconciled or delayed on success: swept on every daily invocation.
    }catch{
     const attempts=w.attempts+1;
     await cleanupCall(()=>deps.db.retryWrite(w.write_id,new Date(deps.now().getTime()+Math.min(86_400_000,60_000*2**Math.min(attempts-1,11))).toISOString(),attempts)).catch(()=>{}); // no budget: unresolved row remains due
     errors.push({code:'verify_error',key:`write:${w.write_id}`});
    }
   }
  }
 }
 const evidenceUntil=Math.min(opts.deadline.getTime(),deps.now().getTime()+evidenceMs);
 let i=0;
 for(;i<all.length;i++){
  if(deps.now().getTime()>=evidenceUntil){errors.push({code:'deadline_hit'});break;}
  const {doc,reportId}=all[i];counts.fetched++;
  try{
   const r=await withinLiveness(verifyDocument(deps,doc,reportId,batchId,{restore:opts.restore===true}),evidenceUntil-deps.now().getTime());
   results.push(r);
   if(r.outcome==='ok')counts.inserted++;
   else{counts.quarantined++;errors.push({code:r.outcome==='error'?'artifact_unreadable':'span_drift',key:doc.document_id});}
  }catch{
   counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'verify_error',key:doc.document_id});
   try{await deps.db.updateDocument(doc.document_id,{last_verified_at:deps.now().toISOString(),verify_status:'error'});}catch{/* the next run retries this document first */}
  }
 }
 const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors},deps.now());
 const freshness=opts.recordFreshness?await recordAttempt(deps.tables,'broker_research',{ok:status!=='failed',cadence:'daily',now:deps.now(),detail:{batch_id:batchId,checked:counts.fetched}}):null;
 return {batchId,status,checked:counts.fetched,remaining:all.length-i,results,freshness,orphansRemoved,writesReconciled};
}
```

（测试中 `deadline_hit` 用例：第一个文档耗时 300 s 后才写完，循环在第二个文档开始前检查预算 → 停止；批次只有信息码 → `success`。）

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/ports/f4.ts
// F4 judgment-framework port (spec §11.2; plan FR-7 scope: interface + a production implementation that
// stays disabled until BROKER_RESEARCH_F4_URL is set). The consumer endpoint POST <F4>/claims/events
// dedupes by event_id and applies only the larger claim_seq per claim_key; this side only delivers.
import type {OutboxEvent} from '../types';

export type F4Delivery={ok:true;accepted:boolean;applied:boolean;claimId:string|null}|{ok:false;error:string};
export interface F4Port{readonly enabled:boolean;deliver(event:OutboxEvent):Promise<F4Delivery>}
export const disabledF4Port:F4Port={enabled:false,async deliver(){return {ok:false,error:'f4_disabled'};}};
export const eventBody=(e:OutboxEvent)=>({...e.payload,event_id:e.event_id,kind:e.kind});
const DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_MS=10_000;

export function productionF4Port(env:Record<string,string|undefined>=process.env,fetchImpl:typeof fetch=fetch):F4Port{
 const base=env.BROKER_RESEARCH_F4_URL?.trim();
 if(!base)return disabledF4Port;
 let url:URL;
 try{url=new URL('claims/events',base.endsWith('/')?base:`${base}/`);}catch{return disabledF4Port;}
 if(url.protocol!=='https:'&&!(url.protocol==='http:'&&/^(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)$/.test(url.hostname)))return disabledF4Port;
 const token=env.BROKER_RESEARCH_F4_TOKEN?.trim();
 return {enabled:true,async deliver(e){
  try{
   const res=await fetchImpl(url,{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json',...(token?{authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}:{})},body:JSON.stringify(eventBody(e)),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_MS)});
   if(!res.ok)return {ok:false,error:`http_${res.status}`};
   const b=await res.json().catch(()=>null) as {accepted?:unknown;applied?:unknown;claim_id?:unknown}|null;
   if(!b||typeof b.accepted!=='boolean')return {ok:false,error:'f4_bad_response'};
   return {ok:true,accepted:b.accepted,applied:b.applied===true,claimId:typeof b.claim_id==='string'?b.claim_id:null};
  }catch(err){return {ok:false,error:err instanceof Error&&err.name==='TimeoutError'?'f4_timeout':'f4_network'};}
 }};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/outbox.ts
// Outbox delivery to F4 (spec §8.3, §10.2). SQL writes the events (publish / unpublish / withdraw /
// hide triggers); TS only delivers. With F4 disabled nothing is read or changed: events stay pending
// and their attempts are not incremented. Each event's shape is checked before delivery;
// markOutbox (A4) increments attempts and turns ≥ 10 failures into 'failed'.
import {CLAIM_METHODOLOGY_VERSION} from './versions';
import type {F4Port} from './ports/f4';
import type {BrokerResearchDb,OutboxEvent} from './types';

export const OUTBOX_LIMIT=50,OUTBOX_BUDGET_MS=50_000;
const CLAIM_KEY=/^broker_target_price:([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}):.+$/i;
/** null when deliverable, else the first offending payload field. */
export function validateOutboxEvent(e:OutboxEvent):string|null{
 if(e.kind!=='claim.register'&&e.kind!=='claim.retract')return null;
 const p=e.payload,m=typeof p.claim_key==='string'?CLAIM_KEY.exec(p.claim_key):null;
 if(!m)return 'claim_key';
 if(p.claim_seq!==(e.kind==='claim.register'?1:2))return 'claim_seq';
 if(e.kind==='claim.retract')return null;
 if(p.claim_type!=='broker_target_price')return 'claim_type';
 if(p.methodology_version!==CLAIM_METHODOLOGY_VERSION)return 'methodology_version';
 const src=p.source as {publication_id?:unknown}|undefined;
 if(!src||typeof src.publication_id!=='string'||src.publication_id.toLowerCase()!==m[1].toLowerCase())return 'source';
 const vis=p.visibility_ref as {view?:unknown}|undefined;
 if(!vis||vis.view!=='broker_report_targets_public_v')return 'visibility_ref';
 return null;
}
export interface OutboxReceipt{skipped:'f4_disabled'|null;taken:number;delivered:number;failed:number}
export async function deliverOutbox(deps:{db:BrokerResearchDb;f4:F4Port;now:()=>Date},opts:{limit:number;deadline:Date}):Promise<OutboxReceipt>{
 if(!deps.f4.enabled)return {skipped:'f4_disabled',taken:0,delivered:0,failed:0};
 const events=await deps.db.takePendingOutbox(opts.limit);
 let delivered=0,failed=0;
 for(const e of events){
  if(deps.now().getTime()>=opts.deadline.getTime())break;
  const bad=validateOutboxEvent(e);
  if(bad){await deps.db.markOutbox(e.event_id,{delivered:false,error:`payload_invalid:${bad}`});failed++;continue;}
  const r=await deps.f4.deliver(e);
  if(r.ok&&r.accepted){await deps.db.markOutbox(e.event_id,{delivered:true});delivered++;}
  else{await deps.db.markOutbox(e.event_id,{delivered:false,error:r.ok?'f4_rejected':r.error});failed++;}
 }
 return {skipped:null,taken:events.length,delivered,failed};
}
```

```ts
vi.mock('@/lib/broker-research/storage',()=>({supabaseBrokerStorage:()=>({tag:'storage'})}));
vi.mock('@/lib/db/table-client',async(orig)=>({...await orig<typeof import('@/lib/db/table-client')>(),supabaseTableClient:()=>({tag:'tables'})}));
import {GET as verifyGET,POST as verifyPOST} from './broker-research-verify/route';
import {GET as outboxGET} from './broker-research-outbox/route';

const AUTH={authorization:'Bearer s3cret'};
const req=(path:string,h:Record<string,string>={})=>new Request(`https://alpha.example/api/cron/${path}`,{headers:h});

 mocks.verify.mockResolvedValue({batchId:'b',status:'success',checked:0,remaining:0,results:[],freshness:'fresh',orphansRemoved:0,writesReconciled:0});

 it('503 without CRON_SECRET, 401 on a wrong bearer, nothing runs',async()=>{

 });

 it('runs with a 250 s budget, cron trigger and freshness recording',async()=>{
```

```ts
// src/app/api/cron/broker-research-verify/route.ts
// Daily evidence verification trigger (spec §8.3). CRON_SECRET bearer (timing-safe, like facts-sync);
// maxDuration 300 with a 250 s budget; the only recordAttempt caller of dataset broker_research.
// NOT registered in vercel.json by this plan (nothing to verify before the first publication; the
// owner registers it after merge — docs/runbooks/broker-research.md). Receipt carries codes and counts.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '@/lib/facts/deps';
import {cronAuthorized} from '@/lib/broker-research/cron-auth';
import {supabaseBrokerResearchDb} from '@/lib/broker-research/db';
import {supabaseBrokerStorage} from '@/lib/broker-research/storage';
import {VERIFY_BUDGET_MS,runVerify} from '@/lib/broker-research/verify';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});

async function run(request:Request):Promise<NextResponse>{
 const secret=process.env.CRON_SECRET;
 if(!secret)return err('cron_unavailable','Cron unavailable',503);
 if(!cronAuthorized(request.headers.get('authorization'),secret))return err('unauthorized','Unauthorized',401);
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false});
 if(!codeVersion)return err('code_version_unavailable','VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA not set',503);
 const started=new Date();
 try{
  const sb=getAdminSupabase();
  const receipt=await runVerify({db:supabaseBrokerResearchDb({admin:sb}),storage:supabaseBrokerStorage(sb),tables:supabaseTableClient(sb),now:()=>new Date(),codeVersion},
   {deadline:new Date(started.getTime()+VERIFY_BUDGET_MS),triggeredBy:'cron',recordFreshness:true});
  return NextResponse.json({ok:receipt.status!=='failed',started_at:started.toISOString(),receipt:{batchId:receipt.batchId,status:receipt.status,checked:receipt.checked,remaining:receipt.remaining,freshness:receipt.freshness,
   outcomes:receipt.results.map(r=>({documentId:r.documentId,outcome:r.outcome}))}},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 }catch{return err('verify_failed','Broker research verification failed',500);}
}
export async function GET(request:Request){return run(request);}
export async function POST(request:Request){return run(request);}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/cron/broker-research-outbox/route.ts
// Outbox delivery trigger (spec §8.3, every 10 min proposed). BROKER_RESEARCH_F4_URL unset → the
// production F4 port is disabled and nothing is read or changed (events stay pending, attempts not
// incremented). NOT registered in vercel.json (F4 consumer endpoint does not exist yet, F4 spec §12.3).
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import {supabaseBrokerResearchDb} from '@/lib/broker-research/db';
import {OUTBOX_BUDGET_MS,OUTBOX_LIMIT,deliverOutbox} from '@/lib/broker-research/outbox';
import {productionF4Port} from '@/lib/broker-research/ports/f4';
import {cronAuthorized} from '@/lib/broker-research/cron-auth';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=60;
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});

async function run(request:Request):Promise<NextResponse>{
 const secret=process.env.CRON_SECRET;
 if(!secret)return err('cron_unavailable','Cron unavailable',503);
 if(!cronAuthorized(request.headers.get('authorization'),secret))return err('unauthorized','Unauthorized',401);
 const started=new Date();
 try{
  const f4=productionF4Port();
  const receipt=await deliverOutbox({db:f4.enabled?supabaseBrokerResearchDb({admin:getAdminSupabase()}):({} as never),f4,now:()=>new Date()},{limit:OUTBOX_LIMIT,deadline:new Date(started.getTime()+OUTBOX_BUDGET_MS)});
  return NextResponse.json({ok:true,started_at:started.toISOString(),receipt},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 }catch{return err('outbox_failed','Broker research outbox delivery failed',500);}
}
export async function GET(request:Request){return run(request);}
export async function POST(request:Request){return run(request);}
```

（Next 路由文件只允许导出约定名，所以 Bearer 校验放在 `src/lib/broker-research/cron-auth.ts`，两条路由共用。）

```ts
// src/lib/broker-research/cron-auth.ts
// CRON_SECRET bearer check shared by the two broker-research crons (same timing-safe check as facts-sync).
import {timingSafeEqual} from 'node:crypto';
export function cronAuthorized(auth:string|null,secret:string):boolean{
 const expected=Buffer.from(`Bearer ${secret}`),actual=Buffer.from(auth??'');
 return actual.length===expected.length&&timingSafeEqual(actual,expected);
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/broker-research/documents/[documentId]/verify/route.ts
// Admin single-document "re-run verify" (spec §8.3): same R1 re-check as the cron, restore=true (a pass
// sets evidence_ok back to true via setReportFlags), manual batch, NO recordAttempt (the cron stays the
// single producer of dataset freshness). Not ★: returns outcomes only, no text or spans. C's adminPost
// supplies 401/403/415/403-origin/400 invalid_json and no-store; BrokerError → status via toErrorResponse.
import {adminPost,jsonNoStore,uuidParam} from '@/lib/broker-research/admin-route';
import {coreDeps} from '@/lib/broker-research/deps';
import {conflict,gone,notFound} from '@/lib/broker-research/errors';
import {VERIFY_BUDGET_MS,runVerify} from '@/lib/broker-research/verify';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
interface Ctx{params:Promise<{documentId:string}>}
export const POST=adminPost<Ctx>('documents.verify',async({ctx})=>{
 const documentId=uuidParam((await ctx.params).documentId,'documentId');
 const deps=coreDeps();
 const doc=await deps.db.getDocument(documentId);
 if(!doc)throw notFound('document_not_found');
 if(doc.status==='withdrawn')throw gone();
 const receipt=await runVerify(deps,{deadline:new Date(Date.now()+VERIFY_BUDGET_MS),triggeredBy:'manual',recordFreshness:false,documentId,restore:true});
 if(receipt.checked===0)throw conflict('not_published');
 return jsonNoStore({batchId:receipt.batchId,status:receipt.status,outcome:receipt.results[0]?.outcome??'error'});
});
```

```ts
// scripts/broker-research/storage-check.ts
// Storage HTTP gate (spec §12.3), run by a human against the LOCAL Supabase stack before FR-6:
//   SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:54321 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=… SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=… npm run test:storage
// Checks: bucket private + 50 MiB + MIME list; anon AND authenticated reads of reports/* and staging/*
// denied; signed upload URL works once with the same raw PUT the admin upload page uses and is refused
// the second time; move semantics (source gone, no overwrite); signed read URL expiry; MIME and size
// rejection; objects and earlier signed URLs dead after removal. Writes a receipt JSON into
// docs/audits/2026-11-06-foreign-research/ and exits 1 on any failure. Refuses any non-local host.
// Creates and deletes one throwaway auth user (random example.test address) for the authenticated check.
import {randomBytes,randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {mkdirSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {createClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';

const BUCKET='broker-research',MAX=52428800;
interface Check{name:string;passed:boolean;detail:string}
const checks:Check[]=[];
const check=(name:string,passed:boolean,detail='')=>{checks.push({name,passed,detail});console.log(`${passed?'PASS':'FAIL'} ${name}${detail?` — ${detail}`:''}`);};
const sleep=(ms:number)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));
const pdf=(extra='')=>new Blob([`%PDF-1.7\n% storage-check ${extra}\n%%EOF\n`],{type:'application/pdf'});

async function denied(c:SupabaseClient,path:string){const {data,error}=await c.storage.from(BUCKET).download(path);return data===null&&error!==null;}
async function exists(c:SupabaseClient,path:string){const {data}=await c.storage.from(BUCKET).download(path);return data!==null;}
async function putRaw(url:string,body:Blob){const r=await fetch(url,{method:'PUT',headers:{'content-type':'application/pdf','x-upsert':'false'},body});return r.status;}

async function main(){
 const url=process.env.SUPABASE_URL??process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,service=process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY,anonKey=process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY??process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;
 if(!url||!service||!anonKey)throw new Error('SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are required');
 const host=new URL(url).hostname;
 if(!['localhost','127.0.0.1','[::1]'].includes(host))throw new Error(`refusing non-local Supabase host ${host}: run against the local stack only`);
 const opts={auth:{persistSession:false,autoRefreshToken:false}};
 const admin=createClient(url,service,opts),anon=createClient(url,anonKey,opts);
 const tag=randomUUID(),rep=`reports/storage-check-${tag}.pdf`,stg=`staging/storage-check-${tag}.pdf`,moved=`reports/storage-check-${tag}-moved.pdf`;
 const cleanup:string[]=[rep,stg,moved];let userId:string|null=null;
 try{
  const {data:bucket}=await admin.storage.getBucket(BUCKET);
  check('bucket is private with the 50 MiB limit and the MIME list',bucket?.public===false&&bucket.file_size_limit===MAX&&['application/pdf','application/json','image/png'].every(m=>bucket.allowed_mime_types?.includes(m)),JSON.stringify({public:bucket?.public,limit:bucket?.file_size_limit,mime:bucket?.allowed_mime_types}));
  for(const p of [rep,stg]){const {error}=await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).upload(p,pdf(p),{contentType:'application/pdf'});check(`service_role uploads ${p.split('/')[0]}/*`,!error,error?.message??'');}
  check('anon cannot read reports/*',await denied(anon,rep));check('anon cannot read staging/*',await denied(anon,stg));
  const email=`storage-check-${tag}@example.test`,password=randomBytes(24).toString('base64url');
  const {data:created,error:ce}=await admin.auth.admin.createUser({email,password,email_confirm:true});
  userId=created.user?.id??null;
  const authed=createClient(url,anonKey,opts);
  const {error:se}=await authed.auth.signInWithPassword({email,password});
  check('throwaway authenticated user signs in',!ce&&!se,ce?.message??se?.message??'');
  check('authenticated cannot read reports/*',await denied(authed,rep));check('authenticated cannot read staging/*',await denied(authed,stg));

  const up=`staging/storage-check-${tag}-signed.pdf`;cleanup.push(up);
  const {data:signed,error:sue}=await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).createSignedUploadUrl(up);
  const first=signed?await putRaw(signed.signedUrl,pdf('signed')):0;
  check('signed upload URL accepts one raw PUT',!sue&&first>=200&&first<300,`status ${first}`);
  const second=signed?await putRaw(signed.signedUrl,pdf('again')):0;
  check('signed upload URL refuses a second upload',second>=400,`status ${second}`);

  const {error:me}=await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).move(stg,moved);
  check('move staging → reports succeeds',!me,me?.message??'');
  check('move leaves no staging object',!(await exists(admin,stg)));check('move creates the target',await exists(admin,moved));
  const {error:overwrite}=await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).move(up,moved);
  check('move onto an existing object is refused',overwrite!==null,overwrite?.message??'no error');

  const {data:short}=await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).createSignedUrl(rep,2);
  const ok=short?(await fetch(short.signedUrl)).status:0;
  await sleep(3500);
  const late=short?(await fetch(short.signedUrl)).status:0;
  check('signed read URL works before expiry',ok===200,`status ${ok}`);check('signed read URL fails after expiry',late>=400,`status ${late}`);

  const txt=`reports/storage-check-${tag}.txt`;cleanup.push(txt);
  const {error:mimeErr}=await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).upload(txt,new Blob(['x'],{type:'text/plain'}),{contentType:'text/plain'});
  check('non-allowed MIME is rejected',mimeErr!==null,mimeErr?.message??'accepted');
  const big=`reports/storage-check-${tag}-big.pdf`;cleanup.push(big);
  const {error:sizeErr}=await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).upload(big,new Blob([new Uint8Array(MAX+1)],{type:'application/pdf'}),{contentType:'application/pdf'});
  check('object over 50 MiB is rejected',sizeErr!==null,sizeErr?.message??'accepted');

  const {data:longUrl}=await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).createSignedUrl(moved,600);
  await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).remove([moved]);
  check('purged object is gone',!(await exists(admin,moved)));
  const after=longUrl?(await fetch(longUrl.signedUrl)).status:0;
  check('a signed URL minted before purge no longer serves the object',after>=400,`status ${after}`);
 }finally{
  await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).remove(cleanup).catch(()=>undefined);
  if(userId)await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(userId).catch(()=>undefined);
 }
 const passed=checks.length>0&&checks.every(c=>c.passed);
 const dir=join(process.cwd(),'docs/audits/2026-11-06-foreign-research');mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});
 const at=new Date().toISOString();
 const file=join(dir,`storage-check-${at.replace(/[:.]/g,'-')}.json`);
 writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify({kind:'broker-research storage-check',ran_at:at,supabase_host:host,code_version:resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true})??'unknown',passed,checks},null,2)+'\n');
 console.log(`${passed?'ALL PASS':'FAILURES'} — receipt ${file}`);
 process.exit(passed?0:1);
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

- [ ] **Step 11: `docs/runbooks/broker-research.md`**

```markdown
# 外资研报（broker research）运行手册

规格：`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-04-foreign-research-design.md`；计划：`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-06-foreign-research.md`。

## 1. 开关与环境变量

| 变量 | 作用 | 未设时 |
|---|---|---|
| `broker_research_settings.public_enabled`（数据库） | 对外开关；关闭时全部公开视图 0 行、公开路由与页面 404 | 默认 `false` |
| `BROKER_RESEARCH_F3_ENABLED=1` | 允许调用 F3 文档管道 | 解析返回 `f3_unavailable` |
| `BROKER_RESEARCH_LLM_ENABLED=1` | 允许调用平台 LLM（抽取 / 摘要 / 翻译） | `llm_unavailable` |
| `BROKER_RESEARCH_F4_URL`（https） / `BROKER_RESEARCH_F4_TOKEN` | outbox 投递目标 `<URL>/claims/events` 与 Bearer | outbox cron 跳过，事件保持 `pending`、`attempts` 不变 |
| `CRON_SECRET` | 两条 cron 的 Bearer | cron 返回 503 |

## 2. FR-6 对外发布（只由 owner 执行）

前置三项门禁（管理员总览只读显示）：
1. **D1**：每个来源的许可行已由 owner / 法务确认当前版本（许可页"确认 v{n}"）。
2. **test:storage**：在本地 Supabase 栈运行 `SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:54321 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=… SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=… npm run test:storage`，全部 PASS，回执 `docs/audits/2026-11-06-foreign-research/storage-check-*.json` 提交到仓库。
3. **黄金集**：owner 批准清单并写 `broker_research_settings.approved_gold_corpus_hash`（O14）；`scripts/broker-research/eval-gold.ts` 在 owner 环境写 `gold` 回执，`passed=true`、`n_docs ≥ 30`、`corpus_hash` 等于批准值。

打开（管理员会话里，浏览器控制台或 curl 带会话 cookie；路由校验 Origin）：
`POST /api/admin/broker-research/settings/public {"enabled":true}` → 匿名浏览器打开 `/intel/foreign-research` 核对只出现许可允许的内容（目标价、片段、摘要逐项）。在规格 §17 记录日期与操作者。

**紧急关闭**：管理员总览"关闭对外"按钮，或同一路由 `{"enabled":false}`。提交后之后的请求不再含任何内容（全部响应 `no-store`）；已送达客户端的响应无法召回。

## 3. 登记 cron（owner 合并后事项；本计划未改 `vercel.json`）

首篇发布后登记核验；F4 消费端点上线且 `BROKER_RESEARCH_F4_URL` 配好后登记 outbox。在 `vercel.json` 的 `crons` 数组追加：

    {"path": "/api/cron/broker-research-verify", "schedule": "30 19 * * *"},
    {"path": "/api/cron/broker-research-outbox", "schedule": "*/10 * * * *"}

（核验 03:30 Asia/Shanghai；outbox 每 10 分钟需要 Vercel Pro。）手动触发：`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET" https://<host>/api/cron/broker-research-verify`。

## 4. 核验失败处理

- 回执 `outcomes[].outcome = failed`（跨度漂移）或 `error`（产物不可读）：对应报告已 `evidence_ok=false` 自动隐藏，`claim.retract` 已入 outbox，`/admin/dq` 有 `span_drift` / `artifact_unreadable` 隔离项。
- 处理：查明原因（产物被替换、桶对象丢失、F3 版本变化）→ 如需重新解析与复核，先 `unpublish`；修复后在文档页点"重跑核验"（`POST /api/admin/broker-research/documents/<id>/verify`），通过则 `evidence_ok=true`；再在 `/admin/dq` 处理隔离项。
- 新鲜度：`dq_freshness(dataset='broker_research')` 只由核验 cron 写；管理员手动重跑不写。

## 5. outbox

- `pending` 积压是正常的（F4 未上线）。启用后每次最多 50 条。
- `failed`（≥ 10 次失败或 `payload_invalid:*`）出现在管理员总览"需要处理"。修复原因后重新排队（service role SQL，逐条核对 `last_error`）：
  `update broker_outbox set status='pending', attempts=0, last_error=null where event_id = '<id>';`
- 同一 `claim_key` 的 retract（seq 2）先到会在 F4 写墓碑，晚到的 register（seq 1）被忽略——重放安全。

## 6. 上传与提升异常

- `409 duplicate_document`：同一 sha256 已入库，打开既有文档。
- `500 promotion_lost`：暂存与正式对象都不存在；文档已 `withdrawn(promotion_lost)`。用同一文件重新上传：intent 路由为该 sha 创建绑定既有 `document_id` 的替换意向，提交成功后文档恢复 `uploaded`。
- 孤儿暂存对象：`POST /api/admin/broker-research/documents/orphan-cleanup`（只删 `staging/` 下过期 / 放弃意向的对象，从不删 `reports/`）。

## 7. 撤回与清除

1. 文档页"撤回"（原因必填）→ 公开 404、原文与签名链接 410、`claim.retract` 入队。
2. 需要删除原文时勾选"同时清除"或之后点"执行清除"（输入 sha256 前 8 位）：步骤 `pdf → artifacts → runs → fields_text → snippets_text → summaries → quarantine_payload`，可重复执行，只重试未成功步骤；全部完成写 `purged_at`。证据哈希、运行元数据与审计保留。清除意向先持久化；purged_at 仅表示已知路径步骤完成，未确认完成的写入仍每日反复删除。撤回但不清除的文档不进入删除对账。没有存储侧生命周期规则；owner 可日后另加。
3. 访问日志（`/admin/broker-research/access-log?document=<id>`）核对撤回前的全文访问。

## 8. 回放

`npx tsx scripts/broker-research/replay.ts --publication <id>`：从发布快照与桶内产物重建，不读活表、不写库；用于审计与对 F4 结算的核对。
```

### MiniMax accepted follow-up — implementation gates (2026-11-06)

These cases extend the named tasks and their existing suites; they are implementation-plan requirements, not executed test results. Implement all adapter changes together. The A4/A5 contract's DTO assertions are added in D1 once `public-dto.ts` and `public-read.ts` exist; before D1 retain the database-only assertions.

| ID | Plan area / mandatory regression |
|---|---|
| P-R6-01 (P2) | A2/A4/A5 shared contract: `withdrawWithIntent` uses one `broker_document_withdraw` statement/transaction in pg and Supabase, and one synchronous validated `moveDocument` in memory. Initial purge withdrawal atomically sets status, timestamp/reason and intent; already-withdrawn retry adds intent without replacing original withdrawal metadata or intent actor. RPC rollback leaves both unchanged. Assert Supabase makes one RPC, never two document updates. C7: separately force lease refusal, then inject failure into each of the seven purge operations (including DB text steps and final sweep); after every failed invocation status remains withdrawn and both intent fields survive. `purge:false` on a fresh document never sets intent; it must not erase earlier authorized intent. |
| P-R6-04 / NEW-05 | C1 covers both preflight failure causes for upload and F3: no invocation, abandoned, null finished_at, excluded from pending/due reconciliation and immune to finish/reconcile. A1 rejects abandoned with finished_at and done without finished_at. F3 errors, timeouts and post-return document/lease failures remain pending. E1 deliberately violates the F3 no-detached-writes contract: successful resolve, post-fence lease loss, late page, withdrawal+purge, another late page, next reconciliation deletes it. |
| NEW-02 | C7 seed two registered paths, one done and one pending. Purge both successfully; done becomes reconciled with deleted_at >= finished_at, pending stays pending with null finished_at/reconciled_at and remains due. Failed deletion never reconciles. Run for pg and memory using memory storage; Supabase adapter contract verifies conditional status=done and finished_at<=deletedAt update. Repeat through final sweep and daily reconciliation. |
| NEW-03 | E1 uses 9s remaining: no cleanup inventory/storage calls, evidence runs. With 80s remaining cleanup gets 20s and evidence 60s; with 250s cleanup gets 60s and evidence 190s. Exhaust cleanup (including a hanging-call fake timer case), then prove evidence executes before the overall deadline. Cleanup DB bookkeeping (logAccess/markReconciled/retryWrite), like inventory/storage calls, must be bounded by the cleanup deadline; timeout retains unresolved rows and never consumes the evidence allocation. Liveness wrappers do not cancel the underlying operation. |
| NEW-04 | A3 exact six-column spread allowlist under anon and authenticated, restricted target-price licence, plus existing read grants/write rejection/visibility tests. No evidence, raw model payload, storage path or target price columns. Supabase cappedAnon spread fixtures use the same six-column shape and exercise null currency. |
| NEW-06 | A4/A5 shared multi-target fixture above: only one target matches security+currency+issuer. Extend with older/newer reports in the same institution, equal-date report IDs, and a second institution; include a newer report with only a nonmatching target. Assert exact sorted `(institution_id, report_id)` winners, no duplicates, independent of report insertion order or unrelated targets. Run identical fixture definitions through memory and pg and compare normalized sets; SQL view and Supabase view rows use the same expected winners. Selection is target-level, distinct `(security_ticker,currency,institution_id)` ordered published_date DESC/report_id DESC, then reader filters issuer/window. |
| NEW-07 / P-R6-06 partial | D1 extension to A4/A5 contract: DTO `targets[].currency` equals matching SQL/memory facet currency and spread row currency. Cases: public target exists; target absent/report price exists; both prices null with populated currency columns; target hidden by licence. Assert correct-currency inclusion, wrong-currency exclusion, and null-currency inclusion in list and spread, identically for memory and pg. Keep nested raw currency columns; use effective currency for filtering. |
| NEW-09 | A3 page-51 fixture explicitly passes target_price=120, price_at_report=100 and both currencies HKD for all 10,001 reports; assert every fixture satisfies the security/issuer/window/effective-currency predicate before asserting two institution winners. |

NEW-08 correction to disposition 15's validation wording: removed `MAX_WRITE_SECONDS` / age-based write completion, not all occurrences of `900`; unrelated `900` values remain in migration timestamps and test data.
